title: Senior QA Engineer – Data, AI & Cloud Pipelines
description:
LSEG is seeking a QA Engineer focused on Data, DevOps and AI to validate cloud data and AI solutions. You will design tests, validate ETL pipelines, and build automated frameworks to ensure data quality across pipelines and AI components.

Design and execute test scenarios and test cases based on business and functional requirements. Validate end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformations, integrations, and business rules. Perform data quality, reconciliation, regression, integration, and large-volume data testing. Develop and maintain automated test frameworks using Python, PyTest, Cucumber, or equivalent tools. Use advanced SQL and Snowflake to validate data and perform root-cause analysis. Integrate automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines. Support Git-based development practices, deployment validation, configuration checks, log analysis, and release verification. Test Generative AI solutions for accuracy, relevance, groundedness, consistency, hallucination risk, and guardrail effectiveness. Validate Agentic AI workflows, including tool and API interactions, multi-step execution, error handling, retry behaviour, and task completion. Create reusable test datasets and automated evaluation checks for data and AI solutions. Use AI-assisted approaches to improve test-case generation, automation, defect analysis, and QA efficiency. Identify, document, track, and communicate defects, risks, and quality metrics. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve engineering quality and release outcomes. 3–7 years of experience in Data QA, ETL testing, data quality engineering, or test automation. Strong SQL skills, including complex queries, joins, aggregations, window functions, and data reconciliation. Hands-on experience with Snowflake and data warehouse or data-platform testing. Experience in Python-based test automation using PyTest or a similar framework. Working knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins. Understanding of Git, branching, deployment workflows, logging, and monitoring.

title: Equipment Repair Technician
company: America's Swimming Pool Co. - Broken Arrow
description:
ASP – America’s Swimming Pool Company is America’s premier swimming pool service company. We have been operating for over 15 years with an outstanding reputation. We pride ourselves on providing "resort quality pool services". To do this we have built a team of dedicated, enthusiastic technicians who enjoy delivering resort-quality service and treating our customers with the utmost respect.
Our Mission: At ASP, we create superior value for our customers in all that we do by leveraging technology, higher standards, knowledge and the relentless pursuit of excellence.
Because of our approach, we have earned loyal customers who expect and desire dependable, quality swimming pool solutions. We guarantee satisfaction with our services and do not require long-term contracts. We are fully licensed and insured and our team members are among the best in the swimming pool service industry.
We continue to grow and are seeking a solution-oriented and customer-focused Equipment Repair Technician to join our team. This position is responsible for diagnosing issues with the swimming pool equipment and providing solutions to each and every customer they are assigned. This includes following our proven process for diagnosing issues, successfully communicating alternative solutions to the customer, completing the solution in an efficient manner and following all established protocols and sharing lessons learned with the rest of our team.
The ideal person for this position will love to work outdoors. They will be a self-­ starter who has the ability to work independently with minimal oversight and guidance. They will handle all matters with integrity and embrace the concept and requirements of delivering "resort-quality service".
Responsibilities:
Success in this position will be determined by the following measurable results:
  • Manage a daily schedule of equipment repair tasks;
  • Repair of pool pumps, heaters, filters, timers, pool cleaners, blowers, lights, automated pool systems, chlorinators, backwash valves, PVC plumbing, copper plumbing, and galvanized plumbing
  • Knowledge of 110 volt and 220 volt electrical equipment
  • The ability to manage an inventory of equipment on the truck and properly utilize and replenish the inventory when needed.
  • The ability to utilize a smart phone for our Pool Ops mobile platform.
  • The ability to spot opportunities outside of the repair call, such as upgrading other equipment or adding to the customer experience with other products.
  • Renovation experience – Re-plaster or equivalent (e.g., PebbleTech®), tile replacement/repair, deck texture/seal, pavers install/repair (preferred, not required)
We are specifically looking for an individual who demonstrates these behaviors consistent with the ASP way of doing business (our culture and values):
  • Acting with Integrity;
  • Superior Knowledge;
  • Passion for the Company;
  • Customer Focus;
  • Accountability and Discipline;
  • Respecting Others;
  • Excellence in ALL we do; and
  • Safety First at all Times.
Requirements:
Requirements for this position are that you have:
(1) a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record;
(2) the ability to lift up to 100 lbs; and
(3) the ability to pass a background check and drug screen
No other specific experience is required as we will teach you the ASP methods designed to give our customers superior value and to maximize your earning potential; however, a high school degree is preferred.
Bonus Potential:
This position has the potential of earning an annual bonus by the company when specific gross revenue goals are met for the year.
Benefits:
A company truck will be provided which you keep fully stocked with tools and inventory. You will receive paid vacation time following a qualifying period.
Next Steps:
If you are interested in being considered for this position and joining our award-winning team, then we would encourage you to apply for this position.
We look forward to learning more about you as you go through our hiring process.

title: Zorgkundige - SP Neurologische revalidatie
description:
Werkplek

SP Neurologische revalidatie is een gespecialiseerde afdeling voor patiënten met langdurige revalidatiebehoeften vanuit een niet-aangeboren hersenletsel (NAH) zoals een acuut CVA, mensen met gangstoornissen, Parkinson of MS. Tijdens de revalidatie wordt gestreefd naar een zo groot mogelijke functionele zelfredzaamheid van de revalidanten, zodat terugkeer naar huis of een geschikte woonomgeving mogelijk is.

Wat ons echt onderscheidt als afdeling is onze warme, gemoedelijke sfeer. Doordat revalidanten langer op onze dienst verblijven creëer je een hechtere band, waardoor er in teamverband zo goed mogelijk samen met de patiënt kan gefocust worden op de revalidatie.

In AZ Turnhout bieden we je de mogelijkheden van een grote organisatie, gecombineerd met het persoonlijk karakter van een klein ziekenhuis. Door onze grootte kunnen we inzetten op verschillende specialisaties en voortdurend investeren in nieuwe technologieën en innovaties. Zo bieden we onze medewerkers talloze leerkansen en doorgroeimogelijkheden. Maar wat ons echt onderscheidt is onze warme, gemoedelijke sfeer. We vinden het belangrijk dat niet enkel patiënten maar ook medewerkers zich Gast voelen in ons Huis.

title: Intern Engineering (MarTech)
description:
LuxExperience is the leading digital, multi-brand luxury group and the online shopping destination for luxury enthusiasts worldwide. LuxExperience operates a portfolio of some of the most distinguished store brands in digital luxury and creates communities for luxury enthusiasts with unique digital and physical experiences. Mytheresa, NET-A-PORTER and MR PORTER, jointly comprising the luxury segments of LuxExperience, offer highly curated edits of the most prestigious luxury brands across the world, featuring womenswear, menswear, kidswear, fine jewelry & watches, and lifestyle products. YOOX, which forms the off-price segment of LuxExperience, is the leading destination for multi-brand off-season online luxury shopping. The NYSE listed group operates worldwide.

To support our Marketing Technology (MarTech) team in Barcelona, we are looking for an intern with a good foundation in JavaScript, an understanding of single-page applications (SPAs), and an interest in web tracking and digital analytics.

During this 12-month internship, your main focus will be implementing and testing JavaScript code and supporting tracking implementations in Google Tag Manager (GTM) across our React-based websites. You will work on clearly defined tasks with guidance and code reviews from experienced team members.

This role is suitable for someone who enjoys coding, wants to understand how websites collect and send event data, and is looking to gain practical development experience. University coursework and personal projects are welcome; previous professional experience is not required.

What You Will Do

  • JavaScript implementation: Write and maintain small scripts and helper functions to support tracking and marketing integrations, following existing specifications and team conventions.
  • Google Tag Manager: Help configure, update and test tags, triggers and variables, including implementations that require custom JavaScript.
  • Tracking on React-based websites: Help implement and validate tracking across SPA navigation and dynamically rendered content, checking that page views and interaction events fire at the right time without duplication.
  • Data validation: Check that website events and data layer values are passed correctly to analytics and marketing tools.
  • Debugging: Use browser developer tools and GTM Preview to investigate missing or duplicate events, JavaScript errors and unexpected tag behaviour, with support from the team.
  • Testing and documentation: Test changes before release and document their purpose, expected behaviour and validation results.
  • Team collaboration: Work with MarTech colleagues to clarify implementation requirements and follow the team’s review, consent and release processes.

Who You Are

  • JavaScript fundamentals: You have a good foundation in JavaScript, including functions, arrays, objects, JSON, event listeners and basic asynchronous programming. Familiarity with DOM inspection or manipulation is useful.
  • Understanding of SPAs: You understand client-side navigation, dynamic rendering and asynchronous content updates, including why a route change does not necessarily trigger a full page reload.
  • JavaScript in dynamic websites: You understand how SPA behaviour affects DOM access, event listeners and script execution. You can reason about when code should run and how repeated execution could cause duplicate events.
  • Practical coding experience: You can write and explain small JavaScript programs. Examples from coursework, personal projects or previous experience are equally welcome.
  • Web fundamentals and debugging: You have a basic understanding of HTML and have used browser developer tools to inspect elements, check console errors and view network requests.
  • Curiosity and collaboration: You enjoy solving problems, pay attention to detail and are comfortable asking questions and learning from feedback.
  • Interest in MarTech: You are interested in applying your coding skills to web tracking, analytics and marketing technology.

What We Offer

  • Practical experience implementing JavaScript and working with Google Tag Manager in an international e-commerce environment.
  • Guidance, code reviews and opportunities to learn from experienced MarTech colleagues.
  • Mobile office with up to 20% of your total contracted hours, depending on the role and position.
  • A monthly gross salary of €800.
  • Individual support for mental health and well-being.
  • Urban Sports Club.
  • Corporate benefits platform.

LuxExperience is an equal opportunities employer, we encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We recognize and celebrate the benefits that diversity brings to our workplace, our business and our customers. We welcome and will consider all applications regardless of race and nationality, religion, color, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

If you require any reasonable adjustments to complete your application, please do not hesitate to advise us accordingly.

title: Specialist, Time and Attendance
description:
Status: Full Time, Permanent, Non-unionized

WHY CALGARY AIRPORTS
Powered by heart and dedicated to excellence, we’re the team that keeps Calgary connected – and you could be our newest member.
We’re in the business of uplifting people, and every day, we create runways to new places and possibilities, building a better airport experience for everyone.
WHAT’S THE TEAM LIKE

At Calgary Airports, our People team has a clear and simple purpose - to build and support exceptional leadership and thriving Crew. Everything we do, every day, is to bring out the best in our crew. With an enviable culture that attracts the best and the brightest, our People team is committed to investing in our crew through programs that support our business growth, create operational excellence and enable organizational effectiveness. The Specialist, Time & Attendance helps ensure employees are paid accurately and time and attendance practices are applied consistently across Calgary Airports. Working with leaders, employees and key partners, this role provides expertise on timekeeping and time-off, resolves issues, analyzes workforce data and identifies opportunities to improve processes.

WHAT ARE SOME OF THE RESPONSIBILITIES

Ensure adherence to employment standards, collective agreements, and averaging schedules for unionized environments.
Monitor hours worked to support accurate utilization time, for example daily hours, use of overtime, and time away from work.
Perform bi-weekly payroll controls and compliance checks to validate accuracy of pay related to overtime, vacation and time away, and identify root causes and implement controls or process improvements that prevent recurrence.
Understand crew, leader, and organizational needs related to time and schedules, and provide expertise and support for needs.
Analyze scheduling patterns and recommend optimization options to improve coverage, reduce costs, and enhance time utilization to strengthen controls and avoid unnecessary payroll costs.
Support payroll processing activities and provide direct coverage for payroll administration and processing during peak periods or absences.
Assist payroll team with auditing and reconciliation of hours worked, overtime, and leave payouts.
Utilize workforce management and scheduling software (e.g., Dayforce) to manage data and workflows.
Partner with People Systems & Analytics to ensure data integrity between HRIS, payroll, and scheduling platforms.
Routinely audit adherence to schedules and appropriately engages with leaders, crew and others involved in time administration decisions, including labour relations functions to ensure accuracy and standards are followed and working as intended.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING

The ability to gain and maintain a RAIC (RAIC Program and Application Information)
Post-secondary education in Human Resources, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field, or demonstrated deep operational education.
3–5 years of experience in time and attendance administration and payroll, schedule or workforce analytics.
Proficiency with workforce management, scheduling systems and payroll systems.
Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools; experience with dashboards and workforce analytics is an asset.
Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage competing priorities.
Proven ability to ensure overall health of time administration systems.
Knowledge of employment legislation related to hours of work, overtime, and averaging agreements.
Demonstrated experience working in a unionized environment, including interpretation and application of collective agreements and employment standards.

WHAT ADDITIONAL SKILLS ARE AN ASSET

Bilingual in English and French.
Certification such as PCP or CPM from the Canadian Payroll Association.
Dayforce experience.
Experience in a unionized environment.

WHAT DOES DIVERSITY MEAN TO US
We are committed to building a team where exceptional leadership shines, and our crew thrives both at work and at home. We believe that deliberate steps such as creating a workplace that is physically and psychologically safe, equitable to all, and actively and diligently taking steps along the path to reconciliation are the keys to making this a reality.
OUR VALUES:
We prioritize genuine concern and compassion for everyone we engage with, from our team members to our partners and guests, always striving to help and support one another.
We actively seek diverse perspectives in our decision-making and collaboratively tackle challenges.
We work together with trust and transparency, supporting one another to achieve the collective goals of our organization.
We grow, evolve, and adapt with purpose, continually aligning our actions with our vision.
We embrace curiosity and boldly challenge the status quo, exploring new opportunities and taking thoughtful, responsible risks that drive purposeful innovation.

title: Semantic Model and Cube Developer at Mississauga, ON (Hybrid)

Role: Semantic Model and Cube Developer

Location: Mississauga, ON (3 Days hybrid)

Contract

Responsibilities:

Semantic Model and Cube Development

  • Translate banking and financial-reporting requirements into scalable analytical models.

  • Develop and maintain MDX calculations and cube components where multidimensional SSAS is used.
  • Create governed and reusable semantic layers that support multiple reports, dashboards, analytical products, and business functions.
  • Assess existing cube and semantic-model designs and recommend improvements to scalability, maintainability, usability, and performance.

Data Modelling and Architecture

  • Design logical and physical data models using dimensional modelling principles.
  • Develop star and snowflake schemas, including fact tables, dimension tables, hierarchies, keys, and relationships.
  • Work with enterprise data warehouses, data marts, operational data stores, and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Define appropriate model granularity, aggregation strategies, relationship behaviour, and data-access patterns.
  • Assist with modernizing legacy cubes and reporting models into Power BI or modern tabular semantic models.
  • Ensure semantic models maintain consistent business definitions across reports and consuming applications.
  • Maintain clear data lineage between source systems, data-transformation layers, semantic models, and reports.

Power BI Development

  • Develop Power BI reports and dashboards based on governed semantic models.
  • Build complex and reusable DAX measures to support financial, operational, risk, regulatory, and management reporting.
  • Use Power Query and M to clean, transform, and integrate data from multiple sources.
  • Configure import, DirectQuery, composite, or live-connection solutions based on business and technical requirements.
  • Implement drill-down, drill-through, hierarchies, bookmarks, tooltips, and other analytical capabilities where required.
  • Publish and manage semantic models and reports within Power BI Service.
  • Configure and troubleshoot scheduled refreshes, gateways, connections, permissions, and deployment activities.
  • Support controlled promotion of models and reports across development, testing, UAT, and production environments.

Performance Optimization

  • Optimize semantic models, DAX calculations, SQL queries, relationships, and data-refresh processes.
  • Analyze slow-running reports and queries and identify model, DAX, storage, or source-system bottlenecks.
  • Improve model performance through appropriate schema design, cardinality management, aggregations, partitioning, incremental refresh, and efficient calculation logic.
  • Optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, views, indexes, and data-extraction processes supporting semantic models.
  • Monitor model size, refresh duration, query response time, capacity usage, and report performance.
  • Resolve production issues related to model processing, refresh failures, data latency, security, and report performance.


Requirements:

  • Minimum 7 years of overall experience in business intelligence, data warehousing, analytics, data modelling, or reporting development.
  • Demonstrated professional experience within the banking or financial-services industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing and developing enterprise Power BI semantic models.
  • Strong experience with SSAS Tabular, Azure Analysis Services, or a comparable enterprise tabular modelling platform.
  • Experience with SSAS Multidimensional or OLAP cube development is strongly preferred and may be mandatory if the existing environment uses multidimensional cubes.
  • Advanced expertise in DAX, including complex measures, filter context, row context, time intelligence, and performance optimization.
  • Strong working knowledge of MDX, particularly where legacy or multidimensional cubes are involved.
  • Advanced SQL and T-SQL development skills.
  • Strong experience in dimensional modelling, including star and snowflake schemas.
  • Experience developing fact tables, dimensions, hierarchies, measures, relationships, and calculation logic.
  • Strong Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service experience.
  • Experience with Power Query and M-based data transformation.
  • Experience with enterprise data warehouses and data marts.
  • Experience with ETL or ELT technologies such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience implementing data security, including row-level security and role-based access.
  • Experience optimizing models, DAX, SQL, refresh processes, and report performance.
  • Strong data-validation, reconciliation, testing, and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into robust technical and data-model designs.
  • Strong stakeholder-management, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Must be located in Canada or authorized and available to work in Canada, subject to the client’s engagement requirements.

title: AI Product Builder (Game)
description:
With over 8 billion downloads and 200+ games in our portfolio, we at SayGames think big. We don’t believe in bureaucracy or complex vertical structures—but we do believe in people and creative freedom. Our approach has propelled us into the top 3 publishers worldwide, and we have no plans to slow down.

We are a data-driven company, relying on analytics, cutting-edge technologies, and expertise. But our true secret lies in our people—their boldness and experience allow us to push boundaries, experiment, make mistakes, set trends, and uncover the secrets of success.

We’re looking for a AI Product Builder to join our internal studio and help us explore new game ideas through fast prototyping, gameplay experiments, and rapid product iterations.

Responsibilities

  • Explore promising game ideas, research the mobile gaming market, and experiment with different mechanics.
  • Independently create 2D and 3D games using AI tools, covering game design, coding, art, and UI.
  • Quickly turn ideas into high-quality playable prototypes. Our target is around one prototype per week.
  • Discuss results with the R&D team, improve promising ideas, and prepare projects for testing.
  • Take part in the further development of successful games, depending on your experience and interests.

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience in creating games with AI. You can use AI tools not just for individual tasks, but to build complete games independently.
  • A portfolio of finished games or high-quality prototypes. Your games don't need to be published on the App Store or Google Play. Playable web versions are also welcome. What matters is that they feel like complete games, not just technical demos.
  • Understanding of the mobile gaming market. You follow new releases, know current genres and mechanics, and understand what kinds of ideas can attract players.
  • Ability to work independently. You can come up with ideas, make decisions, and complete projects without constant guidance.
  • Willingness to experiment. You understand that not every prototype will move forward, can accept feedback, and are ready to explore new ideas.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in game design, especially working with game mechanics, tutorials, and difficulty balancing.
  • Understanding of game analytics and product metrics.
  • Experience in independently releasing games or developing projects beyond the prototype stage.

Conditions

  • Hybrid work format — cozy offices in Limassol, Paphos, or Warsaw. Remote work is up for discussion
  • Flexible schedule — work at your own pace as long as you stay in touch with the team and get things done on time
  • Support for self-development — free English classes, conference and course reimbursements
  • Health benefits — medical insurance for you and your family, plus a sports allowance
  • Top-tier equipment — we’ll set you up with the best devices for a smooth workflow
  • Team-building trips across our office locations and beyond, from sunny Cyprus to Poland’s lakes, rivers, forests, and mountains.

title: Manager, Royalties
description:
Manager, Royalties

DEPARTMENT: Royalties, Tracking & Business Intelligence

TEAM: Royalties - Data Processing

LOCATION: London (5th Floor, Goldings House, Hays Galleria, 2 Hay's Lane, London, SE1 2HB, United Kingdom) - Hybrid [3 days a week in office]

REPORTING TO: George Wroodgate - Senior Manager, Royalties

Joining the growing Royalties team in our London office, the Royalties Manager will head up the Data Processing (DP) team. You will play a crucial role in managing the ingestion of royalty statements from societies, sub-publishers, direct licensees, and flow-through into our bespoke in-house rights management software.

This role requires a detail-oriented, highly analytical leader who can confidently oversee the Identification process—combining technical and manual methods to accurately match incoming royalties to works, right types, exploitation dates, territories, revenue sources, audio-visuals, and sub-accounts. You will navigate incoming queries, new process requests, oversee bespoke ingestion and identification for non-standard sources, and ensure high accuracy through rigorous scheduled quarterly QC tasks while constantly iterating and improving on existing workflows.

The Role

Joining the growing Royalties team in our London office, the Royalties Manager will head up the Data Processing (DP) team. You will play a crucial role in managing the ingestion of royalty statements from societies, sub-publishers, direct licensees, and flow-through into our bespoke in-house rights management software.

This role requires a detail-oriented, highly analytical leader who can confidently oversee the Identification process—combining technical and manual methods to accurately match incoming royalties to works, right types, exploitation dates, territories, revenue sources, audio-visuals, and sub-accounts. You will navigate incoming queries, new process requests, oversee bespoke ingestion and identification for non-standard sources, and ensure high accuracy through rigorous scheduled quarterly QC tasks while constantly iterating and improving on existing workflows.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

  • Team Leadership & Oversight: Manage, develop, and support the Data Processing team responsible for royalty statement ingestion and complex identification processes.
  • Statement Ingestion: Oversee the ingestion of royalty statements from diverse sources including societies, sub-publishers, direct licensees, and flow-through into our proprietary royalty processing software.
  • Identification & Matching: Lead the work identification processes, utilising both technical and manual methods to accurately match incoming royalties to works, right types (radio, streaming, performance, mechanical), exploitation dates, territories, revenue sources, audio-visuals, and sub-accounts.
  • Bespoke Processing: Design and execute custom ingestion and identification processesfor sources that do not adhere to standard formats or normal processes.
  • Quality Control: Execute a large volume of scheduled QC tasks throughout the quarter to check and maintain the highest accuracy of the team's work.
  • Process Improvement: Constantly review, iterate, and improve upon existing ingestion and identification processes to maximize efficiency and keep up to date with changing industry standards.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Interpret and communicate information received from various stakeholders (Copyright, Tech, Client Relations) to ensure processing methods are altered when necessary.
  • Ad-Hoc Query Resolution: Efficiently manage and resolve ad-hoc queries and process requests from internal teams and external partners, ensuring timely and clear communication.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation for all data processing workflows, ingestion rules, and quality control procedures.
  • Team Training & Upskilling: Lead training initiatives to continually upskill team members on new tools, system updates, and changing industry standards.

What You’ll Bring

Essential:

  • Data & Analytics: Numeracy, exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and strong analytical skills.
  • Processing Expertise: Solid understanding of music publishing, copyright & royalty processes, particularly regarding global statement ingestion and data matching.
  • Technical Proficiency: Confident Excel user (calculating percentages, manipulating large datasets using formulas and pivot tables); familiarity with rights management software.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to think of improvements to existing tools and processes to continually enhance what we do to achieve our goals.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills with experience communicating to a wide-ranging audience of varying seniority, skill, and knowledge.

Preferred:

  • People Management: Experience in supervising, managing, and motivating team members.
  • SQL Skills: Background and knowledge of SQL or other domain-specific languages used in programming is preferred.

Additional Skills That Could Add Value

  • Solutions-orientated and adaptable to change.
  • Track-record of excellent organization & prioritisation skills working under high pressure and to tight deadlines.
  • Uses initiative to problem-solve.
  • Positive, determined attitude.
  • Empathetic, open, and honest.
  • Confident in decision-making and own abilities.

Key Behaviours for Success

  • Leads and develops others: Sets clear expectations, coaches with empathy, shares knowledge and holds the team accountable for quality and delivery.
  • Takes ownership of accuracy and outcomes: Prioritises effectively, applies rigorous quality checks and resolves issues promptly to meet processing deadlines.
  • Challenges and improves processes: Uses data and initiative to identify root causes, simplify workflows and implement practical improvements, adapting as requirements change.
  • Collaborates and communicates clearly: Builds effective relationships across teams, translates complex information into clear actions and keeps stakeholders informed of progress, risks and decisions.

Interview Process

  • Introductory call with a member of our Recruitment Team
  • Interview with the hiring manager
  • Interview with relevant members of the Royalties team
  • Final stage interview
  • Feedback at each stage

We aim to complete the full interview process from initial application to offer within three working weeks. While we do our best to meet this timeline, there may be occasional delays. If that happens, our Recruitment Team will keep you updated every step of the way.

Benefits

Kobalt Music Group Employee Benefits from Day 1

  • Annual Leave: Contractually 25 days, however Kobalt closes its offices for the 3 days between Christmas and New Year’s when staff contribute 1 day.
  • Life Assurance: Equal to four (4) times base salary.
  • Income Protection: Covers up to 75% of base salary up to the age of 65.
  • Travel Insurance: Business travel insurance cover.
  • Gym Membership: Corporate rates available at Nuffield Health and Fitness First. Kobalt will subsidise £45.00 per month towards your corporate gym membership if your membership is processed through company payroll.
  • Eyecare: Full eye test provided at a range of opticians through a voucher scheme.
  • Wellbeing: Wellbeing Hub and Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Food & Drink: Fresh fruit, selection of snacks and cereal supplied.
  • Regular Socials: Including seasonal social events and parties.

Post Probationay Period Benefits

  • Pension: Kobalt’s pension scheme is currently with Aviva. On passing probation, staff can select to move to salary sacrifice and benefit from a 2.5% - 5% company matched contribution.
  • Private Medical Insurance: Policy is with the AVIVA ‘select’ scheme.
  • Travel Insurance: Personal travel insurance, individual or family cover.
  • Interest Free Season Ticket Loan: (eligible after 1 month of service) Loans deducted from net pay over a 12-month period.
  • Cycle to Work Scheme: In partnership with Evans Cycles.

Why Choose Us

At Kobalt, we’ve championed creators since 2000. Our technology and music services are built to make the industry more transparent, fair and rewarding for artists, songwriters and rights holders. We’re proud to work with some of the world’s most influential talents including Phoebe Bridgers, Sam Fender, Paul McCartney, Foo Fighters, Karol G, Young Thug, Kali Uchis, FINNEAS and Andrew Watt, as well as acclaimed writers like Simon Aldred (Rag’n’Bone Man, Liam Gallagher, Celeste) and Clarence Coffee Jr. (Dua Lipa, Lizzo, The Snuts).

We’re a company that thrives on creativity, collaboration and progress. Our values — Music First, Transparent, Tech Powered and Transformative — shape how we work, build and grow together. We are a community of people who care deeply about making a meaningful impact in music and technology.

Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in equitable access to opportunities and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and supportive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

If this sounds like you, then please share your story by filling out the application below.

Important Notice

Applicants must be eligible to work in the United Kingdom. A full DBS check will be conducted on acceptance of the offer. Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status or characteristic protected by law.

title: Energy Recovery System Student Placement
description:
Job Title: ERS Student Placement
Location: On-site in Concord, NCDate of Placement: 2027
Drive the Future of Formula 1 with GMPPU!
Job Summary:
We’re seeking a motivated engineering student to join our ERS (Energy Recovery System) Team in Concord, NC for an industrial placement year. As an ERS Student Placement, you will work alongside experienced engineers on real power unit projects, developing hands-on skills in electrical machines, power electronics, energy storage, and data analysis while contributing to the performance of a Formula 1 power unit.
This is a structured development role within the ERS Team. Your primary focus is delivering defined engineering projects with guidance from a named mentor, supporting analysis, testing and documentation across ERS. You will have the opportunity to rotate through ERS disciplines and support the wider team with data processing, test preparation and engineering tools.

Key Responsibilities
ERS Team Projects (Primary)

Own a defined ERS project for the placement year, agreed with your mentor, with clear deliverables, milestones and regular progress reviews aligned to power unit program gates.
Process and analyze dyno, bench and simulation data, producing clear digestible results, summaries and recommendations for the ERS Team.
Develop and maintain Python and MATLAB/Simulink tools that automate data handling, reporting and model-based analysis.
Assist with test preparation and execution, including instrumentation setup, test plans and post-test reports, under the supervision of experienced engineers.
Support thermal, electrical and mechanical investigations across the MGU, CU-K and energy store, helping engineers understand performance and durability limits.
Contribute to design reviews, risk assessments (FMEA) and verification planning, learning how technical gates and evidence are managed on a power unit program.
Follow HV safety, quality and document control practices at all times, and comply with FIA F1 rules and company confidentiality requirements.
Additional tasks as needed.

Team Support and Development (Secondary)

Rotate through ERS disciplines (e-machine, power electronics, energy store, and controls and software) to build broad system-level understanding.
Support hardware build, bring-up and test activities in the lab and workshop, working safely alongside technicians and engineers.
Document work clearly, including test reports, analysis notes and project updates, and present results to the ERS Team at the end of the placement.
Take part in team meetings, training sessions and trackside or dyno debriefs as appropriate to your level of experience.

Required Qualifications

Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field, and eligible to complete a placement of around 12 months.
Solid grounding in engineering fundamentals, including electrical machines, power electronics, thermodynamics, controls, or data analysis relevant to electrified powertrains.
Working proficiency in at least one of Python or MATLAB/Simulink, with the ability to analyze data and present clear results.
Strong communication and teamwork skills, attention to detail, and the discipline to handle confidential information and work safely in a high-voltage environment.

Desirable Skills

Practical experience from Formula Student, university motorsport, or personal engineering projects such as builds, testing and rapid prototyping.
Exposure to motor control, battery systems, thermal modeling, CAD, or lab instrumentation and data acquisition.
Curiosity about FIA F1 power unit regulations, a drive to learn quickly, and the ability to thrive in a high-pressure, fast-moving team.

Personal Attributes

Strong communication and teamwork skills, collaborating effectively with engineers, technicians and mentors across ERS disciplines.
Attention to detail and rigor in analysis, testing and documentation.
Discipline in handling confidential information and working safely in a high-voltage environment.
Curiosity and a drive to learn quickly, with the ability to thrive in a high-pressure, fast-moving team.

Physical Requirements

Ability to stand, walk, and move in diverse operational environments, including race shops, arenas, and commercial facilities.
Comfortable working in variable environmental conditions, including loud, high-traffic, or high-pressure environments.

Why Join Us: You’ll help support a team developing a next-generation Formula 1 power unit, working alongside professionals who value precision, creativity, and a constant drive to improve. Placement students will have the unique opportunity to work on a team poised to showcase American engineering excellence on the global Formula 1 stage. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a competitive and comprehensive package designed to support your performance, well-being, and future, helping you thrive at every level.
That includes access to:

Private healthcare
401(k) plan including company match
Employer-paid life insurance and disability coverage
32 days annual leave (including holidays)
Free financial advisor access
Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
Subsidized on-site dining
On-site gym
Free on-site EV charging for personal GM vehicles

Drive the Future of Motorsport with GMPPU!At GMPPU, we’re not just building power units - we’re shaping the future of Formula 1 technology. Our culture of collaboration fuels creativity and innovation, empowering you to make a real impact on the track. Every idea counts, every breakthrough matters, and every team member contributes to our competitive edge.

If you’re passionate about electrification and motorsport and ready to apply your studies to real power unit performance, this is your chance to join a high-energy, cutting-edge team on a mission to dominate the grid. Your journey to F1 starts here! Apply today and become part of something extraordinary.

For more information regarding the EEOC, please visit https://www.eeoc.gov/employers/upload/poster_screen_reader_optimized.pdf.

title: Afstudeerstage Commerciële Strategie & Marktanalyse DIY Garden
description:
Bij Brand Masters zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste afstudeerstagiair(e) Commerciële Strategie & Marktanalyse voor onze vestiging in Breda. We zijn ambitieus, internationaal en volop in beweging. Wil jij onderzoeken waar de grootste commerciële groeikansen liggen binnen de Europese bouwmarkt- en tuincentrumbranche en met jouw onderzoek direct impact maken op onze groeistrategie én kans maken om bij ons te blijven werken? Dan is deze afstudeerstage iets voor jou!

Jouw functie

Als afstudeerstagiair(e) ga je aan de slag met een strategisch commercieel vraagstuk dat direct bijdraagt aan de verdere groei van Brand Masters binnen Europa.

Brand Masters breidt haar activiteiten uit binnen het DIY & Garden-kanaal. Binnen bouwmarkten en tuincentra zien wij kansen voor FMCG-producten zoals frisdranken, energiedranken, snacks en huishoudelijke producten. Aan jou de uitdaging om te onderzoeken welke landen, retailers en productcategorieën de grootste commerciële potentie bieden.

Je combineert marktonderzoek met praktijkervaring en vertaalt jouw inzichten naar een concreet groeiplan waarmee Brand Masters haar positie binnen de Europese markt verder kan versterken.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Wanneer je je aansluit bij Brand Masters, dan mag je uiteraard ook het één en ander van ons verwachten:

  • Een uitdagende afstudeeropdracht met directe impact op onze Europese groeistrategie;

  • Een stagevergoeding van €0,25;

  • Woon-werkverkeer vergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer;

  • Intensieve begeleiding door ervaren commerciële professionals;

  • Veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid, initiatief en eigen onderzoek;

  • De mogelijkheid om praktijkervaring op te doen binnen een internationale FMCG-organisatie;

  • Een moderne, nieuwe en lichte werkplek in Breda waar ook ons warehouse gevestigd is;

  • Gratis gebruik van onze sportschool op locatie;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen Brand Masters na afronding van jouw studie.

Wat ga je doen?

Tijdens deze afstudeerstage ga je aan de slag met het onderzoeken van commerciële groeikansen binnen de Europese bouwmarkt- en tuincentrumbranche. Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Analyseren van de Europese markt en de belangrijkste bouwmarkt- en tuincentrumretailers;

  • Onderzoeken van FMCG-assortimenten, merken en verschillen tussen landen;

  • Uitvoeren van winkelbezoeken en schapanalyses;

  • Voeren van gesprekken met relevante marktpartijen;

  • Identificeren van commerciële kansen en kansrijke productcategorieën;

  • In kaart brengen van potentiële klanten en groeimarkten binnen Europa;

  • Vertalen van onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete commerciële aanbevelingen;

  • Ontwikkelen van een groeistrategie en presenteren van jouw bevindingen aan collega's en management.

Is er naast jouw onderzoek ruimte of ben je nieuwsgierig naar de praktijk? Dan krijg je de mogelijkheid om mee te draaien binnen commerciële projecten en klanttrajecten.

Jouw profiel

Wij zoeken een enthousiaste hbo-student met een commerciële instelling en een onderzoekende mindset:

  • Je volgt een hbo-opleiding in een commerciële richting, zoals Commerciële Economie, International Business, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare studie;

  • Je bent op zoek naar een afstudeerstage;

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en ondernemend;

  • Je vindt het leuk om markten, retailers en commerciële kansen te onderzoeken;

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd;

  • Je weet inzichten en analyses te vertalen naar concrete aanbevelingen;

  • Je communiceert gemakkelijk en voelt je comfortabel in een internationale omgeving;

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed;

  • Je vindt het leuk om op pad te gaan en zelf informatie op te halen bij marktpartijen.

Jouw team

Wanneer je aan de slag gaat als Afstudeerstagiair Commerciële Strategie & Marktanalyse, werk je nauw samen met onze commerciële organisatie.

Je krijgt begeleiding van ervaren collega's die actief zijn binnen internationale sales, business development en category management. Hierdoor krijg je niet alleen de kans om een waardevol onderzoek uit te voeren, maar leer je ook hoe commerciële strategie, retail en merken samenkomen binnen een internationale FMCG-organisatie.

Je werkt in een ondernemende omgeving waarin initiatief, samenwerking en groei centraal staan.

Ons bedrijf

Brand Masters is een internationale B2B-leverancier van bekende A-merken en private labels aan non-foodretailers. Van Coca-Cola en Red Bull tot producten binnen Food, Drinks en Home Care: wij brengen sterke merken naar plekken waar je ze niet direct verwacht.

Met meer dan 250 collega's werken we dagelijks aan commerciële kansen en nieuwe samenwerkingen. Onze cultuur kenmerkt zich door ondernemerschap, korte lijnen en samen de handen uit de mouwen steken.

Wij ontwikkelen en verkopen innovatieve concepten voor zowel food als non-food en verbinden merken en retailers op slimme, onderscheidende manieren. Door onze unieke aanpak creëren we duurzame groei: category growth voor retailers én nieuwe afzetkanalen voor fabrikanten.

The right product, at the right place, at the right time: dat is waar Brand Masters voor staat.

Sinds onze start in 2012 zijn we uitgegroeid tot een energieke en snelgroeiende organisatie met vestigingen in Breda, Hamburg, Wroclaw en Parijs.

Brand Masters is ambitieus, internationaal en volop in beweging. Word jij onderdeel van ons team?

title: Professional Services Consultant - India
description: Professional Services Consultant - India The Consultant role exists to help customers turn business priorities into scalable solutions, measurable outcomes, and faster time to value. The role independently drives cross- functional customer and technical workstreams; shapes, delivers across business and technical domains, strengthens solution and delivery decisions; and delivers quality from discovery through transition to support. It requires and applies recognized subject-matter depth in either business and industry consulting or technical and integration delivery, with working breadth across. The role operates on strong consulting methods, reusable assets, approved job level and team capability does not redefine its ownership, autonomy, scope, or complexity. In this role you will… Conduct discovery and workshops; document outcomes, processes, requirements, use cases, decisions, assumptions, and acceptance criteria. Configure and validate product capabilities; support data, integrations, migration, identity, reporting, testing, cutover, training, and handover activities. Analyze issues across business process and technology boundaries; perform structured troubleshooting and coordinate resolution. Prepare demonstrations, functional and technical documentation, test scenarios, readiness evidence, and customer enablement materials. Maintain delivery artifacts, communicate status and risks, and contribute to estimates, change requests, reusable assets, and lessons learned. Own the end-to-end connection between customer outcomes, business processes, product capabilities, data, integrations, migration, security, testing, adoption, and operational readiness. Maintain working capability across both functional and technical domains. Apply deeper expertise as either a business and industry SME or a technical and integration SME without becoming limited to that specialization. For a business/industry specialization: bring strong market understanding, cross-industry use cases, operating-model insight, process expertise, value framing, adoption, and outcome design beyond product features. For a technical/integration specialization: solve complex architecture, integration, data, migration, identity, performance, security, troubleshooting, and critical delivery scenarios. Translate between executives, business owners, administrators, architects, developers, partners, and delivery teams using clear, outcome-oriented language. Apply business, market, and industry knowledge to understand customer priorities, use cases, processes, constraints, and expected outcomes, and reflect that context in recommendations and delivery decisions. Analyze new information and dynamically adjust discovery, solution recommendations, workstream plans, risk responses, and adoption actions within assigned scope. title: Director, Grounds & Campus Services
description:
The Director, Grounds & Campus Services is a non-union, full-time, salaried position grade 10 with an expected hiring range of $89,583 to $98,541 annually. Please follow the below link or copy and paste it in your internet browser to see Compensation and Benefits Summary.

Non-Union Full-Time Employees benefits overview

The Director, Grounds & Campus Services provides strategic and operational leadership for the stewardship, performance, presentation, and long-term evolution of Brookfield Zoo Chicago's exterior campus. Reporting to the Vice President, Risk & Facilities Management and leading through managers responsible for Grounds Operations and Horticulture & Landscape Strategy, the Director establishes the vision, standards, priorities, resources, and accountability necessary to maintain an exceptional campus today while shaping its landscape for the future.

The Director is responsible for the integration of large-scale grounds operations and professional horticultural strategy across a complex, 365-day public campus. The position ensures safe, reliable, and efficient daily operations while advancing landscape quality, sustainability, ecological practices, campus aesthetics, and long-term stewardship in support of the Zoo's mission and Next Century Plan.

As a senior departmental leader, the Director serves as the institutional authority for grounds operations and a key strategic leader for landscape and horticultural planning, partnering with key departments across the organization to ensure the Zoo's exterior environment is operationally excellent, visually compelling, sustainable, and maintainable.

PRIMARY JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

1. * Grounds Operations & Campus Readiness

Provide strategic and operational leadership for the care, condition, safety, and readiness of Brookfield Zoo Chicago's (BZC’s) exterior campus. Through the Manager, Grounds Operations, establish standards and priorities for grounds maintenance, turf and lawn care, roads, walkways and exterior hardscape, exterior campus cleanup, snow and ice removal, heavy equipment operations, event preparation and recovery, and other grounds-related services.
Establish service standards, inspection practices, performance measures, and operating expectations that ensure grounds, landscapes, pathways, public spaces, and exterior facilities consistently contribute to a safe, welcoming, and exceptional guest experience.

Ensure effective planning and deployment of personnel, equipment, and resources across a large campus with changing seasonal, weather, event, and operational demands.

2. * Horticulture & Landscape Strategy

Provide strategic leadership for BZC's horticulture and landscape program. Through the Manager, Horticulture & Landscape Strategy, establish direction and professional standards for horticultural strategy and execution, plant collections, landscape standards, arboriculture and tree care, plant health, greenhouse and nursery operations, irrigation strategy, biodiversity, ecological landscape practices, and animal browse support.

Advance long-range strategies that enhance the quality, sustainability, resiliency, diversity, and visual impact of the Zoo's living landscape while ensuring that landscape standards are practical, maintainable, and effectively integrated with grounds operations.

Oversee the Zoo's arboretum accreditation/certification activities and the strategic management and care of the campus tree collection.

3. * Strategic Campus & Landscape Vision

Establish and advance a long-term vision for the Zoo's landscape and exterior campus environment, considering how landscapes, plantings, pathways, gathering spaces, ecological systems, infrastructure, and other elements of the public realm work together to create a cohesive and memorable Brookfield Zoo Chicago experience.

Bring a forward-looking campus-design perspective to planning and decision-making, balancing ambitious landscape and guest-experience objectives with operational requirements, sustainability, lifecycle considerations, and long-term maintainability.

Translate institutional priorities and the Next Century Plan into actionable grounds, horticulture, and landscape strategies.

4. * Workforce Leadership & Organizational Performance

Lead, coach, and develop managers and other reporting staff, establishing clear expectations for leadership, communication, performance, safety, quality, service, and accountability.

Ensure managers and supervisors have the direction, tools, training, and support necessary to effectively lead their teams and deliver consistent results. Foster a workplace culture characterized by professionalism, collaboration, inclusion, mutual respect, continuous improvement, and pride in the Zoo and its campus.

Evaluate organizational structure, staffing deployment, schedules, work practices, supervisory coverage, and resource requirements to ensure people and resources are appropriately aligned with institutional priorities and operational needs.

5. * Labor Relations & Union Partnership

Provide knowledgeable and consistent leadership within a unionized operating environment and support constructive, professional labor-management relationships.

Partner closely with People & Culture to administer applicable collective bargaining agreements consistently and appropriately, including matters related to staffing, scheduling, overtime, work assignments, employee performance, corrective action, grievances, and other labor-related matters.

Ensure managers and supervisors understand their responsibilities under applicable collective bargaining agreements and organizational policies and have the training and support necessary to manage represented employees consistently, respectfully, and effectively.

Ensure required contractual notifications and processes are followed when utilizing contractors or implementing operational changes affecting represented work.

6.* Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

Establish meaningful performance standards and measures for Grounds & Campus Services, including quality, work completion, response, resource utilization, campus condition, and other relevant operational indicators.

Use the Zoo's work-order systems, inspections, operating data, and management reporting to understand workload, establish priorities, allocate resources, identify recurring issues, and support informed decision-making.

Lead continuous improvement efforts that strengthen service quality, operational effectiveness, coordination, planning, and the responsible use of institutional resources.

7. * Snow, Ice, Severe Weather & Emergency Operations

Provide leadership and accountability for comprehensive snow, ice, severe-weather, and other grounds-related emergency operations.

Ensure appropriate response plans, staffing protocols, equipment readiness, training, campus priorities, and operating standards are established and effectively executed.

Partner across Risk & Facilities and other departments to ensure coordinated response to storms, fallen trees, flooding, campus access issues, and other conditions affecting exterior campus safety and operations.

8. * Equipment, Fleet & Grounds Infrastructure

Provide strategic oversight of equipment, vehicles, tools, irrigation systems, and other infrastructure and resources necessary to effectively operate and maintain the exterior campus.

Establish long-range equipment and resource plans, including lifecycle, replacement, maintenance, training, and capital requirements. Partner with Facilities Operations and other departments on shared equipment, infrastructure, and maintenance needs.

9. * Campus Planning, Design & Capital Projects

Serve as a key institutional partner and subject-matter leader for grounds, landscape, and horticultural considerations in campus planning and capital development.

Partner closely with Projects & Planning, Brand Experience & Design, Animal Care and Programs, and other stakeholders, as well as external landscape architects, architects, engineers, designers, and contractors, from project programming and concept development through design, construction, turnover, and ongoing stewardship.

Provide strategic and operational input regarding landscape design, horticulture, grounds operations, irrigation, tree impacts, site access, equipment requirements, sustainability, and long-term maintainability.

Ensure new projects are designed and transitioned in a manner that supports exceptional experiences at opening and sustainable, effective operations throughout their lifecycle.

10. Next Century Plan Implementation

Support implementation of the Next Century Plan by translating its campus vision into grounds, landscape, horticultural, and stewardship priorities.

Anticipate how campus transformation will affect grounds operations, horticulture, staffing, equipment, irrigation, plant collections, landscape maintenance, and long-term resource requirements.

Develop appropriate operating standards, resource plans, and stewardship strategies to support the successful transition and ongoing care of new landscapes and exterior campus assets.

11. Sustainability & Ecological Stewardship

Advance sustainable and ecologically responsible grounds and landscape practices consistent with Brookfield Zoo Chicago's conservation mission.

Provide leadership for sustainable landscape management, biodiversity, water stewardship, irrigation efficiency, soil health, appropriate plant selection, ecological landscape practices, integrated pest management, and climate-resilient landscapes.

Identify opportunities for the Zoo's landscape and grounds practices to demonstrate responsible environmental stewardship and strengthen connections among conservation, campus operations, and the guest experience.

12. Budget, Contracts & Resource Planning

Develop, manage, and control operating budgets for Grounds & Campus Services. Establish long-range staffing, equipment, fleet, materials, and landscape infrastructure requirements and incorporate those needs into annual and long-range planning.

Evaluate the appropriate use of internal employees, seasonal resources, volunteers, and contracted services consistent with operational requirements, institutional policies, procurement procedures, and applicable collective bargaining agreements.

Develop and/or oversee specifications and scopes for contracted grounds and landscape services; participate in procurement and contractor selection; and ensure appropriate standards for contractor quality, safety, schedule, and performance.

13. Perform other related duties as assigned.

*Denotes Essential Job Function(s)

POSITION REQUIREMENTS AND SPECIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Horticulture, Landscape Architecture, Landscape Management, Grounds Management, Environmental Design, Facilities/Campus Management, Business Administration, or a related field, or eight years’ equivalent combination of education , and/or relevant experience. High school diploma or educational equivalent (e.g., GED.) required.
Minimum of eight years of progressively responsible experience leading grounds, landscape, horticulture, campus services, or comparable operations within a large, complex campus or public-facing organization, including significant responsibility for people, budgets, operational performance, and long-range planning.
Minimum of five years of management experience, including responsibility for managers and/or supervisors and a substantial operational workforce.
Proven track record of leading unionized workforces while ensuring strict compliance with complex Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA’s) including demonstrated experience effectively managing labor relations, employee performance, grievances, scheduling, overtime, and other workforce matters.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale grounds operations, including workforce and resource deployment, landscape and turf maintenance, equipment, snow and ice operations, severe-weather response, and exterior campus readiness.
Demonstrated knowledge of professional horticulture, landscape management, and sustainable campus stewardship sufficient to provide strategic leadership to specialized horticultural professionals.
Demonstrated ability to think strategically about campus landscapes and public spaces, with a strong appreciation for landscape architecture, environmental design, and the relationship between landscape, operations, conservation, and guest experience.
Experience working effectively with landscape architects, architects, engineers, contractors, designers, and multidisciplinary internal teams on significant campus or capital projects.
Demonstrated ability to establish performance expectations, use operational information to inform decisions, improve processes and resource deployment, and drive improvements in quality and service.
Strong financial management skills, including operating budgets, equipment and resource planning, contracting, and long-range planning.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship-management, conflict-resolution, organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead organizational and operational change while maintaining effective relationships and continuity of operations.

Demonstrated capacity to foster an inclusive environment and collaborate effectively across diverse, multicultural communities. Ability to maintain confidential information.
English fluency at full professional proficiency required.

This position is responsible for providing excellent on-site pool cleaning and pool maintenance services to each and every customer they are assigned. This includes following our proven pool cleaning methods and handling pool chemicals in a controlled and safe manner. This position is also responsible for diagnosing issues with the swimming pool equipment and providing solutions. This includes following our proven process for diagnosing issues, successfully communicating alternative solutions to the customer, completing the solution in an efficient manner and following all established protocols and sharing lessons learned with the rest of our team.
The ideal person for this position will love to work outdoors. They will be a self-­ starter who has the ability to work independently with minimal oversight and guidance. They will handle all matters with integrity and embrace the concept and requirements of delivering "resort-quality service".
Responsibilities:
Success in this position will be determined by the following measurable results:
  • Manage a swimming pool route that includes cleaning of swimming pools each week and manage a daily schedule of equipment repair tasks;
  • The ability to manage a stocking of chemicals on the truck and properly adjust the water chemistry for each pool each week.
  • Repair of pool pumps, heaters, filters, timers, pool cleaners, blowers, lights, automated pool systems, chlorinators, backwash valves, PVC plumbing, copper plumbing, and galvanized plumbing
  • Knowledge of 110 volt and 220 volt electrical equipment (preferred, not required)

  • The ability to utilize a smart phone for our Pool Ops mobile platform.
  • The ability to spot opportunities outside of the repair call, such as upgrading other equipment or adding to the customer experience with other products.
  • Renovation experience – Re-plaster or equivalent (e.g., PebbleTech®), tile replacement/repair, deck texture/seal, pavers install/repair (preferred, not required)
We are specifically looking for an individual who demonstrates these behaviors consistent with the ASP way of doing business (our culture and values):
  • Acting with Integrity;
  • Superior Knowledge;
  • Passion for the Company;
  • Customer Focus;
  • Accountability and Discipline;
  • Respecting Others;
  • Excellence in ALL we do; and
  • Safety First at all Times.

No other specific experience is required as we will teach you the ASP methods designed to give our customers superior value and to maximize your earning potential; however, a high school degree and Certified Pool Operator License is preferred.
Bonus Potential:
This position has the potential of earning an annual bonus by the company when specific gross revenue goals are met for the year.
Benefits:
A company truck will be provided which you keep fully stocked with tools and inventory. You will receive paid vacation time following a qualifying period.
Next Steps:
If you are interested in being considered for this position and joining our award-winning team, then we would encourage you to apply for this position.
We look forward to learning more about you as you go through our hiring process.

title: Senior GCP Cloud Engineer

  • Affiancare e formare i colleghi del team interno su processi e strumenti del PSN.


Requisiti

  • Esperienza pregressa nell'avvio o nella migrazione di clienti su PSN, preferibilmente utilizzando i servizi Google Cloud.
  • Solida esperienza su Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Ottima conoscenza di Terraform e dell'approccio Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Esperienza in contesti DevOps e di Continuous Delivery.
  • Autonomia nella gestione di attività tecniche e capacità di trasferire competenze al team.


Nice to have

Cosa offriamo?

  • Contratto a tempo indeterminato.
  • Formazione continua su hard e soft skills.
  • Follow-up costante con HR e Business Manager.
  • Un percorso di crescita chiaro e strutturato in un ambiente innovativo, dinamico e internazionale.

La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla nostra società.


Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna


The world needs you

ADENTIS Italia è un equal opportunities employer: crediamo che tutte le forme di diversità siano fonte di arricchimento reciproco. Ci impegniamo a garantire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, nel quale ogni singola risorsa possa apportare un valore unico alla nostra realtà. Pertanto, accogliamo candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile.


Inoltre, teniamo fede ai nostri impegni prestando attenzione alle risorse appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli articoli 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99.

I dati personali saranno trattati in conformità alle disposizioni contenute nel regolamento UE 2016/679.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence, collaborate, and direct the work of other functional teams across organizational boundaries.

World-Class Benefits

Highlights include...

  • Medical plan options include...
    • PPO with low annual deductible and copays.
    • HDHP combined with a health savings account with a contribution from SAS (no access to on-site health care center).

title: Senior Rail Bridge Engineer
description:
GFT is seeking a Senior Rail Bridge Engineer to join our Bridge Team in Chicago or Schaumburg, Illinois. This role follows a hybrid work model, requiring regular attendance at our Chicago or Schaumburg office.

Working on the Bridge Team at GFT offers the opportunity to engage in transformative projects that enhance transportation infrastructure and improve community connectivity. Whether working on freight rail, passenger rail, transit, or highway-rail grade separations, our team excels in resilient, sustainable design and construction, delivering innovative solutions that address the complexities of modern rail infrastructure and provide safe, efficient, and reliable transportation systems.

You will have the opportunity to lead complex rail bridge projects for Class I railroads, passenger and commuter rail agencies, short-line railroads, and transportation agencies, building upon GFT's extensive rail and structural engineering experience. Projects may include assignments similar to GFT's CREATE P1 Englewood Flyover and UPRR Relocation at O'Hare, along with other major railroad bridge, grade-separation, and rail infrastructure projects.

What you’ll be challenged to do:

This position will provide senior technical and project leadership for complex rail bridge projects. The role includes structural analysis and design, bridge replacement and rehabilitation, inspection, load rating, construction support, constructability, and preparation of construction documents, specifications, quantities, and estimates.

The Senior Rail Bridge Engineer will lead complex technical assignments, establish and interpret design criteria, provide technical guidance to engineers and designers, perform quality reviews, and coordinate with multidisciplinary project teams. The successful candidate will also mentor developing engineers, interact directly with clients, and support GFT's continued growth in the rail bridge market.

Applicants must possess strong technical and leadership skills, excellent verbal and written communication skills, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to lead and collaborate effectively on multidisciplinary rail projects.

In this capacity, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:

  • Lead structural analysis and design of railroad bridges and related structures utilizing the current AREMA Manual for Railway Engineering, railroad owner standards, and other applicable design criteria.
  • Lead complex bridge replacement, rehabilitation, strengthening, inspection, and load-rating assignments involving steel, concrete, timber, masonry, and other railroad bridge systems.
  • Develop and evaluate structural concepts, bridge alternatives, rehabilitation strategies, and construction approaches based on structural performance, railroad operations, constructability, schedule, cost, and long-term maintenance.
  • Serve as Structural Lead, Design Team Leader, Project Engineer, Project Manager, or senior technical advisor, as appropriate to the assignment.
  • Lead and coordinate engineers and designers responsible for structural calculations, analyses, plans, specifications, quantities, estimates, reports, and other deliverables.
  • Lead and/or participate in bridge inspections, structural evaluations, and load ratings for railroad and highway structures.
  • Be responsible for the accuracy and technical quality of engineering designs, reports, load ratings, plans, specifications, and estimates, with conformance to project budgets, schedules, client requirements, and company standards.
  • Assure projects meet GFT quality control and quality assurance guidelines and perform detailed checking and independent technical review of work prepared by others.
  • Document and organize calculations and engineering decisions in accordance with GFT's Quality Management Plan.
  • Coordinate structural requirements with track, civil, roadway, geotechnical, hydraulic, environmental, utility, signal, communications, and construction disciplines.
  • Develop practical solutions for active railroad environments, including railroad operations, track outages, construction access, temporary works, construction sequencing, and stakeholder coordination.
  • Provide rail bridge construction support, including responses to RFIs, review of contractor submittals, resolution of field conditions, coordination of track outages, and evaluation of construction staging and temporary works.
  • Assist Project Managers with project scope, schedule, budget, staffing, technical risk, and delivery requirements, and advise management on necessary changes.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to bridge engineers and designers, supporting their technical and professional development.
  • Work directly with railroad clients, transportation agencies, contractors, and other stakeholders to identify and resolve technical issues.
  • Support development of scopes of work, staffing plans, schedules, budgets, engineering fee estimates, technical approaches, proposals, teaming strategies, and client presentations.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with Class I railroads, commuter and passenger rail agencies, short-line railroads, transportation agencies, and other rail clients.
  • Maintain professional and technical knowledge through educational workshops, professional publications, technical networks, and participation in AREMA and other relevant organizations.
  • Be willing to travel within the continental United States for project assignments, field investigations, bridge inspections, client meetings, and other project needs.

What you will bring to our firm:
  • Bachelor's degree in civil or structural engineering, with an emphasis in structures, from an ABET-accredited university or college.
  • A minimum of 12 years of professional structural engineering experience, including significant experience in railroad bridge design, rehabilitation, inspection, load rating, construction, and/or project delivery.
  • Professional Engineer license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, with the ability to obtain Illinois licensure within an agreed period following employment.
  • Significant experience applying the AREMA Manual for Railway Engineering and railroad-owner design standards.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Class I railroads, commuter or passenger railroads, transit agencies, and/or short-line railroads.
  • Experience leading complex rail bridge design, rehabilitation, rating, inspection, or construction-support assignments.
  • Strong knowledge of steel and concrete railroad bridge systems, railroad loading, fatigue, foundations, constructability, rehabilitation methods, and bridge inspection principles.
  • Experience addressing active-railroad requirements, including construction staging, temporary works, railroad access, track outages, and coordination with railroad operating personnel.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing structural calculations, bridge plans, specifications, reports, load ratings, quantities, and construction cost estimates.
  • Experience leading and coordinating engineers and designers on multidisciplinary projects and performing QA/QC reviews.
  • Knowledge of MicroStation and experience with structural analysis, bridge design, load-rating, and foundation software such as LEAP Bridge, STAAD.Pro, RISA, CSiBridge, LPILE, GROUP, or comparable programs.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts to clients, engineers, contractors, and other stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor less experienced engineers, develop client relationships, and support project pursuits and business-development activities.
  • Ability and willingness to travel within the continental United States and regularly work from GFT's Chicago or Schaumburg office.
  • Valid Driver's License.
What we prefer you bring:
  • Master's degree in civil or structural engineering with an emphasis in structures from an ABET-accredited university or college.
  • Illinois Structural Engineer license or the ability and interest to pursue Illinois SE licensure.
  • Experience serving as a Structural Lead, Design Team Leader, Project Engineer, Project Manager, Engineer of Record, or senior technical reviewer for significant railroad bridge projects.
  • Experience with Chicago-area and Midwest rail infrastructure, including projects involving freight railroads, Metra, Amtrak, CREATE, IDOT, the City of Chicago, and other regional transportation agencies.
  • Experience with railroad grade separations, major bridge replacements and rehabilitations, complex steel structures, movable bridges, and construction over or adjacent to active railroad operations.
  • NHI Safety Inspection of In-Service Bridges training and bridge inspection experience.
  • Active AREMA membership, with participation in Committee 7, 8, 9, 10, or 15 preferred.
  • Experience supporting rail bridge pursuits, including technical approaches, scopes, fee development, proposals, teaming, and client interviews.
  • Active participation in professional organizations and technical committees, conference presentations, or technical publications.
Compensation:The salary range for this role is $125,000 - $175,000. Salary is dependent upon experience and geographic location. Featured Benefits:
  • Hybrid (in-person and remote) work environment.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance.
  • Tax-deferred 401(k) savings plan.
  • Competitive paid-time-off (PTO) accrual.
  • Tuition reimbursement for continued education.
  • Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations
  • Incentive compensation for eligible positions.
