We’ve got exciting plans in place for you as a passionate, inquisitive and eager team player who wants to make an impact.

Your Role as Baker

As a Baker at COBS Bread you will lead our freshness commitment. Bakers start their days with an empty bakery but when they leave—it’s filled with the artisan bread and delicious treats for the community to enjoy. Right now, we are looking for personable Bakers to share their love of fresh bread with our loyal customers. No experience necessary- just the right attitude and a willingness to learn.

What Your Day Looks Like

  • Work as part of a small team to bake each morning, following carefully crafted recipes
  • Work alongside your team to keep the bakery clean, and contribute to a great customer experience
  • Be responsible for reading production schedules and recipes, measuring and mixing ingredients, moulding and shaping dough, and processing everything through the ovens

Requirements

Why You Were Bread for This

  • You are an early riser who can work independently or as part of a small team
  • You have pride in what COBS offers the community
  • You have a great attitude and good organizational skills
  • You share in a commitment to the success of your team, the bakery, and to your own development

Physical Requirements

  • Frequent turning and reaching
  • Occasional pushing, pulling and some forward bending
  • Ability to lift at least 2.5 kg to a height of 1.7 meters
  • Constant use of both hands, with frequent wrist rotation and flexing, occasional forceful gripping

Benefits

Perks & What You’ll Feel Good About

  • The satisfaction of baking from scratch, and pride in sharing that product with the community.
  • A fun team work environment with flexible hours
  • Our training program – Continue to develop your baking and leadership skills through our Bronze and Silver baker Development Qualification program.
  • Career advancement opportunities – We have a stake in helping passionate team members grow and have more impact in the business and community.
  • Complimentary products on us every shift
  • And more, including benefits for all full time employees

While we thank you for your interest, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.


About COBS Bread

With over 130 locations, COBS Bread serves fresh and delightful baked goods to communities across Canada every day. Any unsold items are donated daily to various local charities and food banks. The company's success can be attributed to the quality of our product, the development of our people, and our warm and friendly customer service.

COBS Bread is part of Bakers Delight – Established in 1980 operating as Bakers Delight in Australia and New Zealand, and since 2003 as COBS Bread in Canada and the USA. Together we have grown to more than 700 bakeries across Australia, New Zealand, Canada and the USA. The entire network employs over 15,000 people, serving more than 2.1 million customers each week.

title: Commercial Pricing Manager
description:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

Who we’re looking for

A Commercial Pricing Manager who will shape how we price, package and promote our passes and seat reservations, so the right offer reaches the right traveller in the right market, and our revenue and margin grow in a way that lasts. Pricing is one of our strongest levers to deliver on our purpose of creating Citizens of the World. When done well, it makes the deeper, slower journey the attractive choice, keeps buying simple, and reflects the value of the experience.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be joining the Growth Team, part of our Chief Brand Commercial Officer (CBCO) Department. Growth is where we work on selling more passes, in more markets, through our own website and app and through our distribution partners, while strengthening our brand. You’ll report to the Head of Growth.

You’ll be involved in every part of how Interrail is priced: all our passes, seat reservations, add-ons, new products and services, across all channels and markets. You’ll own the impact of pricing on our revenue, margin and order value, keep our pricing foundations strong and bring a test-and-learn mindset. You’ll also help us move to more flexible, market-aware pricing and promotions. A big part of the role is working with many stakeholders: you’ll work closely with Product, Finance, Customer Experience, our partner carriers and our Pricing Expert Committee (PEC), and you’ll lead these relationships yourself.

Commercial pricing strategy

  • Develop a pricing strategy that delivers our targets and fits our product roadmap, with every decision tested against one question: does this help someone come back changed after their Interrail trip?

  • Adjust prices and conditions, such as refund rules, validity and booking windows, based on market, competitor and customer insight.

  • Run the annual point-to-point benchmark with Finance, and own our pricing SKU file.

Stakeholders, carriers and governance

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including internal teams, the carrier community and other external partners.

  • Own our work with the Pricing Expert Committee (PEC), made up of carriers’ pricing experts: organise, prepare and run its meetings when needed, and seek its views and advice on strategic pricing matters, in close collaboration with the PEC’s Supervisory Board Sponsor.

  • Support carrier negotiations on pass prices and reservation fees.

  • Own pricing governance, policies and controls, keeping pricing consistent, transparent and compliant with competition and consumer law, with clear human oversight of any AI-supported pricing.

Products, services and price architecture

  • Price a growing portfolio of products, services and experiences around the trip, beyond the pass itself, and advise on what to add, change or retire.

  • Shape the pass range with Product, with a clear price ladder that rewards deeper, slower travel through more travel days, longer validity or First Class.

  • Keep our core promise clear and well priced: one pass, every train and the freedom to take the next train, selling the journey rather than the number of countries.

  • Price seat reservations, upsells, add-ons and exchange services so they raise order value and improve the trip.

Promotions

  • Own the pricing side of our annual promotional plan, in line with Growth campaigns, seasonality and market priorities.

  • Set discount rules for depth, frequency, eligibility and stacking, and measure the incremental impact of every promotion.

  • Use promotions to reach new audiences, including first-time international train travellers, while protecting price integrity and making sure every promotion serves our brand message.

Own channel and distribution

  • Use pricing and offers to grow sales and conversion on our website, app and distribution network, with clear rules on parity and partner terms.

  • Work with Growth on how prices appear from first search to checkout, and design targeted offers for CRM, loyalty and the Interrail community.

Revenue optimisation and insight

  • Find and size opportunities to grow revenue, yield and margin, backed by demand and elasticity analysis and business cases, and run a structured programme of pricing tests.

  • Build our pricing capability over time, including segmented, demand-responsive and dynamic pricing where it is feasible and fair.

  • Use AI and machine learning to sharpen forecasting, elasticity modelling, testing and promotional planning, together with data and tech colleagues.

  • Benchmark us against other rail passes, point-to-point rail, low-cost airlines and coaches, and track how AI assistants are changing the way travellers search, compare and book, so our prices and offers stay visible, competitive and clear.

You’ll know you’re succeeding when pass revenue and margin are on plan overall and by market, order value and upsell and reservation take-up are growing, our own channel is converting and gaining share, promotions deliver incremental return, and customers see our prices as clear and fair.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • 8 to 10 years in pricing, revenue management or commercial roles in B2C and B2B, with revenue growth you can show.

  • Hands-on experience with promotional pricing, and with pricing across several markets or currencies.

  • Strong data analysis and financial modelling skills.

  • Hands-on use of AI and advanced analytics tools in pricing or commercial work, and a clear view of how AI is changing travel and e-commerce.

  • Extensive experience setting and agreeing pricing strategy in a complex stakeholder landscape, working with senior leaders, external partners and industry bodies.

It’s a bonus if you also bring:

  • A background in travel, transport, hospitality or e-commerce, ideally including direct online sales and digital pricing tests.

  • Experience with range design, dynamic pricing or revenue management tools.

  • Experience with AI or machine-learning models for pricing, forecasting or personalised offers.

  • Knowledge of partner or reseller pricing, and of European competition and consumer pricing rules.

And in the way you work, you are:

  • Purpose-led and commercial. You link pricing to revenue and to the brand.

title: Modeling & Simulation Engineer, Robotics
description:
The Bigger Picture

At Andromeda, we're building the social intelligence layer for humanoid robots - technology that

allows robots to understand people, build relationships and become a meaningful part of everyday life.

Our first robot, Abi, is already doing this in aged care and healthcare, where she brings conversation, companionship and engagement to people every day.

Now we're scaling from early deployments into a platform that can operate across thousands of real-world environments. We're looking for individuals who want to tackle hard problems across robotics and AI, and help define what it means for robots to live and interact alongside people.

The Role

When can we trust a simulated robot?

Andromeda is building the Social OS for robots, starting with Abi: a robot that interacts with people in care environments. As we expand what Abi can do, we need to test more behaviors and failure conditions than physical trials alone can cover.

That makes simulation essential. It also makes its accuracy consequential.

We are hiring a Modeling & Simulation Engineer to own the models of Abi's sensors, actuators, and physical dynamics, and establish how well they predict the real robot. You will decide which differences matter, close them through measurement and modeling, and define where simulation is sufficient and where hardware evidence is necessary.

You will own the infrastructure that runs simulations and tests. You own the physical models and their validation. Together, you will give perception, actuation, and autonomy engineers a reliable basis for development and verification.

The Opportunity

The first challenge is current-generation Abi. The longer-term challenge is maintaining confidence as the hardware, autonomy, and robot embodiments change.

You will establish the modeling discipline behind that work: what we model, how we measure its accuracy, and which engineering decisions the evidence supports. This is an opportunity to shape how successive robots are designed and tested, withdirect access to the hardware and the teams building it.

What you will own

    • Models of robot dynamics, sensors, and actuators that capture the behavior relevant to development and testing, including non-ideal operation.
    • The measurement and system-identification work needed to reduce sim-to-real error, with quantitative evidence of improvement.
    • Model verification and validation: correct implementation, agreement with physical measurements, and explicit limits of use.
    • Fault modeling that exposes weaknesses in the robot's response to degraded sensing, actuation, and communications.
    • Integration of these models into the shared simulation and testing framework, alongside the Simulation Platform Engineer and domain teams.
    • You will set the technical approach and fidelity priorities. The measure of success is whether the models help engineers find failures and make better decisions about the real robot.

Requirements

  • This role requires 2+ years prior hands-on experience and the ability to lead the discipline independently from day one.
  • You have built and validated both sensor and actuator models for real robotic or autonomous systems, or directly equivalent physical systems. Those models have been used for engineering decisions, not only demonstrations.
  • You have a strong applied physics background, including dynamics, numerical simulation, controls, and system identification.
  • You have worked on closed-loop autonomy simulation and demonstrated sim-to-real improvement, or equivalent model-to-hardware correlation. You can explain the discrepancy, your intervention, and the measured result.
  • You know how to establish validation criteria, quantify uncertainty, and recognize when a model cannot support a conclusion.
  • You can implement and debug simulation software, extend a physics engine, and conduct experiments on hardware. Strong Python and C++ skills, or comparable scientific and systems programming experience, are required.
  • Experience with simulators such as Isaac Sim (we use), MuJoCo, Gazebo, or Drake, model formats such as URDF, MJCF, or USD, ROS 2, or hardware-in-the-loop testing is useful.
  • The essential qualification is demonstrated modeling and validation depth, rather than familiarity with a particular tool.

Benefits

The expected base salary for this role is $150,000 to $220,000 plus benefits and equity.

PLEASE NOTE: The advertised salary range is intended as a guide. For an exceptional candidate whose experience and capabilities align strongly with this role, we are open to discussing a package that reflects the value they bring. Given the importance of this hire, we are committed to investing appropriately in the person best placed to help us achieve our mission.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Our Values

  • Empathy – Kindness and compassion are at the heart of everything we do.
  • Play – Play sharpens focus. It keeps us curious, fast and obsessed with the craft.
  • Never Settle – A relentless ambition, bias toward action, and uncomfortable levels of curiosity.
  • Tenacity – Tenacious under pressure, we assume chaos and stay in motion to adapt and progress.
  • Unity – Different minds. Shared mission. No passengers.

Let’s build the future together.

title: Central Sterile Supply Technician
description:
SUMMARY

Receive, disassemble, and inspect reusable medical devices and surgical instrumentation for damage and prepare and sterilize medical equipment.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

· Visually inspect required instruments for cleanliness, signs of damage, deterioration, or imperfection. Conduct equipment testing of surgical instruments to ensure operational efficiency and surgical precision.

· Lubricate power equipment per manufacturer’s specifications.

· Perform leak test of flexible scopes prior to cleaning to prevent damage to inside of scope. Ensure laparoscopic equipment meets industry standards.

· Perform daily quality assurance testing on all equipment used in the cleaning and sterilization of surgical instruments, interpret test results, take appropriate action based on results and manually log all results in correct binder.

· Receive and dispose of regulated medical waste, general waste, and soiled linen.

· Comply with OSHA regulations governing the wearing of personal protective equipment at all times when working in the decontamination area.

· Determine the correct method of decontamination to include the following: removal of blood, tissue fragments, body fluids and other gross contaminants. Decontamination methods shall include wiping, soaking, rinsing, scrubbing, and using ultrasonic and washer decontamination/sterilizer equipment.

· Examine all items after decontamination/pre-sterilization procedures to ensure that gross contaminants have been removed and that instruments function properly.

· Ensure that all medical devices and surgical instrumentation are properly labeled and identified.

· Assemble and prepare the full range of specialty trays and instrument sets. Select correct wrapping or packaging material for medical devices and surgical instrument sets, select sterilization process in accordance with standard MTF procedures to include Ethylene Oxide (ETO) or Steam Sterilization. Correctly label, seal, wrap or place in rigid containers, items with appropriate chemical indicator tape, and aerate gas sterilized items for the correct period of time.

· Receive sterilized trays, sets, and equipment from the sterilizer; check for integrity of sterilization, (i.e., color changes on indicator tapes, external and internal indicators, and dampness of packages); stock and properly store sterile items in sterile storage room in accordance with MTF procedures.

· Maintain regular and punctual attendance.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

None.

Requirements

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

· Completion of a central sterile supply training course or previous military training.

· Current certification by the International Association of Healthcare Central Services Materials Management or current certification by the National Institute of Health Care Sterile Processing and Distribution Personnel.

· Must obtain and maintain the site's required health screening and immunization requirements.

· Must obtain and maintain any necessary security access and/or background checks.

· Must obtain and maintain all required documents, certifications, licenses, etc. listed on the credentialing checklist, sent by Katmai’s Credentialing Specialist, for this position for initial hire.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

· Excellent written communication skills to perform accurate documentation.

· Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with a diverse group of people.

Full-time. May be required to work additional hours as needed to complete assignment or project.

DRIVING REQUIREMENTS

None.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Work is performed primarily indoors at a well-lit military treatment facility such as a clinic, outpatient facility or hospital. The environment is normally air conditioned, but conditions may change dependent upon circumstances. Work may need to be performed in a fast-paced environment requiring quick thinking and rapid judgements. Employee will be exposed to a wide variety of clients in differing functions, personalities, and abilities. Periods of walking, standing, bending, kneeling, stooping, crouching, and lifting boxes weighing up to 30 pounds. Moderate to extended periods of office work with heavy periods of computer usage. Missione del ruolo:

  • guidare la strategia e la governance Data, Artificial Intelligence, Technology ed Enterprise Architecture;
  • assicurare che dati, piattaforme, architetture e standard comuni supportino la trasformazione delle Business Unit in modo sicuro, scalabile, interoperabile e sostenibile.


Mandato e posizionamento:

Principali responsabilità:

1. Data Strategy & Governance:

  • Governare l’evoluzione e l’interoperabilità dell’ecosistema tecnologico.

  • Definire la AI Technology Strategy e la roadmap di industrializzazione di AI (Generativa e Agentica);
  • Impostare e governare per quanto di competenza le iniziative di AI Transformation volte a far evolvere l’adozione dell’intelligenza artificiale nei processi di Business;

  • Assicurare l’allineamento con le architetture e le piattaforme;

  • Garantire la resilienza e continuità operativa di infrastruttura, rete e cloud;
  • Collaborare con i team applicativi nell’evoluzione dell’ecosistema tecnologico.

  • Guidare team e competenze multidisciplinari nelle aree Data, AI, Architecture e Technology;

  • Garantire il controllo e l’ottimizzazione della spesa economica durante tutte le fasi, dalla definizione del budget al controllo periodico;
  • Sviluppare capability interne, community professionali e una cultura orientata a innovazione, execution e valore.

Il/la candidato/a ideale ha maturato almeno 7 anni di esperienza in organizzazioni complesse e programmi di trasformazione tecnologica enterprise, con responsabilità manageriali in almeno quattro dei seguenti ambiti: Data & Analytics, AI/GenAI, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud & Platforms, Technology Strategy e Digital Transformation.

title: Senior Software Engineer - 3 (Orchestration & Validation)
description:
Location: Bengaluru,Karnataka,India

About Us

Exotel is one of Asia’s largest customer communication platforms. We are on a mission to move enterprise customer communication to the cloud. In 2020, we powered over 4 billion calls and connected over 320 million people. We work with some of the most innovative companies such as Ola, Swiggy, Zerodha, Whitehat Jr, Practo, Flipkart, GoJek, etc. We also power customer communication for some of the top banks in the country. Join us on this journey to make a difference to how companies look at customer communication. Read our growth story here.

Tech @ Exotel

Exotel engineering solves some really cool infrastructure level problems with the goal of ensuring no one misses a call or an SMS.

  • Our focus is on building very fault-tolerant, loosely coupled, scalable and real-time distributed system
  • We are generally agnostic of language, technology or tools. Currently, our tech stack is built on Java, Golang, Node.js, Ruby and PHP.
  • We use Postgres, Citus, Redis, Aerospike, MySQL as data stores, ElasticSearch for search and Kafka, Beanstalkd for queuing.
  • We emphasize a lot on clean abstractions of code, loosely coupled services and good coding practices
  • We are very strong believers in “you built it, you own it!”. And running a distributed system is very different from just building one!
  • We are crazy about high availability.

Engineering Team @ Exotel

The “Engineering” Team builds our Platform & Enterprise Contact Center solutions enabling customers to cater to their customer support, sales and collection use cases. The team has to cater to diverse requirements from domestic/international customers. Examples include developing voice, and messaging stacks, integrating our contact centre with CRMs such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zoho, Freshdesk, etc OR into customers’ own workflows, developing omni channel capabilities for our contact center etc.

About the Role

With evolving role of a developer as an orchestrator of agents that build software, we are seeking builders who can build and manage agents that validate software built with AI. You will build and train the AI agents that review pull requests and validate every release, read the code yourself to judge what those agents report, and stay the human in the loop who decides whether a change is safe to ship. You will be expected to understand their code and archiecture enough to suggest+validate deep whitebox approaches. You will debate with owners of PRs to convince why some code is either safe or unsafe to ship.

What You Will Do

  • Regression Analysis: build and operate agents, understand the surrounding service code, work out the blast radius, and arrive at risks and gaps. Risks identify what could go wrong and gaps identify what was needed vs what was built.
  • Decide whether the AI identified risks and gaps are accurate.
  • Validate static analysis with dynamically built tests agentically as the human in the loop
  • Develop and train the test agents: prompts, skills, tool contracts and the CLI/MCP tools that give agents access to code, GitLab, Jira and test environments.
  • Make agent assertions white-box: decide which DB rows, Redis keys, Kafka events or SIP/RTP traces prove a change works, and teach the agents to check them, not just the UI.
  • Measure the agents: track the valid-bug rate, the false-positive rate and time to signal, and keep a set of past MRs with known outcomes to regression-test the agents whenever a prompt or tool changes.
  • Turn every confirmed finding and every escaped defect into a deterministic regression test in CI. Agents feed the release gate; they do not replace it.
  • Tell environment failures from product failures in ephemeral and pre-prod setups, and fix or escalate at the right layer.
  • Validate AI products, whose outputs vary from run to run, with evaluation datasets and LLM-as-judge checks calibrated against human review.
  • Review the agent and test work of other engineers, and help the team adopt this way of working.

What We Look For

Must Haves

  • 6–8 years in software engineering with a Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science or equivalent, including substantial time writing production code in a product engineering organisation.
  • Expertise in one of Java / Go / Python, and enough reading fluency in the others to review an PR in them.
  • Working knowledge of Postgres / Citus / MySQL / Redis and Kafka / Beanstalkd — enough to know what state a change should leave behind and how to check it.
  • Experience with REST APIs and microservices in large-scale distributed systems.
  • Contact centre or telephony exposure is a plus: SIP, RTP, WebRTC, TCP/UDP.
  • Hands-on work building or seriously extending an LLM agent workflow (tool use, multi-step plans, retries, evaluation) and shipping it to real use.
  • CI experience: Running in Jenkins / GitLab CI / GitHub Actions.
  • Comfort with Docker and Kubernetes at the level of reading pod logs and debugging a failed environment.
  • Clear judgement on when an agent is wrong, and the habit of proving it with evidence.

Good To Have

  • Evaluating LLM outputs: eval datasets, rubrics, LLM-as-judge.
  • Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).
  • Exposure to AngularJS, React or Node.js front ends.

Soft Skills

  • A “DevOps” mindset: you own what you validate, through to production.
  • Excellent written communication — your sign-off and bug reports are read by developers and release managers.
  • Says no to agent verdicts that cannot be backed with evidence.
  • Team player who raises the bar through reviews and mentoring.

Apply to this job

DOXA, a Goldman Sachs company, is a leading specialty insurance platform, Private Equity backed, dedicated to partnering with niche underwriting businesses and supporting their growth through operational excellence, strategic investment, and entrepreneurial freedom. Position Overview

DOXA is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Legal Intern to join our corporate Legal Department for Summer 2027. This internship offers a unique opportunity for a law student to gain meaningful, hands-on experience within a centralized corporate legal & compliance department serving a growing insurance and financial services platform. DOXA’s business provides particular exposure to the intersection of law, business, insurance, private equity, and M&A.

The Legal Intern will work directly with DOXA's legal team on a variety of matters, including commercial contracts, corporate governance, regulatory compliance, employment-related issues, mergers and acquisitions support, and general business counseling. The Legal Intern will be exposed to various internal clients, including other corporate functions and distinct operating businesses, in a business-facing role. This is an excellent opportunity for a student interested in pursuing either an in-house legal career or a position with a corporate, M&A, or private equity law firm team after law school.


What You'll Do

The Legal Intern’s specific projects and day-to-day will depend on active matters during the summer, but we would expect the Legal Intern to have opportunities to:

  • Assist in reviewing, drafting, and negotiating commercial contracts and agreements
  • Conduct legal research and prepare memoranda on corporate, employment, regulatory, and insurance-related matters
  • Support corporate governance activities, including board and entity maintenance matters

The Legal Intern will be assigned a capstone project related to legal operations, governance, M&A, regulatory matters, or knowledge management; the specific area will be discussed and determined in the first week of the internship based on the Legal Intern’s specific area(s) of interest. The Account Resolution Representative acts as a critical liaison between the company and its customers to collect debts and resolve outstanding balances. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

About the role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and commercially minded Commercial Associate to support Qureight’s continued growth.

Working closely with the Proposals Manager, you will help prepare high-quality proposals, budgets and RFx responses for pharmaceutical, biotechnology and CRO customers. You will coordinate input from colleagues across clinical, imaging, data science, operations and quality teams, and make sure every submission is accurate, compliant, on time and clearly shows Qureight’s value.

You will also help maintain our proposal content, templates and pricing tools, track opportunities through the commercial pipeline and support the Business Development team when needed.

Around half of your time will be spent on proposals. The rest will be split roughly equally between (i) inside sales, where you will research target accounts, identify decision-makers and help qualify new opportunities, and (ii) marketing, where you will support our Head of Marketing with targeted campaigns, events and content.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their commercial career who wants to build expertise in proposals and bid management, alongside business development and marketing, within the life sciences industry.

What you will do

Proposals (around 50%)

  • Support the preparation of proposals, quotes and RFP/RFI responses.
  • Review customer requests, including protocols, synopses and RFP specifications, to extract key requirements, specifications, nuances and deadlines.
  • Build and check proposal budgets using Qureight’s pricing models, making sure assumptions are accurate and consistent with the scope.
  • Coordinate input from subject matter experts across clinical, imaging, data science, operations, QA and regulatory teams.
  • Manage proposal timelines, trackers and version control so submissions are delivered on time.
  • Proofread and format proposals so they are clear, consistent, compliant and on brand.
  • Maintain and improve the proposal content library, templates, boilerplate and case studies.
  • Support budget revisions, re-bids, change orders and contract handover documents such as work orders.
  • Maintain accurate, timely proposal and opportunity records in Qureight’s CRM, and help report on proposal metrics.
  • Develop a strong understanding of Qureight’s services, pricing and value proposition.

Inside sales (around 25%)

  • Research pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, clinical trials and CRO partners to identify new business opportunities.
  • Identify relevant customer stakeholders and decision-makers, and support outreach through email and LinkedIn.
  • Qualify leads and support their progression through the commercial pipeline.
  • Support the Business Development team with account research, meeting preparation and follow-up.

Marketing (around 25%)

  • Help keep marketing data in the CRM accurate and up to date, including tracking lead sources and campaign performance.
  • Spot proposal wins and customer successes that could make good case studies and help pull them together.
  • Share useful insights from proposals and outreach with Marketing, such as common customer questions and competitor information.
  • Support the Head of Marketing with targeted campaigns, LinkedIn and email content, and conferences and events, including following up leads.

Requirements

What we need

  • A degree or equivalent experience in life sciences, business, marketing or another relevant discipline.
  • An interest in business development and marketing, and in how campaigns and outreach turn into new business.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly and persuasively.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, both in writing and numbers.
  • Confidence in working with Microsoft applications.
  • Strong organisation and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • A proactive approach and willingness to take ownership of tasks.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across different functions and levels of seniority.

Even better if

  • You have experience in proposals, bid management, contracts or another commercial role.
  • You have worked within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO or another life sciences organisation.
  • You have researched clinical trials or pharmaceutical development pipelines.
  • You have built or reviewed commercial budgets, quotations or pricing models.
  • You have experience in inside sales, lead generation or B2B marketing, ideally in life sciences.
  • You have used marketing or social media tools such as HubSpot or LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
  • You have experience using/developing CRMs.
  • You understand clinical trial design, phases and documentation

Benefits

What can you expect from us

  • A comprehensive benefits package that includes an annual bonus plan, private medical insurance, life insurance, cycle-to-work scheme, and a contributory pension scheme
  • Equity, so that our team can share in the long-term success of Qureight
  • 28 days’ holiday allowance, 25 days’ annual leave and 3 additional company days between Christmas and New Year, plus bank holidays and enhanced family leave
  • A diverse work environment that brings together experts in many fields, including software engineering, DevOps, data science, machine learning, quality assurance, regulatory affairs, and clinical operations.

How to apply

Please upload a CV and covering letter by clicking ‘Apply Now’. Your covering letter should explain why you are applying for the job and what skills and experience you can bring to the role.

We review CVs as we receive them and interview as soon as we have applications that look like a good match, usually within one week. We do not use closing dates, so please apply as soon as possible to avoid missing out on this role.

If you have any queries, please contact careers@qureight.com

Everyone is welcome at Qureight. We are an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, sex, gender reassignment, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, or pregnancy and maternity.

Women and other underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for a role unless they meet all or nearly all of the requirements. If this applies to you, we still encourage you to apply. You may be a great fit, even if you don’t meet every qualification. We’d love to hear from you.

If you require any adjustments to the application or selection process, please let us know. We will be happy to support you.

title: Solution Architect - Engine by Starling
description:
Starling Bank is the UK’s first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking with more than 3,000 people in our UK offices and 4 MILLION customers in the UK! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. Now we present… Engine by Starling.

Engine by Starling is Starling’s software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling Bank, and over a year ago we split out as a separate business. We are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology.

This SaaS technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

At Engine by Starling, our technologists are at our very heart and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Engine is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, and discovering to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of our Sydney office in the CBD, so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

About the role

As a Solution Architect (SA) you will use your understanding of the Engine technology and architecture to explain the Engine product, uncover client requirements and support the design of client solutions.

You will be involved in both the sales and delivery phases of a project as well as ongoing client success, collaborating with teams across Engine in Technology, Delivery, Product, Client Success and Business Development..

Supporting these activities on client sites means the role will require travel around Australia and New Zealand, and occasional further travel.

What you'll get to do:

This role blends deep technical expertise with strong communication and collaboration skills. You'll become an Engine expert, understanding its architecture, technology, and functionality, allowing you to effectively communicate its capabilities and value to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You’ll lead on technical designs during the Engine implementation phase, building relationships with a variety of stakeholders within clients and SI partners such as their Engineering leads and Service Owners.

You will work closely with our clients and SI partners on the technical detail of implementing Engine, providing solutions to identified requirements and working with our Product and engineering teams to fulfil them. Your contributions will also extend to shaping Engine's product roadmap and supporting existing clients with additional capabilities to meet their strategic aims. You’ll help them maximise Engine’s current and future capabilities to solve their requirements and meticulously document scope and roadmap decisions to guide subsequent delivery waves, bringing in expertise from our Product Owners and engineering teams where required.

You will also be a technical champion for our existing clients, ensuring their ongoing success. This includes taking ownership of the technical aspects of client deliveries, collaborating closely with our SI partners to overcome challenges and achieve seamless integrations. You'll provide expert guidance to client engineering teams, using documentation, API specifications, and sequence diagrams to foster a deep understanding of Engine's architecture and functionalities. Additionally, you will collaborate closely with our Client Success team to troubleshoot technical issues, translate client needs into new technical requirements, and architect innovative solutions that enhance the Engine platform.

Requirements

Must Have:

  • Experience of end-to-end software engineering / solution architecture across the software delivery lifecycle
  • Experience with software service design and integration, such as RESTful APIs, OpenAPI specification and sequence diagrams
  • Experience of cloud infrastructure and large-scale cloud applications
  • Experience working in a client-facing role and building relationships with stakeholders
  • Strong interpersonal communication and collaboration skills. Experience delivering complex messaging to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience relating to retail or business banking, core banking, card processing or payments.
  • Experience of delivery and implementation of core banking or large-scale digital transformation programmes, application migration and solution integration
  • Commercial acumen with experience of building business cases
  • Experience in a SaaS organisation in a Client Solutions or Client Engineering role
  • Knowledge of financial regulations around the world

About you:

  • You have a focus on delivery and getting things done for a client
  • You have the ability to work well with people from a variety of levels, roles and technical backgrounds
  • You’re able to communicate clearly about technical subjects
  • You’re comfortable working in a varied role, collaboratively in a team, with a flat structure
  • You’re comfortable travelling nationally to our London office (initial upskilling will require a period of time working with our Engineers & Product team in London)
  • You’re comfortable travelling internationally

Interview Process:

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:

  • First Interview (45 mins) - Phone/Video call with existing Engine team members.
  • Second Architecture Interview, including small presentation/system design (90 mins)
  • Final Interview (30 mins)

Benefits

  • 25 days holiday. You’ll also get your birthday on us
  • The option to opt-out of public holidays
  • The option to buy/sell up to 5 days of annual leave a year
  • 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
  • Enhanced Pat & Mat leave
  • Perkbox
  • Length of service increased annual leave

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Engine by Starling is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Engine by Starling are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

When you provide us with this information, you are doing so at your own consent, with full knowledge that we will process this personal data in accordance with our Privacy Notice. By submitting your application, you agree that Engine by Starling and Starling Bank will collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we will process, where we will process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

We use AI tools to support various parts of our recruitment process, helping our team manage applications and assessments more efficiently. These tools are strictly used for support and do not replace human judgment with all final hiring decisions being made by our team. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please reach out to us.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer

General Conditions:

title: Junior adviseur vergunningen
description:
Zonder de juiste vergunningen kan een goed project alsnog stilvallen. Als Junior adviseur Vergunningen zorg je dat juridische randvoorwaarden, ruimtelijke procedures en benodigde toestemmingen vanaf het begin goed in beeld zijn. Zo help je projecten binnen waterveiligheid, energietransitie en infrastructuur van plan naar uitvoering.

Wat ga je doen als Junior Adviseur vergunningen?

  • Je adviseert opdrachtgevers en onze verschillende teams binnen Tetra Tech over juridische zaken op het gebied van vergunningen, ruimtelijke ordening en conditionerende onderzoeken.

  • Je stelt vergunningeninventarisaties op.

  • Je zorgt voor het tijdig aanvragen van vergunningen en andere publiekrechtelijke toestemmingen.

  • Je bouwt een relatienetwerk op en onderhoudt dit met bevoegd gezag.

Wat neem je mee?

  • Een hbo- of wo-opleiding richting rechten, planologie of een vergelijkbare opleiding.

  • Kennis van omgevingsrecht en/of bestuursrecht.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en je hebt de nodige overtuigingskracht.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om je vak goed uit te oefenen én je verder te ontwikkelen, inhoudelijk én persoonlijk.

  • Een goed salaris in lijn met jouw kennis en ervaring in een bandbreedte van € 3.200,- t/m 4.500 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur). Daarnaast ook nog een uitstekende pensioenregeling.

  • Een uitstekende reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Met ons ‘Progress on Demand’-opleidingsprogramma bepaal je zelf hoe je jouw carrièrepad vormgeeft – verdieping, verbreding of een combinatie – en welke trainingen hierbij passen.

  • 25+2 vrije dagen en de mogelijkheid om tien extra verlofdagen bij te kopen.

  • Een vergoeding van je sportschoolabonnement en een aantrekkelijk fietsplan.

  • Flexibele werktijden en hybride werken.

  • Een informele, professionele werksfeer waarin veiligheid, respect, samenwerking, collegialiteit en kwaliteit vanzelfsprekend zijn.

  • Toegang tot het internationale Tetra Tech-netwerk voor kennisuitwisseling en loopbaanmogelijkheden.

  • Ben je jonger dan 30, dan mag je deelnemen aan Tetra Tech Young, ons netwerk voor young professionals.

Waar kom je terecht?

Ons team omgevingsmanagement is een dynamisch en ondernemend team dat sterk is gegroeid in de afgelopen jaren. Het team bestaat nu uit circa 12 FTE en groeit de komende jaren door naar een volwaardig omgevingsteam van 25 FTE dat zich focust op de complexere omgevingsprojecten. We leggen hierbij de focus op projecten die raakvlakken hebben met het Hoogwaterbeschermingsprogramma, Kaderrichtlijn Water, Programmatische Aanpak Grote wateren en de opgave bij de nutsbedrijven op het gebied van energietransitie. Daarbij worden wij door onze klanten gezien als specialisten op het gebied van omgevingsmanagement, ruimtelijke planprocedures en conditionerende onderzoeken.

Werken bij Tetra Tech Nederland

Tetra Tech Nederland is een organisatie in ontwikkeling. Dat betekent: ruimte voor initiatief, voor ondernemerschap en voor mensen die willen bouwen. Je krijgt de ruimte om met ideeën te komen en deze uit te voeren, en door de cultuur van korte lijnen en snel schakelen, zie je ook direct resultaat.

We zijn inhoudelijk breed: van data-inwinning in het veld tot strategisch advies aan tafel. Daardoor werken we integraal, laagdrempelig en met korte lijnen. Geen ingewikkelde structuren of dichtgetimmerde rollen. Wel vertrouwen, vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

Interesse?

Wil je eerst inhoudelijk sparren over de rol, de projecten of jouw persoonlijke ontwikkelmogelijkheden? Graag! We vertellen je met enthousiasme hoe deze functie er in de praktijk uitziet.

Meer weten?

Neem contact op met Daan Breider via e-mail: daan.breider@tetratech.com of bel naar: 06 15 35 00 52.

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer (Team Lead)
description:
LimeoX is seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer to lead architecture, mentor engineers, and deliver production‑ready models and automation. You will drive initiatives across LLMs, weightage models, clustering, and AI‑powered workflows.

The role offers high‑level product direction with freedom to design solutions from scratch. We are looking for a first‑principles thinker who can research, prototype, and ship while collaborating with product and operations to align with business goals.

Lead and mentor a small team of AI/ML engineers: planning, reviews, pairing, and coaching. Own the technical roadmap and architecture for AI initiatives; translate goals into milestones and plans. Build and fine‑tune weightage models and LLMs for real‑world business problems with strong research skills. Design AI agents and automations; integrate workflows with Google Sheets/Docs via Apps Script. Develop custom prediction models; run experiments and A/B tests to identify best approaches. Apply clustering and classification to discover patterns and insights for decision‑making. Develop, optimize, and maintain data pipelines (ETL) and system integrations for training and deployment; implement feature stores. Collect/scrape and preprocess data ethically using Selenium and Playwright. Deploy, monitor, and retrain models; establish MLOps practices (CI/CD, model registry, observability). Collaborate cross‑functionally with product and operations; communicate trade‑offs and risks to stakeholders. We offer a place for meaningful service, professional growth, and spiritual impact. title: Senior Economist
description: The World Bank Group is one of the largest sources of financing and knowledge for developing countries and a global partnership dedicated to ending extreme poverty, boosting shared prosperity, and promoting sustainable development. With 189 member countries and more than 120 offices worldwide, we work with public and private sector partners to design and implement solutions informed by data, research, technology, and global experience. For more information, visit www.worldbank.org . In Latin America and the Caribbean (LCR), the World Bank Group serves 30 client countries with diverse development needs, ranging from large and sophisticated middle-income economies to IDA countries, small Caribbean states, and fragile contexts. Despite the region’s considerable resources and dynamic societies, deep inequalities persist, and many people remain vulnerable to poverty and exclusion. The Bank’s strategy in LCR focuses on promoting inclusive growth, investing in human capital, and building resilience, including through stronger governance, better institutions, economic integration, and greater mobilization of private finance. The regional context is increasingly complex. Sluggish growth, institutional weaknesses, climate change, elevated food and energy prices, and high debt levels are placing additional pressure on governments and disproportionately affecting vulnerable populations. The World Bank—and the Prosperity Practice Group in particular—has an important role to play in helping countries strengthen institutions, improve public sector performance, and sustain reform momentum in this challenging environment. The World Bank’s Governance and Institutions Unit for LCR (GOV PSI), part of the Prosperity Practice Group, works with governments and stakeholders to improve the performance, accountability, transparency, and effectiveness of public institutions. The unit applies a problem-driven and evidence-based approach, combining global knowledge of reform experience with a strong understanding of country-specific institutional constraints and opportunities. GOV PSI works across several core business lines, including public financial management; domestic resource mobilization and tax administration; state-owned enterprises and corporate governance; public institutions, including civil service, center of government, legislatures, and administration of justice; and decentralization and subnational governance. The unit also supports cross-cutting priorities such as digital governance, anti-corruption, and political economy analysis. The unit delivers a broad range of products and services, including diagnostics, technical assistance, advisory services, learning and knowledge activities, and the design and supervision of investment projects, results-based operations, and development policy operations. GOV PSI is seeking an outstanding Senior Economist to strengthen its work on public sector and institutional reforms in LCR, with particular emphasis on public financial management, fiscal management, applied economics, and data-driven analysis. The selected candidate will contribute to policy dialogue, analytical and advisory work, and lending operations, working closely with GOV PSI colleagues, the broader Prosperity team in the region, and global Governance colleagues. The Senior Economist will report to the GOV PSI Practice Manager for Latin America and the Caribbean. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES The Senior Economist will support and help lead the Governance Practice’s work program on fiscal and public financial management, institutional reform, and public sector effectiveness across LCR. Responsibilities include: • Lead and contribute to policy dialogue and business development with client governments on public sector, fiscal, and public financial management reforms. • Prepare and oversee high-quality analytical and diagnostic work, including expenditure reviews, public financial management assessments, institutional reform analyses, and other public policy products. • Lead and support the preparation and supervision of lending operations, including investment projects, results-based operations, and development policy operations. • Lead and support the preparation, implementation, and monitoring of Bank-executed trust funds and related advisory engagements. • Collaborate with other Global Practices, particularly within the Prosperity Practice Group, to design and deliver integrated country engagements and operations. • Provide technical inputs to initiatives led by other Global Practices where institutional reform, public finance, or governance expertise is required. • Contribute to partnerships and knowledge exchange with international organizations and development partners working on institutional development and public sector reform. • Support the design and delivery of learning, training, and knowledge-sharing activities for internal and external audiences. • Undertake other assignments, as agreed with the Practice Manager, consistent with the unit’s priorities and work program.

title: Associate HR Operations
description:
About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved. We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

title: Python-PySpark Developer (CCD/C-CDA)
description:
Job Title: Python / PySpark Developer – Healthcare (CCD/C-CDA)

Experience: 10–15 Years

Remote

Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on Python / PySpark Developer with practical experience processing CCD/C-CDA clinical documents and building scalable healthcare data pipelines.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, PySpark, XML parsing, and healthcare clinical data processing, along with experience developing and enhancing CCD/C-CDA parsers.

Key Responsibilities

1. CCD/C-CDA Parsing & Clinical Data Processing

  • Develop and enhance Python-based CCD/C-CDA parsing and clinical data processing solutions.
  • Analyze raw CCD/C-CDA XML and extract clinical information such as:
  • Demographics
  • Encounters
  • Diagnoses
  • Medications
  • Allergies
  • Immunizations
  • Vitals
  • Labs
  • Procedures
  • Build reusable and scalable parsing logic to support multiple EHRs, HIEs, vendors, and CCD variations.
  • Onboard new CCD vendors into existing frameworks with minimal vendor-specific code.

2. Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

  • Develop scalable data processing pipelines using Python and PySpark.
  • Handle large volumes of files and large XML documents efficiently.
  • Implement validation, error handling, logging, reconciliation, retry, and source-lineage capabilities.
  • Optimize processing performance and ensure pipeline scalability.

3. Data Quality & Troubleshooting

  • Troubleshoot missing, duplicate, malformed, or incorrectly interpreted clinical data.
  • Support production incidents and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Work with upstream providers and internal teams to resolve data-quality and clinical mapping issues.

4. Testing & Production Support

  • Develop automated unit and regression tests.
  • Ensure new vendor changes do not impact existing integrations.
  • Support production stability and continuous improvements.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on Python development experience.
  • Strong PySpark and large-scale data processing experience.
  • Practical experience with XML parsing and CCD/C-CDA documents.
  • Experience developing or significantly enhancing CCD/C-CDA parsers.
  • Good understanding of clinical data domains, including:
  • Labs
  • Vitals
  • Problems
  • Medications
  • Immunizations
  • Allergies
  • Procedures
  • Encounters
  • Experience handling different vendor/EHR implementations of CCD/C-CDA.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience.
  • Experience with clinical terminologies such as:
  • LOINC
  • SNOMED CT
  • ICD-10
  • CPT/HCPCS
  • RxNorm
  • CVX
  • Experience designing modular, reusable, and configuration-driven solutions rather than vendor-specific hardcoded parsers.

Preferred Skills

  • AWS experience, including S3, Lambda, Glue, ECS/Fargate, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, CloudWatch, or similar services.
  • Experience with Epic, Cerner, Meditech, HIEs, or other EHR/clinical data sources.
  • Healthcare payer, population health, or clinical quality reporting experience.
  • HEDIS / NCQA knowledge is an advantage but not mandatory.

title: Senior Business Dvelopment Manager (WhatsApp, Chatbots)
description:
Type: Permanent role, Full time
Location: Saudi Arabia, Riyadh, 100% onsite
Salary: Fixed plus variable (Depending on experience)

About CEQUENS

CEQUENS is a leading cloud communication platform in the Middle East and Africa region and is dedicated to simplifying communications and building bridges to allow businesses to communicate with their customers, no matter where they are. The company provides Omni-Channel communication API’s enabling enterprises and developers to communicate with their

Our partner network covers MEA region with international access to messaging hubs worldwide and our clients include major banks, credit cards, digital payments, OTT applications, government authorities, health and education, and other industry verticals.

If you have the passion for success and are ready to constantly challenge yourself within a collaborative team-environment join our team.

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially driven Senior Business Development Manager to drive revenue growth in Saudi Arabia by winning new customers and developing a strong partner ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of selling SaaS/CPaaS solutions, specifically AI agents, AI-powered chatbots and WhatsApp automation platforms, to businesses looking to improve sales performance, customer engagement, and customer support.

This is a hands-on, targeted sales role as single contributor, reporting in the Sales Manager. We are looking for someone who understands how to sell subscription-based software, can confidently lead their own product demonstrations, manage a sales pipeline and close deals. There will some travel involved to clients site in Riyadh and other location in Saudi Arabia,

Importantly, we want someone who has sold a similar product before, rather than someone coming purely from traditional software or IT services sales.

Alongside direct sales, the successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, recruiting, and managing channel partners who can resell or refer our platform, including digital agencies, system integrators, resellers and technology partners.

Key Responsibilities

New Business Development & Direct Sales

  • Own an deliver an individual new business sales target across the Saudi Arabian market.
  • Identify, prospect and win new customers for our AI agent and chatbot platform
  • Sell subscription-based software solutions to businesses across relevant sectors.
  • Build relationships with senior decision-makers, including CEOs, Commercial Directors, Heads of Sales, Marketing Directors and Customer Experience leaders.
  • Understand customer requirements and demonstrate how AI agents and WhatsApp automation can improve sales conversion, customer engagement and support efficiency.
  • Personally deliver compelling product demonstrations, showing prospective customers the platform's capabilities and commercial value.
  • Manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through demonstrations, proposals, negotiation and closing.
  • Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline, accurately forecasting opportunities and revenue.
  • Consistently achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.

Partnerships & Channel Development

  • Identify and recruit suitable channel partners across Saudi Arabia
  • Build relationships with digital and marketing agencies, system integrators, software resellers and technology partners.
  • Develop partner propositions that encourage third parties to refer or resell the platform.
  • Onboard, train and enable partners to confidently position, demonstrate and sell the solution.
  • Establish partner commercial agreements, referral arrangements and reseller models.
  • Actively manage partner relationships, ensuring partners generate qualified opportunities and contribute to revenue growth.
  • Develop a scalable partner ecosystem that supports market penetration and long-term recurring revenue.

Market Development

  • Develop a strong understanding of the Saudi Arabian market for AI-powered customer engagement and conversational commerce.
  • Identify target industries and businesses with strong demand for WhatsApp automation, AI sales agents and customer service solutions.
  • Monitor competitor offerings, market trends and emerging opportunities.
  • Develop effective go-to-market approaches to accelerate customer acquisition.
  • Represent the business at relevant industry events, networking opportunities and customer meetings.

Requirements

We are specifically looking for candidates with experience selling products similar to ours.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Proven SaaS/CPaaS sales experience: A strong track record of selling subscription-based software, ideally with recurring monthly or annual revenue models.
  • Relevant product experience: 4 years plus experience of selling WhatsApp Business, automation platforms, AI agents, AI-powered chatbots or conversational AI software.
  • Quota-carrying experience: Personally owned and delivered against a new business sales target, with demonstrable success in winning new customers.
  • Product demonstration skills: Confident delivering their own software demonstrations and presenting product capabilities to prospective customers.
  • Full sales cycle experience: Comfortable managing opportunities from initial prospecting through to commercial negotiation and closing.
  • Partnership development: Experience recruiting, onboarding and managing partners who resell or refer software products.
  • Commercial acumen: Able to articulate the business case, ROI and commercial benefits of AI-powered customer engagement solutions.
  • Relationship-building skills: Confident engaging with senior business stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Market knowledge: Good understanding of the Saudi Arabian business environment and B2B technology sales landscape.

Particularly Relevant Backgrounds

  • We are interested in candidates who have worked for businesses selling products in areas such as:
  • WhatsApp Business API platforms and WhatsApp automation software.
  • AI-powered sales agents and customer service agents.
  • Conversational AI and chatbot platforms.
  • Customer engagement and messaging automation SaaS.
  • AI-powered customer experience and contact centre solutions.
  • Omnichannel customer communication platforms.
  • Candidates who have sold comparable subscription-based products and have personally managed their own sales targets will be particularly attractive.

The Ideal Candidate

  • You are a commercially minded, self-starting sales professional who knows how to sell SaaS products and understands the opportunity in AI-powered customer engagement.
  • You are not simply an account manager or relationship builder. You are a proven new business hunter who carries a number, creates opportunities, delivers demonstrations and closes deals.
  • You understand how to sell the value of AI agents and chatbots to businesses, particularly where WhatsApp is a key customer communication and sales channel.
  • You also understand the value of building a partner ecosystem and have experience turning agencies, resellers and technology partners into productive sales channels.
  • Most importantly, you have sold something similar before, know how to win customers and can demonstrate a track record of delivering commercial results.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

  • Supporting the production team to help keep vehicles flowing through the repair process.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Notices the details that others miss.
  • Has a positive attitude and strong work ethic.

  • Is reliable, punctual, and motivated to learn.

  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Must be legally eligible to work in Canada.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation
  • Health and dental benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Full-time, stable employment

title: Content Specialist Aalst, België Bediende Lees verder
description:
Trots, gedreven en betrokken: woorden die op jouw lijf geschreven zijn? Dan bezit je het VPK-DNA dat wij zoeken.

Bij VPK Group zijn we constant in beweging en valt er elke dag iets nieuws te ontdekken. Achter elke hoek schuilt een verhaal, een mijlpaal die werd bereikt of een sterk staaltje innovatie dat het verdient om gedeeld te worden.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Content Specialist ga je actief op zoek naar verhalen binnen onze organisatie en vertaal je ze naar creatieve content. Je denkt mee, detecteert opportuniteiten en bouwt mee aan een consistente contentaanpak voor een internationale groep.

  • Je verzorgt zelf de montage en bewerking van video- en beeldmateriaal.

  • Je analyseert contentprestaties en vertaalt inzichten naar nieuwe ideeën en formats.
  • Je denkt mee na over creatieve contentreeksen en durft bestaande aanpakken constructief in vraag te stellen en nieuwe ideeën aan te brengen.
  • Je volgt digitale trends op de voet, waaronder de impact van AI op contentcreatie en online zichtbaarheid.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met HR en business stakeholders.

Wie ben je?

  • Je hebt bij voorkeur een bacheloropleiding in Digitale Media, Multimedia, Grafische Vormgeving of gelijkaardige opleiding/ervaring.
  • Je bent een sterke storyteller en weet complexe of technische informatie te vertalen naar heldere en aantrekkelijke communicatie.

  • Je beschikt over enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen contentcreatie, communicatie, employer branding of marketing.

  • Je begrijpt hoe verschillende doelgroepen via digitale kanalen bereikt worden.
  • Je bent ondernemend, proactief en neemt graag initiatief.
  • Je kan zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook actief samenwerking op.
  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt de juiste vragen om een sterk verhaal naar boven te halen.
  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels. Kennis van Frans is een pluspunt.
  • Je bent bereid om enkele keren per jaar naar onze Europese sites te reizen.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een uitdagende en dynamische werkomgeving binnen een innovatief financieel sterk familiebedrijf.
  • Je komt op verschillende sites en afdelingen waardoor je VPK van binnenuit leert kennen.
  • Een unieke kans om een nieuwe rol mee vorm te geven en impact te hebben op de communicatie van een organisatie met meer dan 7.000 medewerkers.

  • Veel autonomie en ruimte om nieuwe ideeën, formats en campagnes te ontwikkelen.

Wie zijn wij?

  • VPK Group produceert kartonnen verpakkingen en papier op basis van gerecycleerde vezels. Deze duurzame verpakkingen worden ontwikkeld op maat van de klant. Zo streven wij een optimale logistiek na voor onze klanten.

title: Managing Director - Asset Based Finance
description:
The opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Asset Based Finance (ABF) professional to join Castle Trust Bank as Managing Director, ABF, and play a leading role in establishing and growing an important new capability for the Bank.

This is a particularly exciting time to join us. We’re entering a new phase in our journey, with ambitious plans for growth and continued investment across the Bank.

Working closely with our Chief Investment Officer, you’ll help define and deliver our ABF strategy, identifying and executing opportunities across forward flow, senior financing and bond investments. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape our approach, build key external relationships and create the capability required to support the Bank’s longer-term growth ambitions.

This is a broad and highly commercial role. You’ll lead complex transactions from origination through to execution, balancing commercial opportunity with effective risk management and operating at senior levels both inside and outside the Bank.

This role is based in London, working as part of our hybrid model working 3 days from the office.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll take a leading role in developing and executing our ABF strategy and building the relationships and capability needed to support its continued growth.

This will include:

  • Working closely with the Chief Investment Officer to define and deliver the Bank’s ABF plan.
  • Originating, structuring and executing complex ABF transactions from initial opportunity through to completion.
  • Leading commercial structuring, valuation, due diligence, risk assessment and negotiation.
  • Identifying and evaluating strategic opportunities, including partnerships, funding initiatives and acquisitions.
  • Building strong relationships with institutional investors, non-bank lenders, debt providers, capital partners, rating agencies and external advisers.
  • Providing capital markets expertise as the Bank continues to grow and considers future capital management, risk transfer and wholesale funding opportunities.
  • Presenting commercially grounded recommendations to senior stakeholders, including ExCo and Investment Committee where appropriate.
  • Ensuring ABF activity operates within our regulatory, risk and governance frameworks.
  • Building the processes, frameworks and internal capability required to create a scalable, high-performing ABF function.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for an established leader with deep expertise in Asset Based Finance, Securitised Products, Investment Banking and/or Capital Markets.

As a minimum, you will bring:

  • Significant senior-level experience within ABF, Securitised Products, Investment Banking or Capital Markets.
  • A proven track record of originating, structuring and delivering complex transactions end-to-end.
  • Strong financial, commercial and strategic analysis capability.
  • Experience operating within a regulated financial services environment.
  • Excellent negotiation and influencing skills, with the credibility to operate at the most senior levels.
  • The ability to balance commercial opportunity with risk and regulatory considerations.
  • Strong judgement and the ability to operate autonomously within complex or ambiguous situations.
  • An established external network across relevant banking, lending, investment and advisory communities.
  • A degree in Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

What’s in it for you

This is a rare opportunity to help build and shape an ABF capability from the ground up, with considerable scope to influence the Bank’s future growth and strategic direction. You’ll work closely with senior leadership, have genuine ownership of the ABF agenda and play an important role in developing our external relationships and future financing capability.

Alongside a competitive salary and broader reward package, you’ll join a growing specialist bank where you can have genuine influence and make a visible impact.

In addition, you will receive:

  • Annual performance bonus (based on individual and company performance)
  • Generous contributory pension through Hargreaves Lansdown
  • Life Assurance
  • 28 days' holiday + option to buy/sell 5 days
  • Additional paid volunteering day
  • Private healthcare through BUPA
  • Free access to BHSF Rise EAP to support colleague health and wellbeing
  • Gym discounts
  • Season ticket travel loans (if applicable)
  • A supportive, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

Interested?

If you’re looking for an opportunity where you can combine deep transactional expertise with the freedom to build something, we’d love to hear from you.

Castle Trust Bank is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all colleagues can thrive. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on merit.

We are proud to be a Disability Confident employer. If you have a disability and meet the minimum criteria for the role, you will be offered an interview. If you require reasonable adjustments during the application process, please contact talent@castletrust.co.uk

This role regularly leads projects and is responsible for making equipment-related decisions within the assigned area, with corresponding authority and accountability. Duties include maintaining required compliance documentation and successfully completing all Operator Qualification (OQ) tasks specifically assigned to the position.

The position primarily supports the assigned area but may occasionally assist other areas as needed. It is subject to periodic call-outs and schedule adjustments based on operational requirements. 5 Plus years gas measurement experience
Technical school or college

Associate Degree

  • Oracle certifications in Oracle Cloud technologies.
  • Knowledge of Oracle SOA Suite, Oracle Service Bus (OSB) and WebLogic Server.
  • Direct experience integrating with SAP, Salesforce and other third-party systems.
  • Familiarity with message brokers and event streaming platforms (e.g. Kafka, Azure Event Hubs).
  • Experience with API management tools (e.g. Azure API Management) and API security standards such as OAuth and JWT.
