title: Technical Lead, Infrastructure & Projects
description:
Job Type: Full-Time, On-site (not a remote position)

Salary: $70,000-$90,000 per year (based on experience, qualifications and certifications)

Location: Moncton, NB


ABOUT THE ROLE

Southampton Solutions is looking for an experienced Technical Lead, Infrastructure & Projects to join our senior technical team.

We're a hands-on Managed Service Provider (MSP) helping businesses get the most from their IT systems. As our client base and project requirements continue to grow, we're looking for someone who can take ownership of complex infrastructure projects from technical discovery and solution design through implementation, documentation, and handover.

This is a senior, hands-on technical role rather than a traditional project management position. You'll help scope and design solutions, plan how they will be implemented, lead complex projects, and develop the processes and tools that help our broader technical team deliver projects consistently.

You'll also serve as a senior technical resource for the team, providing guidance and mentoring to other technicians and assisting with complex technical escalations when your expertise is required.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Leadership & Solution Design

· Lead complex infrastructure projects from technical discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, completion, and handover.

· Participate in pre-sales technical discovery, assess client requirements, and design secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective IT solutions.

· Develop technical scopes, solution designs, implementation plans, effort estimates, project schedules, resource requirements, assumptions, and dependencies.

· Develop and continuously improve project lifecycle processes, standards, templates, and documentation so projects can be scoped, planned, delivered, and handed over consistently across the technical team.

· Develop and maintain pre-sales discovery, assessment, and scoping questionnaires and tools to support consistent solution design and effort estimation.

· Translate approved solutions into organized project plans, tickets, assignments, and technical tasks, coordinating resources, clients, vendors, schedules, risks, and dependencies as required.

· Provide technical direction and establish appropriate review checkpoints for projects assigned to other technicians, helping identify technical risks, scope concerns, and implementation issues without requiring the Technical Lead to personally deliver every project.

· Ensure completed projects include appropriate documentation, knowledge transfer, and handover to the service team


Infrastructure & Technical Leadership

· Design, deploy, configure, migrate, and troubleshoot on-premises and cloud infrastructure, including servers, virtualization, storage, networking, and backup/disaster recovery solutions.

· Implement and support Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, VMware, and Hyper-V environments.

· Deploy, administer, and migrate Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID, and Intune.

· Implement and support Microsoft Azure infrastructure and Microsoft 365 security solutions, including virtual machines, Azure Virtual Desktop, MFA, Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender, and identity and access controls.

· Configure and troubleshoot network infrastructure including firewalls, switches, wireless networks, VLANs, routing, and VPN connectivity.

· Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior and intermediate technicians, helping them take on increasingly complex project responsibilities while maintaining consistent implementation standards and best practices.

· When required, assist with complex Level 3 technical escalations, root cause analysis, infrastructure recovery, and other issues requiring senior technical expertise.

· Maintain technical procedures and standards and use PowerShell and other automation tools to improve consistency and operational efficiency

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

· 5+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, cloud infrastructure, networking, or a comparable senior technical role.

· Demonstrated experience leading technical infrastructure projects from discovery and planning through implementation, documentation, and handover.

· Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, virtualization, networking, and infrastructure security.

· Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID, and Intune.

· Experience with Microsoft Azure, server migrations, infrastructure upgrades, virtualization, backup, and business continuity/disaster recovery solutions.

· Advanced troubleshooting skills across complex technical environments.

· Ability to develop technical scopes, implementation plans, effort estimates, schedules, resource requirements, and project documentation.

· Strong organizational, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to work directly with clients, vendors, sales, and technical teams.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

· Previous experience working within a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or supporting multiple client environments.

· Experience with ConnectWise Manage or a comparable Professional Services Automation (PSA) platform.

· Experience developing reusable project templates, discovery questionnaires, implementation standards, or technical project processes.

· Experience with VMware/Hyper-V, enterprise backup and disaster recovery platforms, PowerShell scripting, and infrastructure automation.

· Relevant Microsoft, Azure, networking, virtualization, security, or project management certifications.

· Bilingualism in English and French is an asset.

WORK REQUIREMENTS

· Must be legally eligible to work in Canada.

· Valid Canadian driver's licence and ability to travel to client sites.

· Ability to safely lift and move equipment such as servers, network equipment, and rack-mounted hardware up to 50 lbs.

· Ability to provide a satisfactory criminal background check.

· Strong teamwork, organization, and communication skills.

We offer a positive working environment with competitive wages, health benefits, and RRSP matching. We also support ongoing professional development through certification reimbursement.

This is an on-site position based in Moncton, New Brunswick, with travel to client locations as required.

Some projects, migrations, maintenance activities, and critical incidents may require flexibility outside regular business hours. The position also participates in our rotating after-hours on-call schedule, currently approximately one week every six to eight weeks.

Make sure your cover letter describes your past experience and how it relates to what we are looking for in this job posting.

We thank you in advance for applying but only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Note: This job posting describes the general scope and responsibilities of the position. It is not intended to list every task or requirement, and responsibilities may evolve as our team, technologies, and client needs change.

A company truck will be provided which you keep fully stocked with tools and chemicals. You will receive paid vacation time following a qualifying period.

If you are interested in being considered for this position and joining our award-winning team, then we would encourage you to apply for this position.

title: Head of Digital Acquisition
description:
FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.

In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices. Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents.

To gain deeper insights into FairMoney's pivotal role in reshaping Africa's financial landscape, we invite you to watch this informative video.

THE MANDATE

As our product offering expands, we are looking for marketing leader to help FairMoney reach more customers and scale acquisition efficiently — growing customer volumes while making every acquisition budget work harder.

You will lead FairMoney's digital function, owning paid acquisition across Google, Meta, affiliates and other performance channels. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the acquisition strategy, manage substantial budgets and develop the in-house team, while working directly in advertising platforms, reviewing campaign data and identifying the changes needed to improve results.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Set the paid acquisition strategy across lending and banking products, translating business priorities into channel plans, campaigns and measurable targets.
  • Lead and personally optimise Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns, including mobile app acquisition, bidding, targeting, budget pacing and campaign structure.
  • Own the acquisition budget: planning, forecasting and allocation — monitoring spend and returns, and scaling investment across channels and campaigns based on performance.
  • Own acquisition efficiency and quality: track and improve CAC, CPA, conversion rates, ROAS and cost per activated customer, using cohort and lifetime-value insights to judge the quality of customers acquired.
  • Run structured experiments across creatives, messaging, audiences, bidding strategies and conversion events, and partner with Brand and Design to turn insights into effective advertising.
  • Build and manage affiliate partnerships: negotiate commercial terms and payout models, and monitor traffic quality, fraud risk and acquisition costs.
  • Keep measurement and attribution reliable: work with Data and Engineering on app tracking, attribution and conversion signals, and investigate discrepancies between platform and business results.
  • Optimise the full acquisition funnel with Product, Risk and CRM — from click and install through registration, activation and first product usage, we need the right customer at the right time.
  • Lead and coach the in-house performance marketing team, set clear goals, and present results, forecasts and recommended actions to the management team.
  • Develop new channels: evaluate new paid acquisition opportunities and scale those that demonstrate repeatable results.

Requirements

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Scaled performance marketing in financial services. Has led and scaled performance marketing in fintech, consumer lending, digital banking or other consumer financial services. Emerging-markets experience is preferred.
  • Senior acquisition leadership. 7+ years in performance marketing or digital acquisition, including leading a team and owning acquisition outcomes in a B2C business.
  • Deep, hands-on Google Ads and Meta Ads expertise. A recent, proven record of scaling mobile app or consumer acquisition campaigns.
  • Budget ownership at scale. Has managed substantial paid marketing budgets, including planning, forecasting, allocation and performance reporting.
  • Proven efficient growth. Can show where they improved acquisition efficiency while increasing customer volumes, with clear examples and measurable results.
  • Strong affiliate marketing experience. Including partner management, commercial negotiations and traffic-quality assessment.
  • Technical measurement fluency. Strong understanding of mobile attribution, app events, conversion tracking and value-based bidding; able to troubleshoot measurement issues with technical teams.
  • Strong analytical judgment. A practical command of CAC, CPA, ROAS, LTV, payback and cohort performance.
  • Builder and player-coach. Can build and develop an in-house team while staying closely involved in campaign execution and optimisation.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Attribution and analytics tooling. Experience with Adjust, AppsFlyer or similar platforms, alongside Firebase, GA4 and business intelligence tools.
  • Advanced analysis and automation. SQL or other advanced analytical skills, and practical use of AI or automation to improve campaign analysis, creative testing or reporting.

EXPECTATION ON AI

  • Plan in AI-era timelines. Challenge campaign and testing plans that assume pre-AI cycle times, and compress launch, test and learning loops from weeks into days.
  • Make the team AI-native operators. Expect marketers to use AI directly for creative variants, copy, audience analysis, reporting and campaign diagnostics.
  • Redesign the acquisition workflow. Jointly define with Data, Design and Engineering where AI is used across creative production, testing, bidding, measurement and reporting.
  • Measure AI leverage. Track creative testing velocity, time-to-insight, output per marketer and acquisition efficiency against pre-AI baselines.
  • Scale what works. Turn successful AI-native practices into playbooks, tooling and operating standards across the Growth team.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Efficient growth

  • New-customer volumes grow materially while CAC and CPA improve across channels.

Quality customers

  • Acquired cohorts activate and use our products, with LTV and payback improving across lending and banking.

A team that owns outcomes

  • Attribution is trusted, budget moves on evidence, and each team member owns clear channel targets.

Benefits

  • 25 days paid vacation, Sick & Public Holidays to B2B contractors
  • Remote (timezone must have significant overlap with CET)
  • Training & Development budget
  • Paid company business trips

Recruitment Process:

  • Screening session with a member of the recruitment team.
  • Technical Interview with the Chief Growth Officer
  • Case Study
  • Panel Session to discuss case study
  • Final Interview with the executive team

title: Talent & People Advisor (12-18 months FTC)

Initially this role will be a fixed term contract to support across a period of maternity leave, however there may be scope for this role to become permanent in line with agency growth.

  • Champion our employer brand with our internal marketing team, and support the Head of People in developing an updated employer brand and EVP
  • Support talent initiatives such as internships, work experience and apprenticeships that advance our DEI&B efforts

People Operations

  • Draft employment documentation (contracts, variation letters, probation documents and ad-hoc letters) for sign-off by the Head of People or GM
  • Own onboarding with the Studio Manager, from On-Ramps and inductions to equipment set-up, and support off-boarding, including exit interviews and leaver paperwork

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • Proven in-house recruitment experience, ideally within a creative, design, marketing or professional services agency, hiring both permanent and freelance creative talent
  • Strong sourcing and interviewing skills, and confidence leading a recruitment process using recruitment tools and software
  • A good working knowledge of UK hiring practices, compliance, right-to-work and onboarding requirements
  • Excellent communication and strong emotional intelligence, with the ability to build rapport quickly with candidates and senior stakeholders
  • Great organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle priorities
  • Sound judgement and discretion with confidential and sensitive information
  • A genuine interest in design, branding and the creative industries

Bonus points if you have:

  • HR administration or People Operations experience
  • Experience using our HR platforms (Workable, CharlieHR & Leapsome)
  • Employer branding experience, including using social content to drive attraction
  • Understanding of inclusive hiring practice and creative-sector diversity challenges

Benefits

📍Location: This role is based at our East London studio (E10), with hybrid working arrangements

💰Salary: £40,000 - £45,000 dependant on experience
🕘 Standard hours: 9am–6pm (flexible working hours available on application)
🎉 Unofficial 5pm finish on Fridays

Some of our key benefits

  • 0.5 paid days/month to get inspired
  • Research budgets and trips
  • YCN creative learning membership
  • Spill mental health support
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Fitness discounts

Belonging and Inclusivity at StudioXAG:

StudioXAG is a business that strives for equality for all its people. Known for our storytelling, our different perspectives make us more creative than ever.

No matter who you are, you are welcome at StudioXAG.

title: Railway Logistics Supervisor
description:
Join Our Team as a Logistics Supervisor
Location: Bolton, ON (with travel throughout the GTA)Company: Universal Rail Solutions Inc.Employment: Full-Time

Ready to Keep Our Projects Moving?
If you’re an experienced logistics professional who knows how to keep people, equipment, materials, and schedules moving safely and efficiently, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
Universal Rail Solutions Inc. is seeking a Logistics Supervisor to lead day-to-day logistics operations supporting railway construction and maintenance projects throughout the Greater Toronto Area.

Who We Are
At Universal Rail Solutions Inc., we keep Canada’s railways moving — safely, efficiently, and sustainably. We work coast-to-coast across every railway sector and project size, delivering exceptional value and service excellence to our clients.
Within our team, we call this Doing It Right!

The Opportunity
Reporting to the Project Manager and/or General Manager, the Logistics Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the safe, timely, and cost-effective movement of materials, equipment, tools, and personnel in support of railway construction and maintenance operations.
In this role, you’ll provide day-to-day leadership to logistics employees while working closely with project teams, suppliers, freight carriers, subcontractors, and customers. You’ll help anticipate operational needs, solve transportation and delivery challenges, oversee fleet and regulatory requirements, and ensure projects have the resources they need when they need them.
This role is more than logistics coordination. It’s about keeping projects moving, minimizing disruptions, and building a safe and reliable logistics operation.

What You’ll Do

Coordinate the scheduling, transportation, and delivery of railway construction materials, equipment, machinery, and tools
Develop short- and long-term logistics plans based on project schedules, priorities, resources, and material requirements
Work with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, and Site Supervisors to forecast transportation, equipment, and material needs
Confirm that required transportation, equipment, operators, permits, and documentation are in place for upcoming work
Coordinate the deployment and movement of specialized railway machinery, vehicles, tools, and support equipment
Monitor shipments, deliveries, and inventory levels to prevent project delays, equipment downtime, and material shortages
Respond to changing project schedules, site conditions, and urgent operational requirements
Lead the resolution of transportation, delivery, inventory, and equipment-movement issues

Assign work, establish priorities, and monitor progress to ensure activities are completed safely and on schedule

Support recruitment, onboarding, training, development, and performance management
Coach employees on safety, customer service, documentation, equipment care, and operating procedures
Monitor employee scheduling, attendance, qualifications, and compliance with company requirements
Promote effective collaboration between logistics teams, field employees, project teams, customers, and external service providers

Support the operation and administration of the company fleet, including Commercial Vehicle Operator’s Registration (CVOR) requirements
Coordinate preventative maintenance, inspections, repairs, servicing, and required fleet documentation
Ensure vehicles, trailers, machinery, and material-handling equipment are suitable and available for planned work
Confirm Drivers and Operators hold the appropriate licences, certifications, training, and qualifications
Coordinate permits and documentation for oversized, overweight, controlled, or hazardous loads
Maintain accurate records related to equipment movements, vehicle use, maintenance, inspections, deliveries, and permits
Monitor compliance with applicable transportation regulations, company safety policies, and customer requirements
Participate in incident reviews and corrective actions involving fleet, equipment, deliveries, or logistics operations

Vendor, Supplier & Customer Coordination

Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, freight carriers, subcontractors, rental companies, customers, and internal stakeholders

Review transportation rates, quotations, rental costs, and service arrangements within assigned authority
Support vendor selection based on safety performance, reliability, availability, and cost
Monitor vendor performance and address delivery, invoicing, documentation, service, or compliance concerns
Communicate delivery schedules, restrictions, delays, and operational changes to stakeholders

Inventory, Cost & Performance Management

Oversee the tracking and control of materials, equipment, tools, and inventory
Ensure shipping, receiving, transfer, inspection, and delivery documentation is accurate and complete
Review logistics invoices, freight charges, purchase documentation, rental costs, and supporting records
Investigate invoice discrepancies, transportation costs, equipment losses, delivery exceptions, and inventory variances
Support logistics budgeting, forecasting, cost tracking, and reporting
Identify opportunities to consolidate shipments, reduce expedited deliveries, improve equipment utilization, and control costs
Monitor logistics performance, including:

Delivery reliability
Fleet utilization
Equipment availability
Transportation costs
Inventory accuracy
Operational delays

Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, checklists, schedules, and tracking tools
Identify opportunities for continuous improvement across logistics and fleet operations
Provide management with regular updates on operational risks, upcoming requirements, costs, and compliance matters
Perform other related duties as required

What You Bring

College diploma or university degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Construction Management, or a related field
A combination of relevant education and substantial industry experience may also be considered
5+ years of progressively responsible experience in logistics, transportation, fleet, railway, construction, or heavy industrial operations
2+ years of supervisory or operational team leadership experience preferred
Experience supporting railway construction, civil construction, heavy equipment, or multi-site field operations is an asset
Working knowledge of CVOR requirements and commercial fleet operations is strongly preferred
Knowledge of transportation documentation, load securement, fleet operations, and applicable transportation requirements
Strong leadership, coaching, communication, negotiation, and customer-service skills
Ability to coordinate multiple logistics activities across projects and job sites
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
Experience with logistics, fleet-management, inventory-management, ERP, or similar operational systems
Ability to interpret project schedules, anticipate requirements, assess risks, and allocate resources
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Sound judgment with the ability to make timely decisions and escalate safety, operational, compliance, or cost concerns appropriately
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate recordkeeping
Valid driver’s licence with an acceptable driving record
Forklift, material-handling, load-securement, or heavy-equipment certification is considered an asset
Ability to travel regularly to project sites, yards, suppliers, and customer locations
Flexibility to work evenings, nights, weekends, or outside regular business hours when operational requirements demand it
Ability to respond to urgent fleet or logistics matters as required

Work Environment

Work is performed across office, yard, warehouse, shop, customer, and active construction-site environments
Regular travel between company locations, project sites, vendors, and customer locations may be required
Exposure to weather, construction activity, moving equipment, noise, dust, and uneven terrain
Required personal protective equipment must be worn while working in designated environments
Extended or irregular hours may occasionally be required to support project schedules, emergency requirements, or time-sensitive deliveries

What We Offer

Competitive compensation
An industry-leading comprehensive benefits program
Opportunities for professional growth and development
The opportunity to lead an important operational function within a growing railway construction and maintenance organization
A collaborative work environment where Safety is an integral part of our culture

Apply Today!

Universal Rail Solutions Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
A.I. may be used in the grading of candidates for selection purposes.

title: Ungulates - Keeper
description:
Hours: 15 hours per week over 2 days
Work pattern: Includes weekends, bank holidays and some evenings
Duration: Permanent salaried PT
West Midlands Safari Park is currently recruiting for an Animal Keeper on our Ungulates section.

This is an exciting opportunity, where we are looking for applicants who can demonstrate the ability and knowledge to work with the extensive range of ungulate species, managed in a drive-through safari system. The position involves husbandry tasks, such as feeding, cleaning, health monitoring and environment maintenance, delivered to a high standard. The position involves work in the Asian and African sections and all the species within. It includes monitoring of guests in our Safari Drive and delivering keeper talks.

About you
The role requires someone who is confident, motivated and enthusiastic about wildlife conservation and has excellent communication skills. The successful applicant will require good wildlife knowledge and have an animal related qualification to HND level or above. Ideally, we are looking for someone with previous experience in a similar role. It is a physically demanding but very rewarding role.
You will need to be flexible in your approach to work outside of standard business hours, including weekends, bank holidays and evenings. Due to driving in animal restricted areas, we are looking for someone who has a full, valid driving licence.

Benefits
As well as benefiting from working in a unique and beautiful setting, you’ll also receive a range of additional perks to employment including:

WMSP Annual Pass which gives you and your family and friends free admission and theme park wristbands, and free entry to our sister site Drayton Manor Park also Water World Stoke On Trent
20% Discount in our retail Shops.
50% of Food & Beverage while on shift (Individual)
35% of VIP Experiences. Discounts do not apply to guided Minibus Tours.
35% off at selected Food & Beverage Purchases whilst visiting the park.
10% off stays in Safari Lodges
24 Hour access to an online doctor and access to online prescriptions.
Counselling access.
Online retailer discount portal.

What we are
West Midlands Safari Park is an award-winning visitor attraction, located in Worcestershire in the heart of England. It is home to some of the world’s most beautiful and critically endangered species, with a four-mile Safari Drive, Safari Walk with a Discovery Trail, African Village and Lemur Woods, allowing guests to experience up close encounters with hundreds of amazing animals. Guests can also choose from a wide range of catering and retail outlets, as well as enjoying a large amusement area with over 21 rides and attractions providing the ideal venue for family days out.
In 2021, the Park introduced Safari Lodges – luxury accommodation allowing guests to stay overnight for the first time. Guests can wake up to incredible sights of elephants, giraffe, rhinos, hippos and red pandas, or sleep just a ‘whisker’ away from lions, tigers and cheetahs.
In addition, the Park is home to three incredible venues – Spring Grove House, Treetops Pavillion and Cellarz, which play host to weddings, corporate events and social celebrations.

What we do
Our mission is to bring people together to create unique wildlife experiences that exhilarate, educate and leave memories to last a lifetime.
Our 200-acre site allows us to do just that, whether you’re a day guest, wedding guest or overnight guest! We create experiences unlike no other, attracting visitors from across the Midlands and beyond.
Our brand and our team members live by our core values. We’re passionate and work with a sense of togetherness, always striving to be progressive, with preservation at the heart of everything we do, all while creating unforgettable experiences.
Through these principles we aspire to achieve our vision: to be the number one UK wildlife attraction through the creation of immersive animal habitats and unique visitor experiences.

description:
Job Title: VP, Supply and Trading, Renewable Energy
Division: Renewable Energy
Location: Toronto (Mississauga office) or Montreal (Varennes office)
Reports To: Executive Vice President and Co-Head, Renewable Energy
Vacancy Status: This posting represents an active vacancy for which we are currently hiring.
Who We Are
Every day, people around the world take medicine, pour a drink, wash their hands, wear a fragrance, or fill up their car. Most of them never think about what’s inside. We do, because a lot of it starts with us.
Greenfield Global produces the high-purity alcohols, specialty solvents, custom blends, bioprocessing inputs, and low-carbon fuels that industries in more than 50 countries depend on. Founded in 1989 as a single plant in Tiverton, Ontario, we now operate ethanol distilleries in Ontario and Québec, manufacturing and packaging facilities in Canada, the United States, and Ireland, and a globally integrated supply chain. Because we’re the producer and not a middleman, we control every step from sourcing and testing to delivery, giving customers exceptional quality, reliability, and support.
About the Role
The Vice President (VP), Supply and Trading leads the commercial supply and trading activities of the Renewable Energy business unit, with a focus on renewable fuels and related environmental markets. The VP is responsible for product supply, physical trading, environmental credits and market risk management, with a mandate to optimize margins across ethanol and other renewable fuel products while developing the commercial capabilities required to support the growth of new low-carbon solutions.
What You’ll Do

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing supply and trading team.
Manage ethanol supply, sales and distribution relationships with refiners, marketers, and terminals, including the negotiation and management of commercial contracts, terms and conditions.
Trade and optimize environmental attributes, including Clean Fuel Regulations (CFR) credits, Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) credits, Renewable Identification Numbers (RINs), the Quebec SPEDE/Cap & Trade credits and European certificates.
Approve feedstock and co-product strategies on behalf of Renewable Energy.
Lead logistics strategy of the Renewable Energy supply network.
Develop and maintain hedging strategies and risk policies in partnership with Finance and Risk.
Support offtake strategy and commercial structuring for new products, including e-methanol and other low-carbon molecules.
Track and interpret policy and market developments (CFR, LCFS, the European Renewable Energy Directive, and provincial mandates) and translate them into commercial positioning.
Provide market intelligence, forecasts, and performance reporting to Renewable Energy executive leadership.
Oversee market intelligence activities and manage subscriptions to market data and pricing services to support commercial decision-making.
Lead supply strategies for the purchase and resale of products, identifying market opportunities and optimizing value across the portfolio.

About You

At least 12 years in energy, biofuels, or commodity trading, including at least five in a senior leadership role.
Deep knowledge of ethanol and low-carbon fuel markets and environmental credit programs.
Proven record managing physical supply, price risk, and counterparty exposure.
Strong commercial negotiation and structuring skills; experience with long-term offtake or supply agreements is an asset.
Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, economics, or a related field.
Functional in English and French.
Demonstrated ability to take full ownership and accountability for decisions, results, and business outcomes.
Proven ability to build strong, trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex issues clearly, directly, and effectively at all levels of the organization.
Strong and decisive leadership, with the ability to set direction, make difficult decisions, and lead with conviction.
Strong executive presence and demonstrated ability to influence, engage, and mobilize others.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, with a demonstrated focus on maximizing profitability and value creation.
Ability to navigate ambiguity, complexity, and rapidly changing market conditions while maintaining sound judgment and strategic focus.
Demonstrated resilience and perseverance, with the ability to remain effective and solution-oriented in the face of challenges and adversity.
Provide leadership, coaching and mentorship to the commercial team, fostering talent development, knowledge sharing and strong succession.

What Success Looks Like

Improved margin capture and reduced volatility.
Optimize value across products, markets and jurisdictions

title: Distribution Administration - Distribution Center Manager
description:
Distribution Center Manager
About the Company
Malteries Soufflet acquired United Malt Group in 2023, creating the world’s largest malting company with an annual production capacity of 3.7 million tons of malt through 41 facilities in 20 countries, serving both industrial and craft brewers and distillers. Across the globe, our family of brands produce malt that is blended into some of your favorite industry-leading beverages and local craft brews.
Our more than 2300 employees are proud of the rich heritage of our family of brands and are committed to incorporating sustainability improvements at every touchpoint of our supply chain. We celebrate the diversity of our people and together strive to create an environment where all employees are safe, welcomed and have a sense of belonging.
Leverage Difference • Be Accountable • Passion for Innovation • Cultivate Agile Collaboration
About the Role
Reporting to the Director of Operations, Supply Chain CMG, the Distribution Center Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and operational excellence of the distribution center. This role ensures the safe, efficient, and cost-effective receipt, storage, inventory management, and distribution of products while maintaining high levels of customer service. Preference will be given to qualified candidates with a passion for the craft brewing industry.
RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead, develop, and coach supervisors, leads, and warehouse associates; set performance expectations and accountability standards.
Foster a culture of safety, teamwork, professionalism, and continuous improvement.
Ensure compliance with OSHA, company safety policies, GMP, HACCP, FSMA, and environmental and facility regulations.
Lead safety meetings, observations, near-miss reporting, investigations, and root cause analyses.
Facilitate and/or conduct all required employee training, including forklift and safety certification programs.
Oversee all warehouse activities, including receiving, put-away, storage, inventory control, picking, packing, shipping, and returns.
Monitor labor productivity, equipment utilization, and warehouse capacity to meet service level requirements.
Coordinate transportation and logistics activities with internal and external partners.
Manage staffing levels, scheduling, workforce planning, performance reviews, employee development, and corrective actions.
Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counts, audits, and reconciliation; investigate discrepancies and implement corrective actions.
Manage stock levels to meet customer demand while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory, and partner with Supply Chain Planning and Procurement on inventory strategy.
Develop and manage operating budgets; control labor, transportation, warehouse, and operating expenses.
Support EBITDA and profitability objectives by finding ways to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
Ensure products are handled, stored, and shipped according to quality standards, and achieve order accuracy and on-time delivery targets.
Lead investigations and corrective actions related to customer complaints, quality incidents, and non-conformances.
Use Lean, Six Sigma, and Root Cause Analysis methods to improve processes and drive warehouse optimization initiatives.
Implement best practices and standard operating procedures; lead change management and employee engagement efforts.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

5+ years of direct warehouse distribution management experience, including a demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and mentor employees.
Proven ability to create and operate within budget guidelines.
Knowledge of and experience ensuring compliance with OSHA, DOT HAZMAT, and HACCP regulations.
Warehouse Management System and/or ERP software experience required; Microsoft Dynamics D365 F&O experience preferred.
Experience with cycle count methods and full physical inventory counts.
Material handling and equipment maintenance experience.
Experience facilitating effective employee training.
Experience in a production environment preferred.
Lean/Six Sigma certification and 5S practices are a plus.
Ability to embrace and lead change in a fast-paced environment, and to use sound judgment where there are no formal guidelines.
Ability to multi-task while keeping high attention to detail.
Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
Must be able to obtain forklift certification and operate a forklift and other equipment as needed.
Passion for the craft brewing and malting industry is a plus.
Computer Skills: Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, WMS/ERP software

EDUCATION
4-year relevant college degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
WORK ENVIRONMENT
Standard warehouse environment, including variable temperatures and humidity. The role requires being on your feet for 8+ hours per day, going up and down stairs, ladders, and steps, and sitting and standing for long periods. Must be able to comfortably lift and carry up to 55 lbs. Required personal protective equipment must be worn and all safety protocols followed. Regular travel is not required.
COMPENSATION
We offer a competitive compensation and generous benefits package including extended healthcare, flex spending accounts, EAP, paid holidays, paid time off program, basic & voluntary life insurance, STD, LTD, and pension plan.
Recruitment Statement
Soufflet Malt is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and equitable workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment and selection process. Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process. Candidates requiring accommodation are encouraged to advise us of their needs so that appropriate arrangements can be made.

title: Summer 2027 – Quantum Research & Development Intern (Master's)
description:
Nice to meet you!

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence – and questions into answers.

If you’re looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you’ll find it here. We’re recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

What you’ll do

Looking for *that* internship? The game-changing one that’ll help you learn, grow, and chart your path forward? You’ll find it at SAS. Our interns aren’t coffee runners – they do real, meaningful work. Our award-winning internship program is focused on development, culture, and community. We’ll help you grow professionally, find (or further) your passion, and make memorable connections that last beyond the summer.

As an intern supporting the quantum development team at SAS, you’ll contribute to research and development in quantum algorithms, hybrid quantum-classical approaches, product development, and customer pilot projects as part of the team's efforts to transform quantum research into production-level features.

As an intern, you might:

  • Research quantum computing algorithms, methods, and applications
  • Develop, test, and benchmark hybrid quantum-classical algorithms
  • Prototype promising quantum approaches for future SAS products
  • Work with the quantum development team on real-world customer projects and engagements
  • Contribute to the development, testing, and advancement of SAS Quantum Lab

Required Qualifications

  • You’re a Master's level student studying Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Physics, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline; not graduating prior to December 2027
  • Strong programming skills, including Python
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Strong foundation in linear algebra, optimization, machine learning, or numerical methods
  • Ability to read research papers, translate ideas into working prototypes, and communicate technical results clearly.
  • You’re curious, passionate, authentic and accountable. These are Our SAS Values and influence everything we do.
  • Strong communication skills - both written and verbal
  • Leadership abilities. Your past experiences demonstrate you’ll take initiative and go above and beyond the call of duty.
  • You are interested in the future of Analytics and embrace technology.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of quantum computing, quantum algorithms, or hybrid quantum-classical methods

  • Experience with quantum software frameworks, SDKs, or hardware platforms

  • Research experience in one or more of the following: machine learning, mathematical optimization, numerical methods, scientific computing, or quantum information

  • Experience prototyping, benchmarking, or evaluating new algorithms

  • Ability to communicate complex technical ideas clearly

Location

  • This position is located in Cary HQ (hybrid). You must be local to Cary HQ and willing to come to the office.

Timeline

  • Interviews begin: On a rolling basis
  • Internship: May 18, 2027 – August 6, 2027 (These dates are not flexible. To be considered for the SAS Summer Internship program, all interns must be available to start in person at Cary HQ on May 18, 2027. Summer internships last 12 weeks.

Perks of the job

  • Work with (and learn from) the best. As a SAS intern, you’ll get face time with company leaders and executives.
  • Hybrid work flexibility: Our hybrid approach offers the best of both worlds, combining in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work remotely, aligned with your team’s needs (minimum of 3 days in the office per week).
  • Free SAS programming training and certification.
  • Your well-being matters. We support all dimensions of your well-being with programs designed to reduce stress and distractions so you can stay healthy and productive. This includes an on-site Work/Life Center, Recreation and Fitness Center, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), subsidized cafés and more.
  • We work hard, but we like to have fun, too. Enjoy hackathons, social events and other opportunities to connect and engage.

You are welcome here.

At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.

Additional Information

To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States, and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status. SAS is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by law. Read more: Know Your Rights.

Resumes may be considered in the order they are received. SAS employees performing certain job functions may require access to technology or software subject to export or import regulations. To comply with these regulations, SAS may obtain nationality or citizenship information from applicants for employment. SAS collects this information solely for trade law compliance purposes and does not use it to discriminate unfairly in the hiring process.

SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact Recruitingsupport@sas.com.

Pay transparency: Hourly rates for SAS internships are based on an applicant’s year in school and the role they are hired into. Rates range from $15 to $30 per hour for associate and bachelor’s-level positions and from $29 to $49 per hour for master’s and Ph.D positions. Internship roles are not eligible for bonuses.

Do you want work that makes a meaningful difference in your community? Easterseals PORT Health is seeking Child Placement Coordinator to join our Child Placement team in Craven, Pamlico & Jones counties in North Carolina!

The Child Placement Coordinator functions primarily as coordinator of placement services for children receiving treatment foster care. Responsibilities include supervision of foster parents, intake, casework, service planning, and planning/coordinating the services and resources affecting children and their families.

What You’ll Do:
Service Delivery Responsibilities:
  • Advocates for personal outcomes for children and primary/birth families, adhering to best practices.
  • Coordinates referrals for placements and receives all necessary paperwork prior to service delivery.
  • Coordinates admission and discharge planning with respective contracted agencies including completion of required documents prior to placement and conducts an initial visit with the child within 48 hours (72 hours for emergency weekend placements).
  • Responding to calls, emails, and other correspondence promptly (within 24 hours).
  • Communicates with collateral agency representatives regarding child/family status including medication changes, residential situation, staff changes, school performance, incidents. etc. (within 24 hours).
  • Coordinates and oversees initial and ongoing assessment activities.
  • Facilitates person centered planning and child & family team meetings. Develops initial and ongoing revisions of person-centered plan and monitor the implementation of person-centered plan.
  • Links children/adolescents/families to additional services, arranges for referrals, and completes application forms to access needed services in the community.
  • Attends community appointments as needed. Transports individuals being served, as needed.
  • Documents all interactions, meetings, supervisions, and other contacts in electronic health record.
  • Keeps supervisor informed of clinical and administrative issues relating to service delivery.
  • Participates in on-call rotation for routine and emergency situations. Responds to emergency/crisis situations as needed during the day, night, holidays and weekends. Maintains a caseload of 6-7.
  • IAFT, 10-11 TFC, or 13-16 FF children (or combination thereof) for a FT position.
  • Must demonstrate Easter Seals valued behaviors of Accountability, Commitment and Caring.
  • Performs related duties as requested.

Supervisory Responsibilities:
  • Provides direct supervision to Foster Families. Visits each therapeutic family weekly. A minimum of two visits per month must be in person in the foster home, the remaining two can be done virtually (i.e. via zoom). Visits each family foster home at least monthly in person in the foster home.
  • Addresses issues or concerns related to the Foster Parent's performance of the expectations outlined in their Foster Parent Agreement.
  • Supervises and monitors the documentation requirements for Foster Parents.
  • Maintains professional relationship and appropriate boundaries with foster parents under supervision.
  • Provides additional required training to Treatment Parents prior to placing an Intensive Alternative Family Treatment level child in the home.
  • Makes daily contact with Treatment Parents for Intensive Alternative Family Treatment level children.
  • Completes Foster Parent pay documentation within the required timeframes for processing of parent pay.

Compliance Responsibilities:
  • Assures adherence to Client Rights and Confidentiality Rules and ensures foster parents under supervision understand and adhere to Client Rights and Confidentiality rules.
  • Enters all required information into electronic health record and maintains electronic health record in accordance with NC DSS Administrative Rule lOA NC 70 and DMA documentation standards.
  • Reviews documentation to ensure that all notes are entered into the electronic health record within 48 hours of service date, goals/objectives as outlined in service plan are worked on, and documentation meets Medicaid guidelines.
  • Reviews foster parent notes a minimum of 3 times per week to ensure all documentation is reviewed within 48 hours and approved in time for weekly billing cut off.
  • Reviews paperwork and medication orders and uploads by the 10th of each month for the month prior.
  • Ensures all required electronic data is complete, correct, and entered into Client Care Web within required timelines for Intensive Alternative Family Treatment level children.
  • Assures authorizations and re-authorizations are submitted accurately at least 14 days prior to the expiration of the prior authorization.
  • Ensures all documentation in electronic health record is complete and signed within 5 days of occurrence.
  • Ensures incident reports are completed and filed within the 72-hour deadline.
  • Attends and participates in required trainings, seminars, workshops within prescribed timeframes.
  • Follows all ESUCP Policies and Procedures.

What You Bring:
We’re looking for someone who brings the experience, skills, and commitment needed to succeed in this role.
  • Bachelor's degree in social work from a college or university accredited by an entity approved by USDOE or CHEA; or.
  • Bachelor's degree in a human services field from a college or university accredited by an entity approved by USDOE or CHEA plus one year directly related experience; or.
  • Bachelor's degree in a non-human service-related field from a college or university accredited by an entity approved by USDOE or CHEA plus two years directly related experience.
  • Outstanding oral and written communication skills including clarity and articulation of thought, appropriate grammar, style, form and punctuation.
  • Valid and unrestricted state appropriate driver’s license.
  • Must have reliable transportation and the ability to transport self.
  • Previous experience within Foster Care and/or teaching a plus.

Why Join Easterseals PORT Health?
Easterseals PORT Health is a trusted and compassionate organization providing disability, mental health, and substance use services across North Carolina and Virginia. Purpose, dedication, and empathy guide the way we support our neighbors and one another.

What We Offer:
  • Competitive hourly pay based on experience.
  • Flexible scheduling that supports work-life balance.
  • Community-based work with the opportunity to build meaningful relationships with families.
  • Company-provided technology, including a laptop, phone, and hotspot.
  • Mileage reimbursement for applicable travel.
  • Ongoing opportunities for professional growth and development.

About Easterseals PORT Health:
Easterseals PORT Health helps people with disabilities, mental health and/or substance use challenges, their families, and our employees embrace their potential, access opportunities, build resilience and thrive. Purpose, dedication, and empathy drive our in-person and telehealth service delivery.

Our 2,800-member team provides more than 10.2 million hours of meaningful support to 40,200 children, adults, and families in 11,000 home, facility, and community locations across North Carolina and Virginia.
Easterseals PORT Health is an Inclusive Culture, Different Voices, Embracing Potential, Authentic Self, and Learning and Growing.

title: Emergency Medical Technician - Day Shift
description:
WorkCare is looking to hire a full-time EMT (Basic or Advanced) to join our onsite occupational health clinic at a meat processing facility in Guymon, Oklahoma.

Schedule: 5:00 AM – 5:00 PM | 3 days per week (36 hours).

Are you an EMT looking to use your skills outside of traditional EMS? Do you enjoy helping others and making a difference in the workplace? Are you looking for a consistent schedule, great benefits, and the opportunity to expand your clinical experience? If so, WorkCare may be the right fit for you!

Here's Why You'll Love Working for WorkCare:
  • Work-Life Balance! Enjoy a consistent schedule working just three days per week.
  • Competitive Pay! Earn $27.00–$29.00/hour based on experience and qualifications.
  • Sign On Bonus! Receive a $1,500 sign-on bonus.
  • Great Benefits! Medical, dental, vision, paid time off, 401(k), and more.
  • Make an Impact! Play an important role in keeping employees healthy, safe, and productive.
  • Professional Growth! Gain valuable experience in occupational health while working alongside healthcare and safety professionals.
  • Variety! No two days are exactly alike. From injury assessments and first aid to occupational health testing and employee wellness, you'll have the opportunity to use a wide range of your clinical skills.

What You'll Be Doing:
  • Provide onsite medical care, injury and illness assessments, first aid, and treatment within your EMT scope of practice and established clinical guidelines.
  • Perform injury and illness triage, assessment, and support for employees onsite and, as appropriate, by telephone for Animal Operations.
  • Communicate with the Occupational Health Nurse Manager and client's Workers' Compensation Director regarding work-related injuries and illnesses.
  • Assist with workers' compensation claims, injury and illness management, documentation, and return-to-work processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of work-related injuries and illnesses in CCMSI's ICE system and the Cority electronic medical record (EMR).
  • Partner with Human Resources and client leadership regarding employee work restrictions, absences, and return-to-work clearances.
  • Perform occupational health and regulatory testing, including respiratory evaluations, spirometry, audiometry, vision testing, urine testing, immunizations, and heat stress evaluations, as trained and authorized within scope of practice.
  • Conduct drug and alcohol testing in accordance with client policies.
  • Assist with First Aid, CPR, AED, and other employee training as needed.
  • Provide preventive health and wellness education to employees.
  • Maintain clinic utilization reports, medical supplies, and general clinic operations.
  • Communicate with the Clinic Medical Director, Regional Account Manager, and client representatives as needed.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For:
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Active Oklahoma EMT-Basic or EMT-Advanced certification/license required.
  • Current BLS/CPR certification for Healthcare Providers.
  • Previous experience in a healthcare setting, urgent care, or emergency department preferred.
  • Experience with electronic medical records preferred.
  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain patient privacy and confidentiality.
  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with clinic staff, supervisors, and client teams.
  • Strong time management skills and dependable attendance.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Windows, and the ability to learn additional software systems.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment:
  • Ability to sit for extended periods, with occasional standing, walking, bending, stretching, stooping, kneeling, and crouching.
  • Ability to lift or move up to 50 pounds and climb stairs.
  • Ability to kneel for extended periods while providing emergency care or CPR.
  • Manual dexterity and ability to use computers, phones, and other office equipment.
  • Work is primarily performed in an indoor, climate-controlled clinic or office environment with moderate noise levels.

Compensation & Benefits:
The hourly pay range for this position is $27.00–$29.00/hour. Actual compensation offered will depend on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and qualifications.

WorkCare offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:
  • Pro-rated paid time off (PTO).
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Critical illness insurance.
  • HSA, HRA, and FSA options.
  • Life and disability insurance.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Legal and identity theft coverage.
  • Pet insurance and additional voluntary benefits.

Ready to Join WorkCare?
If you're an EMT looking for an opportunity to use your clinical skills in an occupational health setting, enjoy a consistent schedule, and make a meaningful impact on employee health and safety, we encourage you to apply today!

The preceding statements describe the general responsibilities and qualifications of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily, accurately, and safely.

title: Associate Program Manager - Early Career
location: Milford, Massachusetts, United States; Boston, Massachusetts, United States
description:
Job Title: Associate Program Manager – Early Career

Employment Type: Full-Time

FSLA: Salary/Exempt

Division: Human Resources

Department: Talent Acquisition

Reports To: Sr. Program Manager, Early Career

Supervisory Duties: Yes

Salary Range: $90,000 - $120,000

Job Description

The Early Career Associate Program Manager will lead and manage Consigli’s outreach, engagement, and recruitment efforts with universities and educational institutions. This role is responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive early career program designed to attract top talent for entry-level positions. The Associate Program Manager will collaborate with internal stakeholders, the University Relations team, and academic partners to strengthen Consigli’s campus presence and create meaningful opportunities for students to connect with the company.

Responsibilities / Essential Functions

  • Recruitment Strategy & Execution:Proactively build a diverse, consistent pipeline of qualified candidates for entry-level positions across the company.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead and mentor the Early Career team, providing guidance and support to ensure efficient and effective hiring processes. Foster an environment of collaboration and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Talent Sourcing & Networking: Build and maintain relationships with external resources, educational institutions, and professional organizations. Leverage various sourcing channels, including job boards, social media, and industry events, to attract top talent.
  • University Partnerships & Engagement: Cultivate strong relationships with universities, colleges, and academic departments, focusing on engineering, construction management, architecture, and related fields.
  • Campus Recruiting, Events & Outreach: Lead campus recruiting at targeted universities, including career fairs, networking events, information sessions, student workshops, and panel discussions. Partner with the University Relations team and faculty and staff on outreach.
  • Employer Branding & Awareness: Work with the marketing team to strengthen Consigli’s employer brand and visibility on campus, communicating its values, culture, and career opportunities to students, faculty, and career services departments.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with senior leaders, hiring managers, and department heads to understand their staffing needs and develop tailored recruitment plans. Provide expert guidance on best practices for interviewing, selection, and candidate engagement.
  • Metrics & Reporting: Track and report on program effectiveness, recruiting results, and candidate quality, using data to continuously optimize programs.
  • Continuous Learning & Market Trends: Stay informed of industry trends, university programs, and student engagement best practices through relevant professional organizations and networks.

Key Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels.
  • Exceptional prioritization and time management skills, with a proven ability to manage multiple projects at once and excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to translate business and workforce needs into scalable, engaging early career experiences and campus partnerships.
  • Analytical mindset with experience using metrics, feedback, and insights to evaluate impact and improve programs.
  • Commitment to inclusive talent practices and delivering high-quality participant and manager experience.
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable working across functions, regions, and levels of the organization.

Required Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business administration or a related field
  • Five or more years of experience in early careers, university relations, talent programs, talent acquisition, or human resources.
  • Proven success in managing relationships with academic institutions and executing campus recruiting strategies.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and experience using applicant tracking systems, to track activity and outcomes.

title: Study Director for Pharmacology PM
description:
Biocytogen Boston Corp is seeking a highly motivated and versatile Pharmacology Scientist to support both in vivo and in vitro preclinical research services in the fields of immunology, immuno-oncology, metabolic disease and neurology. This role is ideal for candidates with broad expertise in pharmacological studies, disease model development, and cell-based assays, who are passionate about evaluating novel therapeutic agents for clients.

The successful candidate will be a critical member of our fast-paced and expanding CRO team, actively engaging in both hands-on experimental work and strategic project management to support biotech and pharmaceutical partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage multiple client-sponsored preclinical pharmacology projects, ensuring timely execution, scientific quality, and successful delivery of study objectives.
  • Collaborate with clients to develop and optimize in vivo study designs, including pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics (PK/PD), biodistribution, efficacy, and toxicology studies across various therapeutic areas.
  • Oversee the planning, coordination, and execution of preclinical in vivo studies involving a range of therapeutic modalities, including biologics, small molecules, cell therapies, and gene therapies.
  • Analyze and interpret preclinical study data, ensuring accurate reporting and providing scientific insights to support clients' drug discovery and development programs.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, facilitating effective communication and collaboration with internal scientific teams and external partners to ensure project alignment and client satisfaction.
  • Support the development and optimization of preclinical disease models, study methodologies, and scientific capabilities to meet evolving research and client needs.
  • Ensure studies are conducted in compliance with applicable regulatory guidelines, Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) protocols, and internal standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Assist in the development, review, and implementation of IACUC protocols and other study-related documentation to ensure scientific rigor, regulatory compliance, and animal welfare.

Requirements

  • PhD in pharmacology, immunology, cancer biology, or related biomedical field.
  • Cross-functional knowledge across therapeutic areas is a plus.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and team collaboration skills with the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage projects and work with cross-functional teams.
  • This is a fully onsite position based at our office in Waltham, Massachusetts.

Benefits

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Health Reimbursement Accounts
  • Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Short & Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Sick Days & Holidays

title: Rotating Equipment Engineer: Compressors & Steam Turbines
description:

The candidate will mentor junior engineers, develop innovative solutions, and maintain engineering standards in collaboration with the RED division.

Provide technical consultations for equipment including dynamic (e.g. centrifugal), positive displacement (e.g. reciprocating) compressors, gearboxes and steam turbines. Involve in specifying and reviewing equipment designs, selections, ratings and specifications for new projects including existing equipment modifications. Maintain and improve the company compressors, gearboxes and steam turbines standards. Develop/introduce new technologies/innovative ideas to address business challenges or/and enhance equipment reliability/availability/performance. Lead in developing and recommending solutions to solve plant machinery technical issues. Provide work direction, technical advice and mentoring to teammates and junior engineers. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized and approved program. At least 20 years’ experience in Rotating Equipment focusing on compressors and steam turbines within refineries, chemical plants, gas plants or similar facilities. Experience analyzing performance, troubleshooting, selecting, and repair of process gas compressors, steam turbines and gearboxes including auxiliary components such as seals, bearings and lube oil systems. Detailed knowledge of international codes and API standards related to rotating equipment with more focus on compressors, steam turbines and gearboxes. Category II vibration analyst certification. Submit at least two recent engineering reports or case histories on the subject of rotating equipment authored by you. These reports shall include Compressors and Steam Turbines problems.

title: Medical Field Manager
description:
Karo Healthcare, a dynamic and growing personal-care retail company, is all about making smart choices for everyday healthcare. With a wide-ranging portfolio across seven categories including medical products, we own and sell over 80 brands in about 90 countries. Our portfolio includes such brands as E45, Pevaryl, Lamisil, Nutravita, Decubal and many others. Our core belief in empowering people to make intelligent health decisions drives our growth strategy, blending organic expansion and M&A.

Join us at Karo Healthcare on our exciting journey. We're currently looking for a Medical Field Manager – Finland for our office in Espoo.

What’s in it for you?

Shape the medical strategy behind trusted healthcare brands. In this highly visible role, you will combine scientific expertise, strategic thinking and hands-on execution to strengthen HCP engagement, develop KOL partnerships and support the growth of Karo’s portfolio in Finland and across the Nordics.

You’ll work closely with healthcare professionals, commercial teams and Nordic stakeholders in a fast-moving international environment—while having the autonomy to turn medical insights into meaningful action.

What you’ll be doing

  • Develop and execute strategic HCP and stakeholder engagement plans to support the growth of Karo’s portfolio, including base creams and other healthcare products.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare professionals, KOLs, advisory boards and other relevant medical stakeholders.
  • Plan and deliver HCP engagement activities, including scientific meetings, congresses, webinars, events and speaker programmes.
  • Identify, gather and communicate medical and market insights to support local execution and the wider Nordic medical strategy.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with commercial, marketing, regulatory and other internal teams, providing medical input to projects, materials and activities.
  • Set medical field activity and visit targets, and coordinate the medical field team to support future growth.
  • Lead weekly hands-on calls, team meetings, co-travel days and joint meetings with local commercial teams.
  • Plan and organise regional training programmes together with the medical field team.
  • Identify key opinion leaders and develop plans to deepen collaboration through local KOL programmes.
  • Adapt Nordic materials to local market conditions and target-group needs, ensuring clear, scientifically robust claims and effective HCP communication.
  • Develop and maintain the KaroPro portal for healthcare professionals.
  • Manage approved activities within agreed budgets and Karo’s compliance requirements.
  • Escalate relevant medical insights, unmet needs and market opportunities to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Represent Karo’s values in all professional interactions, collaborations and decisions.

Requirements

  • Advanced academic degree in life sciences, such as an MSc in Pharmacy, an MD or another relevant scientific qualification.
  • Significant experience in the pharmaceutical, consumer healthcare or related industry, ideally within Medical Affairs, Scientific Affairs, Regulatory Affairs or a comparable senior role.
  • Strong experience working with pharmaceutical products; experience with medical devices, cosmetics or consumer healthcare products is highly desirable.
  • Experience working across Nordic markets and within a matrixed international organisation.
  • An established HCP and KOL network in Finland.
  • Strong ability to assess scientific evidence, evaluate claims and translate complex information into clear recommendations and action plans.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence and engage diverse audiences.
  • Strategic mindset with the confidence to challenge the status quo and identify new opportunities.
  • Analytical and commercially minded approach, with the ability to turn data and insights into practical actions.
  • Comfortable moving between strategic planning and hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent written and spoken Finnish and English. Additional Nordic-language skills are an advantage.

Benefits

  • Opportunity to create, grow and encourage.
  • A competitive salary package and strong opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • Flexible working arrangements and a healthy work–life balance.
  • Responsibility for exciting, challenging projects with a direct and visible impact on customers and the healthcare industry.
  • A positive, collaborative working environment with a young, international and motivated team.
  • A start-up spirit combined with the stability, resources and strong values of a larger international organisation.

Karo Healthcare has a diverse and inclusive environment. We welcome qualified candidates irrespective of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, religion, national origin, disability or age.

(1) a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record;
(2) the ability to lift up to 100 lbs; and
