description:
ADENTIS Italia è alla ricerca di un Cloud & Security Engineer da inserire nel team, per un progetto nel settore della comunicazione sicura. La risorsa progetterà, implementerà e metterà in sicurezza infrastrutture cloud, garantendo resilienza, conformità e protezione dei dati.

Requisiti principali: laurea magistrale in Ingegneria o Informatica, almeno 3 anni di esperienza, competenze su IaaS/KaaS, Proxmox/OpenStack/OpenShift, Docker/Kubernetes, sicurezza (SIEM, IAM, DLP) e CI/CD.

Progettare, implementare e mettere in sicurezza infrastrutture cloud. Garantire resilienza, conformità normativa e protezione dei dati. Contribuire a pratiche CI/CD e gestione della sicurezza. Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria o Informatica. Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in ruoli cloud e security. Esperienza con ambienti IaaS e orchestratori e gestione sicurezza.

title: Senior Systeem- & Cloud Engineer
description:
Als Senior Systeem- & Cloud Engineer ben jij het technische fundament en het baken van rust binnen de IT-infrastructuur van Groenhuysen. Of je nu de stap maakt vanuit een rol als ervaren systeembeheerder, netwerkbeheerder, cloudbeheerder of netwerk engineer: in deze nieuwe sleutelrol haal jij de technische regie steviger naar binnen. Je overziet het grotere geheel, bewaakt onze architectuur en kiest principieel voor duurzame kwaliteit boven haastige ‘quick and dirty’ oplossingen. Zo zorg jij voor een veilige, stabiele digitale werkomgeving waarmee onze zorgcollega’s dagelijks het verschil maken voor ouderen in de regio.

Je combineert diepgaande hands-on expertise met regie en coaching:

  • Cloud, Identity & Continuïteit: Je bewaakt de performance, lifecycle en kosten (FinOps) van onze hybride omgeving (Azure, Entra ID, Windows Server, SQL Server, Intune en Google Workspace), borgt aantoonbare back-up- en restore tests en adviseert over Identity & Access-vraagstukken.

  • Netwerken & Regie op de MSP: Het 24/7 operationele beheer ligt bij onze externe MSP; jij bent hun inhoudelijke sparringpartner op het gebied van enterprise-netwerken (switching, Wi-Fi, BLE, IoT en Fortinet). Je toetst hun kwaliteit en stuurt bij op nieuwe ontwikkelingen.

  • Security & Standaardisatie: Je vertaalt ons informatiebeveiligingsbeleid (NEN 7510) naar concrete hardening-maatregelen, coördineert pentests en analyseert SOC-meldingen. Daarnaast zet je standaarden en documentatie neer en coach je collega’s van de ICT Servicedesk en Informatisering om hiernaar te werken.

Waar ga je werken?

Je gaat aan de slag bij Groenhuysen, dé specialist in ouderenzorg in de regio Roosendaal en omstreken. Met ruim 2.300 medewerkers en 800 vrijwilligers zetten wij ons elke dag vol passie in om ouderen te ondersteunen bij het leiden van hun eigen leven, vanuit onze drijfveer: ‘Ouder worden, jezelf blijven’. Achter die zorg staat een moderne, complexe IT-omgeving die dag en nacht moet draaien en daar maak jij het verschil.

Je komt te werken binnen de informele en professionele afdeling Informatisering & Automatisering (I&A), die bestaat uit ruim 30 collega’s. Omdat dit een gloednieuwe interne sleutelrol is, krijg je alle ruimte om deze functie zelf vorm te geven en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van onze IT-organisatie. Je werkt met korte lijnen nauw samen met de Coördinator Servicedesk, de Adviseurs Informatiemanagement, de applicatiebeheerder van de technische applicaties en je collega’s van de ICT Servicedesk. Je rapporteert aan en adviseert de Manager I&A.

Nieuwsgierig of werken als Senior Systeem- & Cloud Engineer bij Groenhuysen iets voor jou is?

  • Opleiding & ervaring: Je hebt hbo werk- en denkniveau (ICT, Systeembeheer of Netwerkinfrastructuur) en minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een senior rol binnen een complexe IT-omgeving.

  • Microsoft & Cloud: Je hebt aantoonbare, diepgaande kennis van Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Azure, Entra ID en Intune (bij voorkeur met certificeringen zoals AZ-800/801/802, AZ-104 of MD-102). Ervaring met Google Cloud Platform en Google Workspace is een pré.

  • Databases & automatisering: Je hebt ruime ervaring met het technisch beheer van Microsoft SQL Server, identity governance en het automatiseren van beheertaken (bijv. met PowerShell).

  • Netwerken & Security: Je hebt stevige netwerkkennis (switching, routing, VLAN’s, Wi-Fi, BLE en IoT), bij voorkeur praktijkervaring met Fortinet (NSE 4/5/6) en bent bekend met normenkaders als NEN 7510 / ISO 27001 en ITIL.

  • Gestructureerd & kwaliteitsgericht: Je werkt uiterst zorgvuldig, documenteert secuur en combineert een scherpe analytische blik met oog voor duurzame architectuur.

  • Coachend & verbindend: Met jouw proactieve houding en sterke advies- en coachingsvaardigheden ben je een natuurlijke sparringpartner voor zowel interne collega’s als onze externe MSP.

Wil je meer weten over deze vacature? Neem gerust contact op met de collega’s van Werving & Selectie, ☏ 088-557 4220. Zij brengen jou graag met de juiste personen in contact!

Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

Bij Groenhuysen bieden we méér dan alleen een functie volgens de CAO VVT. Als Senior Systeem- & Cloud Engineer kom je terecht in een organisatie die oog heeft voor jouw welzijn, ontwikkeling en werkgeluk. We investeren in goede zorg én in onze medewerkers.

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van maximaal € 5.413,38 (CAO VVT, functiegroep 50-55) op basis van 36 uur. De schaal wordt bepaald op basis van opleiding en ervaring.

  • Een contract voor 36 uur per week, in ieder geval voor een jaar. Wil je langer blijven? Bij een positieve samenwerking, heel graag!

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering, vakantiegeld en pensioenregeling.

  • 6,5 week aan vakantiedagen op basis van 36 uur, daarvan zijn 12 vakantiedagen bovenwettelijk. Dit ‘verlofmandje’ is bedoeld om verlofuren te kunnen opnemen op feestdagen, bij calamiteiten, kort verzuimverlof of gewoon een extra dag vrij. Werk je minder dan 36 uur, dan krijg je vakantie-uren naar rato.

  • Een meerkeuzesysteem arbeidsvoorwaarden. Besteed je brutosalaris voordelig aan bijvoorbeeld een fiets, extra verlof, sportabonnement of mobiele middelen.

  • Een divers programma om jou fit en vitaal te houden. Vitaliteit staat namelijk hoog in het vaandel bij Groenhuysen.

  • Een actieve cultuur van waardering: we zien en erkennen jouw inzet.

  • Scholingsmogelijkheden. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan een leerplein met online en fysieke scholingen. Hiermee blijf je groeien in je vak én als persoon.

  • Een fijne, veilige werkplek met aandacht voor elkaar. We werken samen in teams met korte lijnen en veel vertrouwen.

  • Ruimte voor initiatief: jouw ideeën doen ertoe en worden gehoord.

title: AWS API Engineer - Multi-Region Python Lambda & DevOps
description:
iSystems Ltd seeks an experienced AWS Developer/Architect to design and implement scalable, secure cloud solutions using API Gateway and Lambda in Python. You will craft multi-region deployments, automate CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, and write DevOps code for infra automation.

A strong background in AWS services and architecture is required to ensure fault tolerance and high availability. Applicants should have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience,

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable AWS-based solutions. Develop REST APIs using API Gateway and Lambda functions, primarily in Python. Implement and optimize AWS deployment architectures for reliability and performance. Design, develop, and deploy multi-region solutions to ensure fault tolerance. Build and maintain Jenkins pipelines to automate development and deployment processes. Write and maintain DevOps code to support infra automation and deployments. Troubleshoot issues related to AWS services, integrations, and deployments. Stay updated with the latest AWS technologies, cloud architecture standards, and best practices. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field. 5+ years hands-on experience with AWS technologies. Proficient in developing REST APIs using API Gateway and Lambda with Python. title: Sr. Lending and Collections Manager
description:
The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei, the Canadian fintech company accelerating the business of clients around the world. Nuvei's modular, flexible and scalable technology allows leading companies to accept next-gen payments, offer all payout options and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 50 markets, 150 currencies and 700 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally with one integration.

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Senior Lending & Collections Manager to lead and optimize our consumer lending, underwriting, indirect lending, and credit card operations. In this role, you will be responsible for driving revenue through our Lending and Collections partnerships and direct merchants, managing a team of business development managers, and ensuring successful partner/merchant enablement and activation. You will be responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance, enhancing operational efficiency, and delivering exceptional support experiences. This position requires a strong combination of lending expertise, leadership capabilities, and a passion for continuous improvement.

Your Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

• Oversee day-to-day operations for our lending and collections team

• Ensure consistency, efficiency, and quality throughout the lending/collections processing lifecycle.

• Monitor lending performance, portfolio trends, and key performance indicators to ensure achievement of organizational goals.

• Implement process improvements to enhance turnaround times, operational effectiveness, and partner/merchant satisfaction.

• Partner with internal departments to ensure smooth execution of sales initiatives and partner success.

• Work closely with Marketing to align on campaigns, content updates, and event planning.

Leadership & Development

• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, service excellence, and continuous improvement.

• Provide ongoing training and product knowledge to lending/collections staff.

Underwriting & Risk Management

• Develop and maintain underwriting policies, procedures, and decisioning standards.

• Ensure merchant account approvals and processing activities align with Nuvei policies and regulatory requirements.

• Monitor portfolio quality and implement corrective actions when necessary.

Compliance & Quality Assurance

• Ensure compliance with all applicable consumer lending regulations and credit reporting requirements.

• Oversee quality assurance programs, loan file reviews, and operational audits.

Merchant & Partner Relationships

• Support and oversee indirect/direct lending relationships lending and collections partners and LMS software partners.

• Review partner performance reports and ensure alignment with established standards.

• Conduct regular partner business reviews, track KPIs, and report on team and partner performance.

Performance & Reporting

• Develop and maintain operational reporting to measure production, portfolio growth, service levels, and credit quality.

• Conduct regular business reviews and provide recommendations to executive leadership regarding lending/collections performance and strategic opportunities.

Industry & Market Awareness

• Monitor competitive trends, market conditions, and lending/collections industry developments.

• Recommend enhancements to products, programs, and commercial strategies to support organizational growth and partner/merchant needs.

Requirements

· Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

· 7 years of experience ISV/ISO partner management, business development, or sales leadership within ERP, SaaS, or integrated payments.

· Strong knowledge of consumer lending operations, underwriting, indirect lending, and credit card processing management.

· Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams.

· Experience developing lending policies, procedures, and operational controls.

· Strong understanding of consumer lending regulations, compliance requirements, and credit reporting practices.

· Excellent analytical, communication, and decision-making skills.

· Demonstrated project management and process improvement experience.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and service quality.

Benefits

  • Competitive holiday allowance
  • 401K Matching program
  • Group Insurance Benefits
  • Remote working model
  • Employee Assistance Program

Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can’t wait to meet you.

Working Language
English (written and spoken) is the language used most of the time, as work colleagues, clients, and strategic suppliers are geographically dispersed.

Our recruitment process may use automated tools, including AI, to support application management and candidate shortlisting.

title: Pricing Analyst (6 Month Fixed Term Contract)
location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
description:

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Non-Bulk Fuel Product Price Updates

Bulk Fuel Product Price Updates

title: Pool Maintenance and Repair Technician
company: America's Swimming Pool Co. - Wesley Chapel
location: Wesley Chapel - Pasco Co, FL, US
description:
Benefits:
  • Company car
  • Paid time off
  • Training & development
ASP – America’s Swimming Pool Company is America’s premier swimming pool service company. We have been operating for over 15 years with an outstanding reputation. We pride ourselves on providing "resort quality pool services". To do this we have built a team of dedicated, enthusiastic technicians who enjoy delivering resort-quality service and treating our customers with the utmost respect.
Our Mission: At ASP, we create superior value for our customers in all that we do by leveraging technology, higher standards, knowledge and the relentless pursuit of excellence.
Because of our approach, we have earned loyal customers who expect and desire dependable, quality swimming pool solutions. We guarantee satisfaction with our services and do not require long-term contracts. We are fully licensed and insured and our team members are among the best in the swimming pool service industry.
We continue to grow and are seeking a solution-oriented and customer-focused Pool Maintenance and Repair Technician to join our team. This position is responsible for providing excellent on-site pool cleaning and pool maintenance services to each and every customer they are assigned. This includes following our proven pool cleaning methods and handling pool chemicals in a controlled and safe manner. This position is also responsible for diagnosing issues with the swimming pool equipment and providing solutions. This includes following our proven process for diagnosing issues, successfully communicating alternative solutions to the customer, completing the solution in an efficient manner and following all established protocols and sharing lessons learned with the rest of our team.
The ideal person for this position will love to work outdoors. They will be a self-­ starter who has the ability to work independently with minimal oversight and guidance. They will handle all matters with integrity and embrace the concept and requirements of delivering "resort-quality service".
You are applying for work with a franchisee of ASP America’s Swimming Pool Company, not ASP Franchising SPE, LLC or any of its affiliates. If hired, the franchisee will be your only employer. Franchisees are independent business owners who are solely responsible for their own employees.
Responsibilities:
Success in this position will be determined by the following measurable results:
  • Manage a swimming pool route that includes cleaning of swimming pools each week and manage a daily schedule of equipment repair tasks;
  • The ability to manage a stocking of chemicals on the truck and properly adjust the water chemistry for each pool each week.
  • Repair of pool pumps, heaters, filters, timers, pool cleaners, blowers, lights, automated pool systems, chlorinators, backwash valves, PVC plumbing, copper plumbing, and galvanized plumbing
  • Knowledge of 110 volt and 220 volt electrical equipment (preferred, not required)
  • The ability to manage an inventory of equipment on the truck and properly utilize and replenish the inventory when needed.
  • The ability to utilize a smart phone for our Pool Ops mobile platform.
  • The ability to spot opportunities outside of the repair call, such as upgrading other equipment or adding to the customer experience with other products.
  • Renovation experience – Re-plaster or equivalent (e.g., PebbleTech®), tile replacement/repair, deck texture/seal, pavers install/repair (preferred, not required)
We are specifically looking for an individual who demonstrates these behaviors consistent with the ASP way of doing business (our culture and values):
  • Acting with Integrity;
  • Superior Knowledge;
  • Passion for the Company;
  • Customer Focus;
  • Accountability and Discipline;
  • Respecting Others;
  • Excellence in ALL we do; and
  • Safety First at all Times.
Requirements:
Requirements for this position are that you have:
(1) a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record;
(2) the ability to lift up to 100 lbs
No other specific experience is required as we will teach you the ASP methods designed to give our customers superior value and to maximize your earning potential; however, a high school degree and Certified Pool Operator License is preferred.
Bonus Potential:
This position has the potential of earning an annual bonus by the company when specific gross revenue goals are met for the year.
Benefits:
A company truck will be provided which you keep fully stocked with tools and inventory.
Next Steps:
If you are interested in being considered for this position and joining our award-winning team, then we would encourage you to apply for this position.
We look forward to learning more about you as you go through our hiring process.

description:

title: Autobody Technician
description:
CSN is looking for a Licensed Auto Body Technicians to join our team. Our Auto Body Technician must be able to take a vehicle in a damaged state and repair or restore damaged vehicles to their original structural integrity, function, and appearance. The Incumbent is detailed oriented and can multitask to accommodate shifting priorities. The technician reports to the General Manager.

Primary Objectives of the Auto Body Technician:

  • Review work order and estimates of repair cost and plan work to be performed
  • Thoroughly examine collision damage (Review the complete vehicle exterior body parts, check all power accessories (door locks/windows/mirrors are operational) check that the dash panel has no warning lights on. Identify any prior damages overlooked on the QA checklist/ or related on the supplemental damage sheet.)
  • Performing structural and complete body repairs: Repair and replace front end components, body components, doors and frame and underbody components. (Assess, Repair or Replace interior and exterior parts, electrical components, and vehicle accessories, doors and frame and underbody components)
  • Straighten bent frames using frame and underbody pulling and anchoring equipment, Hammer out dents, buckles and other defects using blocks and hammers.
  • Welding on vehicles with the use of MIG welders and compression spot welders.
  • Fully dismantle the complete vehicle damaged areas including the blend panel parts in order to identify all hidden damages as early in the repair cycle as possible. For example remove damaged fenders, panels and grills using wrenches and cutting torch and bolt or weld replacement parts into place, repair or replace damaged windows, windshields and sunroof
  • Ability to file, grind and sand repaired surfaces, using power tools and hand tools
  • Operate soldering equipment or use plastic filler to fill holes, dents and seams
  • Follow all OEM Procedures using all data
  • Inspect repaired vehicles and test drive vehicles for proper handling
  • Technician must be able to read and understand the estimates.
  • Capable of reading and comprehending automotive repair procedures.
  • Able to work with a variety of metals and plastics, as well as glass, electrical, and mechanical parts.
  • Experience using frame and measuring equipment.
  • Experience with disassembly and reassembly of vehicles
  • Ability and willingness to follow standardized production processes.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Requirements

  • Auto Body Repair experience - 3+ years required
  • Auto Body Collision and Damage Repairer (310B) Red Seal License (310Q) (Preferred but not a must) or in a registered apprenticeship program.
  • Technicians with I-Car and OEM certifications are favorable.
  • I car Welding certification
  • Carrying, Lifting – 100 lbs, standing, sitting, walking, reaching)
  • Valid driver's license required
  • Must have own tools, safety footwear.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Benefits Package which includes: health, dental, vision
  • Paid time off
  • Growth Opportunities
  • Opportunities to be certified 310b, I-Car

title: Technician Quality Control
description:
Kerr Dental is seeking a Quality Assurance professional to review SOPs, test instructions and calibration procedures, and to finalize DHRs for medical devices in a regulated environment.

title: Notarieel Team Assistent Vastgoed
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Als notarieel team assistent ben je van begin tot eind betrokken bij de dossiers binnen dit team. Je ondersteunt niet alleen de juristen, maar draait inhoudelijk mee in het dossierproces en bewaakt de voortgang. Jij zorgt dat alles klopt, op tijd is en soepel verloopt.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het aanmaken en beheren van dossiers

  • Het opstellen en uitwerken van conceptdocumenten (zoals brieven, akten, volmachten en memo’s)

  • Het onderhouden van cliëntcontact en contact met andere betrokken partijen

  • Het bewaken van termijnen en dossierafspraken

  • Het verwerken van declaraties en dossieradministratie

Je werkt nauw samen met de notaris, kandidaat-notarissen en juridisch medewerkers in het team en bent een vaste, inhoudelijk betrokken schakel in het werkproces.

Waar ga je werken?

Je komt te werken binnen de sectie Overheid & Vastgoed in Arnhem, waar we samenwerken met grote opdrachtgevers. Ons team bestaat uit zo’n 80 collega’s, waaronder advocaten, (kandidaat-)notarissen, fiscalisten en juridisch medewerkers. Jij sluit je aan bij het notariële team van Ruben Berentsen: een enthousiaste en informele groep die houdt van aanpakken. We combineren juridische expertise met een praktische insteek en werken volledig digitaal.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een nauwkeurige, zelfstandige en proactieve assistent die overzicht houdt en graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor dossiers.

Verder:

  • Heb je een afgeronde mbo+/hbo-opleiding (bijvoorbeeld juridisch of vergelijkbaar) of relevante werkervaring

  • Werk je gestructureerd en ben je administratief én communicatief sterk

  • Vind je het leuk om (inhoudelijk) betrokken te zijn bij juridische dossiers

  • Ben je servicegericht en prettig in contact met cliënten en collega’s

  • Heb je affiniteit met of interesse in notarieel werk en vastgoed

Ervaring binnen het notariaat is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Belangrijker is dat je wilt leren, meedenkt en eigenaarschap toont.

Wat bieden we je?

Een uitdagende werkomgeving waar je op hoog niveau nauw samenwerkt met collega’s en cliënten. De sfeer binnen het team is positief en collegiaal. Daarnaast bieden we je:

  • Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid;

  • Een open cultuur en een informele sfeer;

  • De mogelijkheid om de functie parttime (4 dagen) in te vullen;

  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een winstdelingsregeling en een fietsregeling;

  • Collega’s die ook buiten werktijd gezellige dingen met elkaar doen;

  • Leuke events, zoals de wekelijkse vrijdagmiddagborrel, sectie-uitjes, bbq’s en een jaarlijkse cultuur- en skireis;

  • Een laptop en een vergoeding om een thuiswerkplek in te richten.

Een diploma- en/of referentiecheck maakt onderdeel uit van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

Heb je interesse in deze vacature? Dan willen wij je graag aanmoedigen om te solliciteren. Dirkzwager gelooft in gelijke kansen op de arbeidsmarkt voor iedereen. Wij zijn er namelijk van overtuigd dat we tot de mooiste resultaten komen als we verschillende persoonlijkheden, perspectieven en achtergronden samenbrengen in onze organisatie.

title: Staff Engineer – Electrical & Embedded Software
description:
Business Title: Staff Engineer – Electrical & Embedded Software
Reports to: Director of Engineering
Leadership Scope: Team Leader

Company Info: With a heritage of nearly 120 years, we aren’t just a company; we are a brand of trust. But more than anything, we are a collection of individuals who, together, give Grote Industries a decisive competitive advantage. At Grote, our shared vision is clear – to meet the needs of the customers we serve. We accomplish that mission every day by following a set of core values that makes us who we are.

Innovation has been the hallmark of Grote Industries from the start. From durable, easy to see stop lights to the latest in LED lighting technology, Grote has been leading the way in advanced vehicle system solutions from early in the last century right up to today. With these innovations, Grote has helped millions of people throughout North America and the world benefit from the innovation and design excellence of Grote products.

Position Summary: The Staff Engineer is the senior technical authority and team lead for Grote's Electrical and Embedded Software Engineers supporting OEM headlamp and signal lamp programs for the heavy-duty commercial vehicle market. This role owns the electrical and software architecture across the product portfolio, sets the team's technical standards and processes, and leads and mentors the team while remaining hands-on in the most complex design and problem-solving work.

Position Duties:

Leading a team of Electrical and Embedded Software Engineers: assigning and prioritizing work across programs, coaching and developing engineers, and supporting hiring, onboarding, and performance reviews.
Owning the electrical and embedded software architecture for lamp products, including LED driver topologies, protection circuits, controller selection, communication interfaces, and diagnostics, and driving platform reuse to reduce cost and development time.
Reviewing and approving PCBA schematics, PCB layouts, component and material selection, harness designs, drawings (including proper GD&T), and firmware releases.
Establishing and maintaining design, simulation, testing, and software development standards, including requirements traceability, coding standards, version control, code review, and release management.
Leading design reviews, DFMEA, worst-case analyses, and root cause investigations; overseeing circuit simulations, tolerance stack-ups, and thermal FEA/CFD.
Owning the thermal management strategy across hardware and software, including temperature sensing, firmware-controlled current derating, and verification that lamps maintain photometric compliance and LED lifetime under thermal limits.
Defining and overseeing validation testing for ESD, voltage transients, EMI/EMC, over/reverse voltage, thermal performance, and CAN/LIN communication.
Serving as the team's expert on FMVSS 108, UN Regulations (R10, R148–R150), SAE Lighting Systems Group, SAE J1939, ISO 11898, and applicable IEC, IPC, CISPR, and ISO standards.
Representing electrical and software engineering with OEM customers and supporting Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing, and Sales on production issues, sourcing, and quoting (including development effort and cost estimates).

Requirements: The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical, Electronics, or Computer Engineering or a related field, with 8–10+ years of electrical and/or embedded engineering experience in automotive or commercial vehicle electronics (headlamps and/or signal lamps preferred), including 3+ years leading engineers. Experience with PCB/PCBA and lamp manufacturing processes and strong communication and cross-functional leadership skills are essential. Specific relevant skills/experience are listed below:

Constant-current switch-mode and/or linear LED driver design, including thermal derating and protection
Mixed-signal design, circuit protection, EMC, ESD, and signal/power integrity
PCB layout and materials (FR4, aluminum metal core; ENIG, HASL finishes)
LTspice or similar, Altium Designer / Altium 365, and wiring harness design
Embedded C for microcontrollers; software best practices (Git, code review, testing); MISRA C and Automotive SPICE a plus
CAN/LIN (SAE J1939, ISO 11898), UART, I2C, and SPI GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, DFMEA, and root cause methods (8D, 5-Why)

Improve framework reliability, execution efficiency, and maintainability. Lead testing efforts across web, mobile-web, hybrid, and native mobile applications. Perform cross-browser and cross-platform testing across modern browsers and devices. Develop automation solutions for iOS and Android platforms. Validate mobile-specific functionalities including gestures, permissions, notifications, orientation changes, interruptions, and application upgrades. title: Scan-to-BIM Technician
description:
Position: Scan-to-BIM Technician

Salary: Php 70,000 to Php 90,000

Working Hours: Aligned with NZ Business Hours

Work Type: Independent Contractor

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The company is a specialist 3D reality capture, surveying, and digital modelling practice operating across New Zealand and Australia. Partnering with architects, engineers, property owners, and construction professionals, company documents existing buildings and environments utilizing terrestrial laser scanning, mobile LiDAR, drone photogrammetry, and BIM modelling. Their project portfolio spans residential, commercial, heritage, healthcare, industrial, and infrastructure sectors. They are currently seeking a skilled Scan-to-BIM Technician to join their growing production team.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

As a Scan-to-BIM Technician, you will be responsible for converting 3D laser scan point cloud data into accurate, well-organized as-built BIM models using Autodesk Revit and/or Graphisoft Archicad. Unlike conventional architectural design roles focused on new builds, this production-focused role centers on modelling existing buildings and structures directly from reality capture data. While comprehensive training will be provided to align your existing skillset with the company's high modelling standards and workflows, a solid foundational understanding of BIM modelling and Scan-to-BIM processes is essential from day one.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Produce accurate as-built 3D BIM models of existing buildings from registered 3D laser scan point cloud datasets.
  • Model core architectural and structural elements, including walls, floors, ceilings, roofs, doors, windows, stairs, and structural components.
  • Generate detailed 2D architectural documentation, including floor plans, elevations, sections, and reflected ceiling plans.
  • Interpret complex point cloud datasets, accurately identifying building geometry and resolving ambiguous or incomplete scan information.
  • Deliver models adhering strictly to project-specific Level of Detail (LOD) and Level of Information (LOI) requirements.
  • Maintain clean, structured BIM files using consistent naming conventions, families, layers, and classifications.
  • Perform rigorous quality assurance checks to verify that completed models faithfully represent the source point cloud data.
  • Collaborate and coordinate effectively with project managers and fellow technicians to meet project deadlines and quality benchmarks.

Requirements

  • Ideally 3+ years of relevant professional experience producing as-built BIM models directly from laser scan point cloud data.
  • Strong proficiency in Autodesk Revit and/or Graphisoft Archicad (expertise in one platform is required; proficiency in both is highly advantageous).
  • Demonstrated experience importing, navigating, and modelling from large point cloud datasets.
  • Solid background in civil engineering or architectural drafting, backed by a sound understanding of existing building construction, building elements, and construction documentation.
  • Proven ability to interpret complex architectural geometry, including irregular and heritage building conditions.
  • Strong command of BIM modelling standards, model organization, and 2D drawing production.
  • Clear, professional communication skills in English, with the ability to work autonomously and manage deadlines.


PREFERRED:

  • Experience using Autodesk Civil 3D.
  • Dual proficiency in both Autodesk Revit and Graphisoft Archicad.
  • Experience producing existing-condition models for architectural renovation, engineering, and heritage projects.
  • Familiarity with varying Levels of Detail (specifically LOD 200–350).
  • Experience modelling structural and MEP services from point cloud data.
  • Understanding of terrestrial surveying, laser scanning, and reality capture workflows.
  • Familiarity with Australian or New Zealand architectural documentation standards.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Hands-On Reality Capture Expertise: Direct experience working with laser scanning datasets rather than solely modelling from 2D CAD drawings or new-build designs.
  • Precision & Efficiency: High spatial awareness and a methodical approach that balances modelling speed with uncompromising geometric accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Autonomous Collaboration: Reliability and self-direction within a fast-paced, collaborative production environment.
  • Growth Mindset: A genuine interest in developing long-term expertise in reality capture and digital modelling technologies.

title: Professional Engineer
description:
Professional Engineer – Utilities (Structural & Tubular Steel)

About Us
V&S Schuler Utilities Group is a trusted leader in structural and tubular steel manufacturing, with locations in Ohio, Oklahoma, New Jersey, and Georgia. We combine a proud legacy of craftsmanship with an innovative, forward-looking approach to deliver high-quality, durable products that power critical industries.

Our team is known for its commitment to quality, safety, and a customer-first mindset. We offer a supportive, team-oriented environment where hard work is recognized, growth is encouraged, and your contributions make a real impact.

Position Overview

We are looking for a proactive and skilled Professional Engineer to join our team. In this full-time salaried position, you will be responsible for designing and analyzing tubular and structural steel structures used in electrical substations and transmission applications. Responsibilities will include the design of transmission structures, substation structures, foundations, overhead wire systems, and associated structural components.

You will ensure that all designs comply with applicable codes, industry standards, customer specifications, and project requirements while collaborating with customer representatives and internal Project Management, Engineering, Detailing, and Manufacturing Teams.

This position will play an important role in translating customer requirements and engineering specifications into practical, cost-effective designs that can be efficiently fabricated and delivered. The successful candidate will work closely with our manufacturing facilities to ensure designs consider structural performance, material efficiency, fabrication requirements, and overall product quality.
This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must have authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.
Key Responsibilities

Design and interpret drawings for transmission and substation structures and foundations per customer specifications and applicable design codes.
Perform structural analysis and engineering calculations for tubular and structural steel components, including poles, frames, support structures, equipment supports, platforms, and other utility infrastructure.
Evaluate structural loading conditions, including wind, ice, dead loads, and other applicable environmental and operational loading requirements.
Develop and review structural designs, connection details, and material specifications to ensure structural integrity, constructability, and compliance with applicable standards.
Review internal drawings to ensure compliance with specifications and codes.
Utilize PLS-Pole software for modeling and analysis of structures.
Utilize structural engineering software to analyze and optimize steel structures, including tubular and fabricated steel assemblies.
Problem-solve issues related to design, construction, and compliance.
Create and verify material list descriptions for transmission lines.
Prepare and review engineering calculations, design documentation, and technical reports to support customer approvals and manufacturing requirements.
Collaborate with detailing and drafting personnel to ensure engineering designs are accurately translated into fabrication and construction drawings.
Work closely with manufacturing and fabrication teams to identify opportunities to improve manufacturability, material utilization, product quality, and production efficiency.
Provide engineering support during fabrication, including resolving design questions, reviewing proposed modifications, and addressing manufacturing-related technical issues.
Participate in customer design reviews and technical discussions as required to clarify specifications, resolve engineering issues, and develop solutions that meet project requirements.
Review applicable industry codes and standards and maintain awareness of changes affecting utility structural steel design.
Travel periodically to different company locations.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in civil, structural or mechanical engineering.
3 to 5 years of experience in the Electrical Substation and Transmission Lines Industry.
PE License preferred, but at a minimum, an EIT studying for the PE is required.
Knowledge of PLS, RISA 3D, Mathcad, or other structural software.
Knowledge of AutoCAD or other relevant drafting software.
Some experience in steel and concrete structural design.
Familiarity with industry standards.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

Experience designing tubular steel structures, transmission poles, substation structures, and fabricated structural steel assemblies.
Working knowledge of structural steel design, including member sizing, connection design, bolted and welded connections, and material specifications.
Familiarity with applicable industry codes and standards, such as AISC, ASCE 7, ACI, NESC, and relevant IEEE standards.
Understanding of steel fabrication processes, including welding, cutting, drilling, forming, and assembly.
Ability to interpret customer specifications, engineering drawings, structural calculations, and fabrication drawings.
Experience working with manufacturing, detailing, and project management teams in an engineered-to-order or custom manufacturing environment.
Experience with PLS-CADD, PLS-POLE, RISA 3D, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000, or similar structural analysis software is a plus.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple engineering projects and priorities simultaneously.

title: Lloyd's Delegated Authority Auditor (Coverholder, DCA/TPA & Reinsurance)
description:
G MASS Consulting is partnered with a leading global insurance services group to build a pool of experienced delegated authority auditors. They will deliver coverholder, Delegated Claims Administrator (DCA) and reinsurance audits on behalf of Lloyd’s managing agents from January 2027.

The work covers the UK, Europe, the US and Canada. The client expects six to eight assignments a quarter, with a pipeline secured for at least the first six months of 2027. Auditors will deliver each audit end to end, from planning and fieldwork through to the final client-ready report, with minimal oversight.

Please read before applying

  • This opportunity is for individual practitioners only. We are not looking to sub-contract the work to other firms or consultancies. Independent freelancers are very welcome, but please only apply if you personally intend to carry out the audits.
  • Audits will be paid at a fixed price per audit, varying by audit type. Fees will be discussed at interview.
  • Audit work will start from January 2027.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end coverholder, DCA and reinsurance audits on behalf of Lloyd’s managing agents, typically around two full audits per month.
  • Review the binding authority agreement, delegated claims agreement or reinsurance contract, along with the managing agent’s audit scope, and issue tailored pre-audit information requests.
  • Conduct on-site and remote fieldwork, testing underwriting, claims, governance and controls against the terms of the delegated authority or reinsurance arrangement.
  • Hold wrap-up meetings with coverholder, DCA or cedant management to discuss initial findings.
  • Produce clear, evidence-based audit reports using a risk-based approach. Reports should give prioritised findings and recommendations, each tied back to the underlying agreement.
  • Submit formal reports to managing agents and record findings and recommendations in Lloyd’s Delegated Audit Manager (DAM) within the agreed deadlines.

Requirements

  • Proven experience delivering Lloyd’s coverholder, DCA/TPA and/or reinsurance audits. This is the most important requirement, and a strong audit track record will be prioritised.
  • Alternatively, a senior background as an underwriter, claims manager or reinsurance professional, with a solid understanding of delegated authority and reinsurance operations end to end.
  • Strong working knowledge of the Lloyd’s coordinated audit process and the current LMA Coverholder Audit Scope and TPA (DCA) Audit Scope, including the accompanying guidance notes.
  • Experience auditing reinsurance arrangements, or deep technical reinsurance expertise that can be applied in an audit context.
  • Demonstrable experience leading audits and writing structured, client-ready audit reports independently. The report is the client’s key deliverable, so this is essential.
  • Hands-on experience using DAM is strongly preferred.
  • Willingness to travel to audit sites as required.
  • Language skills in French, Italian, German or Spanish are advantageous. Spanish is especially helpful for work covering Florida and South America.

Benefits

  • Type: Freelance / contract, paid at a fixed price per audit
  • Start: January 2027
  • Location: Remote (UK- or US-based), with travel to audit sites as required

title: Public Affairs Manager EU
description:
We are looking for a Public Affairs Manager who thrives on collaboration and can build strong bridges between research, innovation and EU policy. Working closely with colleagues across the Novo Nordisk Foundation and Novo Holdings, you will identify where our research, innovation and investment activities within AI and quantum connect with relevant policy agendas, and help turn these connections into focused public affairs activities.

As the Foundation continues to strengthen its engagement at EU level, close collaboration with colleagues will be essential to linking work in our research areas with the right policy opportunities. You will help identify these matches and build the bridge between colleagues’ expertise and engagement with EU institutions, policymakers, and organisations. In doing so, you will contribute to the Novo Nordisk Foundation’s vision of improving people’s health and the sustainability of society and the planet.

The Novo Nordisk Foundation is one of the largest philanthropic actors in the world.

The Job

The Novo Nordisk Foundation supports excellent research and innovation in close collaboration with public and private stakeholders. In this role, you will primarily work alongside two colleagues on EU-related public affairs and collaborate closely with colleagues across the Foundation and Novo Holdings. Your core focus will be in the intersections of research, innovation, AI and quantum. A central part of your role will be following the related EU policy developments, shaping public affairs initiatives and strengthening our dialogue in and around the EU system. The tasks will include:

  • Identifying, building, and maintaining relevant stakeholder relations within the EU and related organisations
  • Building and maintaining alliances and partnerships with relevant EU stakeholders
  • Monitoring and influencing institutional, political, and regulatory developments in EU within areas of importance to the Novo Nordisk Foundation and Novo Holdings
  • Contributing to the running of the Brussels office and providing day-to-day public affairs support and advice across the Novo Nordisk Foundation and Novo Holdings
  • Working actively with agenda setting at EU and member state level
  • Closely collaborate and align with expert functions including coordination of outreach with public affairs colleagues
  • Building bridges across teams, enabling effective collaboration and timely alignment while navigating different priorities and realities with diplomacy and sound judgement
  • Designing and heading specific EU public affairs activities within AI and quantum, which for example includes driving the Foundation’s engagement on the EU Quantum Act through the full legislative process, from Commission proposal to negotiations in the European Parliament and the Council, following related EU frameworks and building alliances with research organisations, foundations, industry and other European quantum stakeholders.

You will be based in Brussels and regular travel activities to the headquarters in Copenhagen must be expected according to agreed-upon terms.

You will be reporting to the Director of Public Affairs and being part of our Public Affairs team with 9 colleagues. The team is anchored in the Corporate Affairs department. We value a collaborative working environment, where proactivity and an eye for detail drive our activities. Working together as a dedicated team is key to provide the best solutions in everything we do.

​Professional and personal qualifications

The ideal candidate has a minimum of +5 years’ experience with EU-related public affairs.

Furthermore, we expect that you have:

  • A master’s degree in political science, European studies, communication, law, economics, natural sciences, engineering or other relevant educational background;
  • Knowledge of EU decision-making processes and the political, regulatory and scientific landscape relevant to research, innovation, AI and quantum;
  • A strong and broad network within the EU environment;
  • Experience with complex stakeholder management;
  • The ability to independently drive processes and projects;
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build and engage stakeholders at all levels;
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbally and written;
  • Relevant EU policy expertise in AI and/or quantum technologies is required. Experience in EU research and innovation policy would be an asset. Experience with policies affecting the wider investment ecosystem, such as capital markets, seeds, venture and growth financing, or the mobilisation of long-term private capital, would be an additional advantage, but is not required.

As a person, you are purpose driven with a positive attitude and you have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build professional relationships and engage stakeholders at all levels.

You are also:

  • Analytical and with a structured approach to problem-solving;
  • Proactive and willing to take ownership of tasks across the team’s portfolio;
  • Professional, quality-conscious and impact-oriented;
  • A strong team player who contributes actively, supports colleagues and fosters collaboration.

Application and Information

For more information about the role, you can contact Senior Public Affairs Managers Maria Teresa Buco at mbu@novo.dk and/or Marie Elsner Sander mes@novo.dk. We encourage you to send your application as soon as possible, and no later than 6 December 2026.

To apply, please send your CV, cover letter, and university transcripts by clicking on the “Apply now” button.

About the Novo Nordisk Foundation

Established in Denmark in 1924, the Novo Nordisk Foundation is an enterprise foundation with philanthropic objectives. The vision of the Foundation is to improve people’s health and the sustainability of society and the planet. The Foundation’s mission is to progress research and innovation in the prevention and treatment of cardiometabolic and infectious diseases as well as to advance knowledge and solutions to support a green transformation of society.

title: Welcoming Street Coordinator (1 position)
description:
Position Title: Welcoming Street Coordinator (1 position)

Employment Status: Temporary Full-Time contract until March 31, 2027 with a possibility for extension

Position Status: This is a Bargaining Unit position. All terms and conditions of the collective bargaining agreement apply.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Job Posting Deadline for Internal Candidates: November 26, 2026, at 5:00pm

Hours of Work/Schedule: 35 Hours per week (including some evenings, weekends)

Position Reports To: Manager, HART Hub

Salary Range: Annualized salary range $56,201.60 - $62,062.00, commensurate on skills and experience, plus participation in HOOPP.

Primary Work Location: Oshawa, and across various agency locations within Durham Region.

Organization

Who We Are: Durham Community Health Centre (DCHC) is a registered charitable organization that provides integrated, accessible, and equitable community-based primary care, wellness services, and health education for Durham community members facing barriers to health and well-being.

Who We Serve: DCHC offers equity-focused programs and services for priority populations, including Indigenous peoples, Black communities, 2SLGBTQI+ community members, newcomers to Canada, seniors, and clients without a family doctor. This approach helps community members access both preventive care and care when they are ill.

How We Work: Our interprofessional team includes physicians, nurse practitioners, nurses, counsellors, dietitians, outreach workers, medical secretaries, and administrative staff. Together, we place each client at the centre of care and respond to their needs through integrated clinical care, wellness supports, and health education.

Why Join Now: This is an exciting time to join DCHC as we advance an energizing path toward greater impact in local health care. Guided by our Strategic Plan, Theory of Change, brand, client stories, and resources, we are diversifying, expanding, and strengthening how we serve the community.

Position Overview

The Welcoming Streets Program works to address concerns identified by business owners, and the public, about vulnerable and street-involved individuals who may be at risk. The program aims to facilitate more positive relationships between business owners and vulnerable individuals and ensures that unsheltered individuals are linked with the services they could benefit from. In addition, this program focuses on building capacity among local businesses to be better equipped to address concerns and build empathy for people who are vulnerable and living on the street.

The Welcoming Streets Coordinator will collaborate within an interdisciplinary team of health professionals across the community network that influences the health environment targeted to clients, as well as within the Agency’s team structure, in support of goals that align with and achieve the Agency’s strategy, Mission, Vision and Values.

Additionally, the Welcoming Streets Coordinator will develop links to community resources to meet the needs of clients, paying close attention in building partnerships with those who support the targeted community with the goal of improving engagement and continuity of care across the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Answering/supporting/directing incoming referrals and inquiries regarding unsheltered and risk of becoming unsheltered for individuals and families
  • Work with Case Managers to assist with weekly client schedules to ensure program goals & objectives are met.
  • Community case management – Covering case load for Case Managers while staff are on holidays/off sick, etc.
  • Development of groups to meet community needs including gap analysis/community feedback groups as well as training/mentoring new staff.
  • Assists with system navigation, advocacy, and life-skill development programming.
  • Working from a determinants-of-health and client-centred perspective in order to assist in building clients' capacity to work toward goals.
  • Maintains and manages the Homeless Individuals and Families Information System (HIFIS) database according to contractual requirements. Including performing audits on Case Managers case loads.
  • Completion of statistical reports for funders.
  • Sit on Community Advisory Committees with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Advocates for clients to receive the appropriate social service and health care.
  • Participates in case conferences for clients’ plans of care with external agencies and services where appropriate.
  • Establishes and maintains knowledge of community resources and builds strong relationships with external agencies and partners.
  • Document with DCHC’s EMR, information regarding outreach contacts.
  • Complete Incident Reports as required.
  • Follow policies and standards regarding confidentiality and documentation.
  • Ensure all necessary reports are completed accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Attend relevant team meetings and planning activities.
  • Participate in quality improvement and evaluation activities.
  • Work with the health and safety guidelines provided by the agency, which includes annual mandatory training requirements.

Other duties within scope of this position include:

• Assists, as assigned, in the orientation, training and mentoring of new staff on the team.

  • Consults regularly with local agencies or community resources concerning resource development and program planning which is pertinent to the population served.
  • Adheres to and applies organization-wide policies and practices in support of organizational health and performances.
  • Adheres to and applies established compliance measures within legislative requirements and equity principles (e.g., AODA, Human Rights Code, and Ontario Employment Standards).
  • Champions and supports Employee Engagement efforts and initiatives.
  • Ensures scope of duties/accountabilities adheres to established Health & Safety program, policies and procedures.
  • Other duties as assigned by the manager and the director.

Qualifications

  • Post secondary degree in Social Work, Psychology, Social Sciences, or equivalent is required. A diploma in Social Service Work (SSW) or related field of study with combined work experience will be considered.
  • Graduate certificate in Addictions and Mental Health is an asset.
  • At least two (2) years of experience in working in a community setting, specifically with street involved populations is required.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with marginalized and culturally diverse populations, including those with chemical dependency, mental illness, and HIV positive.
  • Screening, intake, assessment, and crisis intervention skills.

title: Duurzaam & Circulair (sloop-)projectmanager

Jouw rol als Duurzaam & Circulair (sloop-) projectmanager

  • Je begeleidt opdrachtgevers bij het vrijmaken van ruimte in de bebouwde omgeving. Je doet dat van eerste verkenning tot en met de bouwrijpe oplevering, met toxische saneringen, demontage, sloop en bouwrijp maken als kern. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor planning, financiën, kwaliteit, risico's en voortgang van projecten.

  • Je adviseert opdrachtgevers over circulaire strategieën, hergebruik van materialen en duurzame projectaanpakken.

  • Je onderhoudt en versterkt relaties binnen jouw netwerk van opdrachtgevers, marktpartijen en samenwerkingspartners.

  • Je draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling en zichtbaarheid van onze dienstverlening op het gebied van circulariteit en sloopmanagement.

  • Je begeleidt minder ervaren collega's en deelt actief kennis binnen het team.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent ondernemend, resultaatgericht en weet mensen mee te nemen in projecten. Je combineert een gestructureerde aanpak met commercieel inzicht en voelt je prettig in een omgeving waarin je verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en initiatief wordt gewaardeerd.

Wat neem je mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in civiele techniek, bouwkunde, vastgoed, milieukunde, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Ruime werkervaring binnen projectmanagement, sloopmanagement, bouw, vastgoed, duurzaamheid of circulariteit.

  • Ervaring met het leiden van multidisciplinaire projecten.

  • Sterke communicatieve en organisatorische vaardigheden.

  • Affiniteit met circulaire vraagstukken en duurzame gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

  • Het vermogen om duurzame relaties op te bouwen en kansen in de markt te herkennen.

  • Een proactieve, zelfstandige en ondernemende houding.

  • Bij voorkeur woonachtig in de regio Breda of bereid om regelmatig vanuit deze regio te werken.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Bij Tetra Tech krijg je de ruimte om je vak zelfstandig uit te oefenen én verder te ontwikkelen. Je werkt aan projecten die zichtbaar bijdragen aan de verduurzaming van de gebouwde omgeving en krijgt veel vrijheid om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

  • Een goed salaris in lijn met jouw kennis en ervaring in een bandbreedte van €5.000- t/m €6.500 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur). Daarnaast ook nog een uitstekende pensioenregeling.

  • Een leaseauto, op basis van ons mobiliteitsbeleid of Je krijgt een uitstekende reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Specialist worden in je vak of doorgroeien naar een leidinggevende rol? Met ons ‘Progress on Demand’ opleidingsprogramma bepaal je zelf hoe je jouw carrière pad vormgeeft – verdieping, verbreding of een combinatie – en welke trainingen hierbij passen.

  • 25+2 vrije dagen en de mogelijkheid om tien extra verlofdagen bij te kopen.

  • Flexibele werktijden en hybride werken.

  • Een vergoeding van je sportschool abonnement en een aantrekkelijk fietsplan.

  • Een informele, professionele werksfeer waarin veiligheid, respect, samenwerking, collegialiteit en kwaliteit vanzelfsprekend zijn.

  • Ben je jonger dan 30, dan mag je deelnemen aan Tetra Tech Young, ons netwerk voor young professionals

Werken bij Tetra Tech Nederland

Tetra Tech Nederland is een organisatie in ontwikkeling. Dat betekent ruimte voor initiatief, ondernemerschap en mensen die willen bouwen. Hier krijg je de kans om ideeën daadwerkelijk om te zetten in resultaat.

Wij werken integraal, laagdrempelig en met korte lijnen. Geen ingewikkelde structuren of dichtgetimmerde rollen, maar vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om impact te maken.

Meer weten?

title: Junior AI Developer: Generative AI & Cloud Prototyping

Mentorship

title: Security System Engineer
description:

Supportare il CISO presso il cliente. Fornire supporto tecnico su sicurezza di posta, M365 e rete. Essere il punto di contatto con il SOC remoto. Preferenza per certificazioni in ambito security o sistemistico (es. Security+, SC-900, AZ-500).

title: Remote Full-Stack Engineer for AI Evaluation Projects
description:
Anyone AI is seeking skilled Full-Stack Developers for a project with a leading AI lab. This remote, part-time consultant role focuses on designing and evaluating realistic coding tasks, bug fixes, and feature implementations.

Contributors will create multi-file coding tasks, write specifications, extend tests, and review peer submissions. You control your schedule and tools, and rates are paid per project.

Design and implement multi-file coding tasks across bug fixing, feature development, refactoring, and testing Write clear natural-language specifications and reference implementations Develop and extend unit and integration test suites Review peer-generated tasks for correctness, clarity, and realism Identify edge cases, ambiguities, and potential failure modes Ensure alignment between specifications, code, and expected outputs 3–7 years of professional software engineering experience. Advanced proficiency in English. Strong Python and JavaScript/TypeScript skills; knowledge of Java, C#, or Go. Backend or full-stack development in production systems. Experience with testing frameworks. Ability to debug and navigate large, multi-file codebases. Experience with code reviews, refactoring, and migrations.

title: Senior Network Security Engineer (L3) – Hybrid
description:
NorthBay Solutions LLC is seeking an experienced L3 Network Security Engineer to support enterprise security environments for a UAE-based client. The role emphasizes hands-on troubleshooting, security architecture, and incident resolution across diverse firewall platforms and security tooling.

You will work on complex security incidents, design secure networks, and participate in migrations and project work while aligning with UAE business hours when required.

Provide L3 technical support for complex network security incidents, escalations, and service requests. Administer, configure, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise firewall and network security platforms. Work with Palo Alto, FortiGate, Check Point, and other enterprise firewall technologies. Manage and troubleshoot F5 BIG-IP and related security infrastructure. Support IPS/IDS and DDoS protection/mitigation activities. Manage enterprise proxy and secure internet access solutions (Zscaler/Forcepoint). Support MFA, VPN token solutions, Cisco ISE/NAC, and remote access security environments. Design and review secure network architectures including HLD/LLD, HA, segmentation, and controls. Perform firewall policy reviews, rule implementations, migrations, and hardening. Troubleshoot VPN, firewall, authentication, and connectivity issues. Support WAF and application security requirements. Work with EDR and DLP technologies for endpoint security. Assist vulnerability assessments and security posture improvements. Coordinate with ITSM processes for incidents and changes. title: Junior Software Developer (Remote) – Algominds – Pakistan 2026
description:

Write and optimise SQL queries and manage database systems. Develop and integrate RESTful APIs. Utilise Git for version control and collaborative workflows. Apply data structures, algorithms, and OOP principles to solve technical challenges. Perform debugging and basic software testing. 0-1 years of programming experience required. Familiarity with object-oriented programming concepts. Proficiency in at least one language: Java, Python, or JavaScript. Experience with React.js and SQL databases.

title: Designer
description:
As a Designer at We Are Social, you’ll be bringing to life nicely-crafted, socially-led creative ideas across multiple platforms (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn) for some of the world’s biggest brands.

You’re not just a pro with static layouts, but also well-versed in motion design, video editing, and probably even dabble in animation, illustration, or shooting your own stuff and/or making your own content.

You’ll work closely with a close-knit design team as well as creatives, editorial staff, and account management to output brilliant, impactful work at the speed of social.

You’re a power user of pretty much everything Adobe Suite (like Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro), but also always keeping up to date with social trends, as well as social-first apps such as Capcut and cutting edge developments in new fields.

Naturally, you’re across typography, colour theory, grids, and all that. And you’re ready to break the mold when necessary and work in various different graphic styles depending on the brand.

You soak up design inspiration like a sponge and are keen to push visuals in new directions and be proactive and flexible in your work approach.

You’re ready to do some of the best work of your career, and maybe win some awards.

Being at a socially-led agency, you have the ability to be always-on, with a high level of versatility, and you’ll be able to flex your skills across multiple projects at a fast pace.


You’ll have:

  • At least 3 years experience in a digital, creative or social agency
  • Proficiency in design for digital and, in particular, social media platforms
  • A degree level education in graphic, digital or interactive design,
    fine arts, illustration and/or other related design discipline
  • Excellent knowledge of industry standard software such as Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Motion design and video editing skills
  • Ability to take direction and execute/create to a high standard under pressure

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Designer you’ll be expected to:

  • Conceptualise and visualize content for social media as well other channels
  • Have an excellent knowledge of industry trends, campaigns and platform requirements
  • Challenge yourself and those around you to consistently improve
  • Ensure the level of design that comes out of the agency is of a high visual standard and crafted to meet the rapidly-changing requirements of the various social platforms
  • Have a keen eye for detail and be able to maintain quality control of own work
  • Work efficiently on a number of different clients within the working day, meeting deadlines and making sure projects are completed both on time and on budget
  • Self initiate ideas and proactively contribute to briefs
  • Demonstrate excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Collaborate with clients and colleagues at all levels



ABOUT US

We are a global socially-led creative agency with 1,300 people in 19 offices. We understand social behaviours within communities and cultures, helping our clients reach the right people in relevant ways.

We love diversity of thought and experience. We welcome unique voices and talents that haven’t been traditionally embraced by advertising. If you want to work in a place where your perspective matters, we want to hear from you.

title: Linux Infrastructure Engineer | Full Remote
description:
Descrizione azienda

La figura sarà coinvolta nelle attività di gestione operativa, manutenzione e monitoraggio delle infrastrutture IT, contribuendo a garantire la continuità dei servizi, l'affidabilità dei sistemi e il corretto funzionamento delle piattaforme tecnologiche.


Cerchiamo un profilo con solide competenze nell'amministrazione di sistemi Linux, capace di intervenire nella gestione quotidiana delle infrastrutture, nell'analisi e risoluzione di incident e problematiche tecniche e nel supporto alle attività operative del team.


La risorsa opererà su un ecosistema tecnologico che comprende piattaforme quali Talend, Cloudera, Qlik, ServiceNow, IronPort e soluzioni MDM, collaborando con team multidisciplinari per garantire la stabilità e l'efficienza dei servizi infrastrutturali.

Costituiscono requisiti preferenziali:

  • Esperienza in contesti di Managed Services, con gestione di servizi infrastrutturali regolati da SLA.
  • Familiarità con processi di Incident Management e Problem Management.
  • Esperienza nell'utilizzo di strumenti di IT Service Management, con particolare riferimento a ServiceNow.
  • Conoscenza di ambienti infrastrutturali complessi e piattaforme enterprise.
  • Esperienza nella collaborazione con team tecnici multidisciplinari per la gestione e il miglioramento dei servizi IT.


Competenze trasversali


  • Buone capacità di analisi e problem solving.
  • Autonomia nella gestione delle attività assegnate.
  • Attitudine al lavoro in team e alla collaborazione con figure tecniche multidisciplinari.
  • Capacità di gestione delle priorità e delle scadenze.
  • Precisione e attenzione alla qualità, all'affidabilità e alla continuità operativa dei sistemi.
  • Buone capacità comunicative e relazionali.
  • Predisposizione all'apprendimento continuo e alla condivisione delle competenze.


Cosa offriamo


Retribuzione annua lorda (RAL) compresa tra 33.000 € e 43.000 €, commisurata alle competenze tecniche, alla seniority e all'esperienza maturata.


Modalità di lavoro Full Remote, con possibilità di operare da qualsiasi città italiana.

Sono inoltre previsti buoni pasto, assicurazione sanitaria aggiuntiva e percorsi di formazione interna con simulazioni AI per attività di upskilling e reskilling.


Human-centric Company


Il nostro asset più importante sono le persone e lavoriamo ogni giorno per migliorare il work-life balance delle nostre risorse.

Flessibilità, ascolto e fiducia sono valori strettamente connessi alla nostra idea di leadership e che rientra nelle relazioni con le nostre persone, i nostri clienti e i nostri partner.


#Joinus


Crediamo nei valori della diversità, dell'equità e dell'inclusione, promuovendo un ambiente di lavoro che valorizzi le competenze e le caratteristiche individuali.

Crediamo nei valori della diversità e dell’inclusione di genere e cultura, prestando inoltre attenzione e sensibilità ai/alle candidati/e appartenenti alle categorie protette, ai sensi degli articoli 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99. I dati personali saranno trattati in conformità alle disposizioni contenute nel Regolamento UE 2016/679.

title: Manufacturing Designer / Engineer
description:
Position Summary:
The Manufacturing Designer / Engineer turns product designs into parts and assemblies the shop can build right the first time. The role is CAD-first, with approximately 80% of time in the office and 20% on the production floor. Core work includes 3D modeling and detailed drawings for fabricated and machined parts, DXF cut files for the plasma CNC, support for outside machine shops, and resolving manufacturability issues between Engineering and Production.
The final title (Manufacturing Designer or Manufacturing Engineer) is set at hire based on demonstrated experience. Responsibilities and authority are the same for both titles.
Essential Responsibilities:

Create and maintain 3D models, assemblies, and detailed 2D drawings for fabricated, welded, and machined parts using SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor, or Onshape.
Generate DXF files for the plasma CNC and verify cut files are accurate before release to the floor.
Serve as the point of contact for outside machine shops: interpret drawings, answer questions, and resolve discrepancies so parts are returned correctly.
Review designs for manufacturability before release and recommend changes to Engineering before steel is cut.
Spend regular time on the production floor resolving build issues, checking fit-up, and folding shop feedback back into drawings.
Design weld fixtures, jigs, and shop aids that make builds faster and more repeatable.
Perform basic FEA (linear static analysis) on fixtures, frames, skids, lifting points, and structural weldments. Analysis on pressure-containing components is reviewed and approved by qualified Engineering per company procedures.
Maintain BOM accuracy and drawing revision control in the PDM and ERP systems.
Apply the API and ISO standards FHE is held to when creating and revising drawings.
Take assigned design projects from concept through finished, built product.
Participate in design reviews and perform drafting checks to catch errors and omissions before release.
Support the Quality Management System through document control and corrective actions as requested.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:
Required

2+ years of hands-on experience in SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor, or Onshape (Onshape preferred).
Experience as a drawing detailer in a fabrication and machining environment, including dimensions, tolerances, and weld callouts.
Working experience with FEA, at minimum basic static stress analysis.
Hands-on build experience, either working in a shop on deadlines or substantial personal projects, using your hands to solve problems.
Practical understanding of plasma cutting, welding, and machining processes and their limits.
Knows what “done” looks like: holds drawings and cut files to exact requirements, and moves quickly on fixtures, prototypes, and shop aids that just need to work.
Strong attention to detail.
Self-motivated; manages own workload and deadlines with minimal direction.
Communicates clearly with welders, machinists, vendors, and engineers.

Preferred

Has taken a design project from scratch to finished product.
Experience with gas piping requirements.
Oil and gas industry experience.

Education & Experience:

Degree in mechanical engineering, manufacturing engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. A degree is not required.
2+ years of CAD experience in a manufacturing, fabrication, or machining setting.

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements:

Duties performed primarily in an office setting (approximately 80%), with regular time on the production floor (approximately 20%).
Exposure to loud noise levels and certain contaminants while on the production floor.
Must wear required personal protective equipment in designated areas, including safety glasses, steel-toed boots, and hearing protection.
Extended periods of sitting and computer use.
While on the production floor: stand, walk, bend, and climb onto equipment; occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 lbs.
Close vision required for detailed drawing and inspection work.

Tools and Equipment Used:

Computer with CAD, PDM, and ERP software; general office equipment.
Measuring tools such as calipers, tape measures, and squares.
Common hand and power tools as needed on the production floor.

Other:

This position is 100% on-site and non-exempt, overtime may be required based on department workload and is paid in accordance with applicable law.
Employees of FHE are expected to abide by the Code of Conduct and Ethics and to maintain a high standard of integrity, honesty, and reliability.

title: General Maintenance II
description:

Monday-Friday, 7:30am - 4:00pm
SCHEDULE

Respond to all emergency situations including but not limited to fire alarms and leaks.
Ensure quality workmanship in all work.
Maintain cleanliness in all work and break areas.
Keep all equipment in good working condition.
Work safely and comply at all times with Plymouth Harbor’s safety standards.
Work individually, and as a team member to provide support and assistance to all fellow Maintenance Services staff.

Troubleshoot maintenance issues involving electrical, structural, plumbing, and other MEP equipment.
Perform assigned preventive building maintenance.

Perform routine electrical repairs, i.e., change light bulbs or fluorescent lamps, repairing ballast and light fixtures.
Repair and/or replace doors, door closures, hinges, door knobs or locks, windows, window hardware, screens, etc.
Perform minor repairs of ceramic tile and other flooring material.
Repair drywall including matching existing texture/finish.
Paint including interior/exterior walls, touch up of areas where work has been done to complete work order.
Perform visual inspections and/or readings of fire extinguishers, fuel tanks, gas boilers and other equipment as assigned.
Perform preventive/routine maintenance on all appliances; troubleshoot appliance issues, make or arrange for repairs needed, recommend replacement as appropriate; switch-out old appliances and tag new appliances.
Purchases supplies, equipment, and materials necessary to complete work orders/projects.
Attend and participate in workshops, seminars, and mandatory in-services as approved or required.
Discharge properly any other responsibilities, duties or assignments that may be assigned to you.

Smith Care Center

Conduct comprehensive SCC room audits as assigned.
Repair/replace bathroom plumbing fixtures, walls and flooring, re-grouting, caulking and painting.
Troubleshoot/repair nurse call system, bed center and communication systems including bed lighting and handrail operation, cable and electrical outlets, electrical devices and switches, exterior shutters, etc.

title: Senior IT Business Analyst - Laboratory Informatics & Integration

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior IT Business Analyst to lead requirements and process design for laboratory instrument connectivity and scientific data integration initiatives.
