You will help shape solutions that support the full laboratory workflow, from sample registration and testing through result approval and downstream analytics. The role spans discovery, Agile delivery, user acceptance testing, and qualification in GxP-regulated environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Elicit, analyze, and document business, functional, data, and integration requirements for laboratory connectivity and scientific data integration initiatives.
  • Lead discovery workshops and requirements sessions, serving as the primary liaison between laboratory subject matter experts, business stakeholders, vendors, architects, and engineering teams.
  • Map current laboratory processes and data flows, identify gaps, and design target-state workflows for sample handling, testing, data acquisition, result review, approval, and downstream data use.
  • Support the onboarding of laboratory instruments and applications, including laboratory information management systems (LIMS), electronic laboratory notebooks (ELN), and chromatography data systems (CDS), into enterprise platforms.
  • Contribute to solution evaluations, integration assessments, and architecture reviews. Help define repeatable approaches for onboarding instruments and applications at scale.
  • Drive business analysis activities throughout Agile delivery, including backlog refinement and prioritization, user story and acceptance criteria development, user acceptance testing (UAT), and stakeholder sign-off.
  • Support qualification and validation by authoring qualification documentation, leading informal and formal testing, and documenting test results and evidence in collaboration with QA and validation teams.

Requirements

Skills and Expertise

  • Strong business analysis skills, including requirements elicitation, process modeling, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and solution assessment.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end laboratory workflows, including sample registration, testing, data acquisition, result review, approval, and use of scientific data for analytics and decision-making.
  • Hands-on experience with laboratory informatics systems such as LabWare LIMS, IDBS or Revvity Signals ELN, and Chromeleon CDS.
  • Understanding of laboratory instrument workflows and how data moves between instruments, CDS, LIMS, ELN, enterprise data platforms, and analytics applications.
  • Experience with system integrations, APIs, data mapping, interoperability, metadata management, and enterprise data platforms.
  • Knowledge of GxP, ALCOA+ data integrity principles, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, and EU GMP Annex 11.
  • Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate laboratory needs into clear requirements for technical teams.

Experience And Qualifications

  • At least eight years of IT business analysis experience.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or R&D laboratory environments.
  • Proven delivery experience in laboratory digitalization, scientific data integration, or interoperability programs.
  • Experience collaborating with laboratory operations, QA, validation teams, vendors, and IT delivery teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, engineering, life sciences, or a related field.

title: Data Architect
description:
Data Architect - Hands on

6-month contract


Your new company

A leading Australian organisation is embarking on a major enterprise-wide data transformation program focused on modernising its data ecosystem and enabling future Data & AI capabilities. This initiative includes migrating from legacy data warehouse platforms to AWS Cloud, implementing Data Mesh principles, and establishing a scalable, cloud-native data platform that will support the organisation's long-term digital strategy.


Your new role

An opportunity exists for a Hands-On Data Architect to lead the Finance data stream within a complex transformation program. This role is ideally suited to someone who has progressed from a strong Data Engineering background into architecture and remains highly technical.

You will be responsible for defining and driving the data architecture, leading technical discussions, influencing key stakeholders, and providing hands-on guidance throughout delivery. While operating at an architectural level, you will also work closely with engineering teams to ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and successfully implemented.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead the Finance data workstream across a large-scale transformation program.
  • Define and own the target-state data architecture and migration roadmap.
  • Drive the migration from legacy data warehouse technologies to AWS Cloud.
  • Design and implement Data Mesh-aligned architecture and data products.
  • Provide technical leadership across data engineering, integration, modelling and governance.
  • Lead architecture workshops and facilitate discussions with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Review solution designs and provide hands-on technical direction to delivery teams.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards.
  • Enable future analytics, reporting, machine learning and AI capabilities through modern platform design.
  • Collaborate with project, architecture and engineering teams to deliver successful outcomes.


What you'll need to succeed

  • Proven experience as a Data Architect, Lead Data Architect, Principal Data Engineer or similar role.
  • Strong hands-on Data Engineering background with the ability to contribute to solution design and technical decision-making.
  • Experience leading enterprise data platform modernisation or cloud migration programs.
  • Deep knowledge of modern data architecture patterns and best practices.
  • Strong experience with:
  • AWS
  • DBT
  • Amazon Redshift
  • Data Warehousing
  • Data Modelling
  • ETL/ELT Frameworks
  • Data Mesh Architecture
  • Experience designing cloud-native data platforms that support analytics and AI workloads.
  • Ability to independently lead discussions, workshops and stakeholder engagements.
  • Proven capability to take ownership of architecture decisions and drive outcomes.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.


What you'll get in return

  • Initial 6-month contract with strong extension potential.
  • Opportunity to lead a critical stream of a high-profile enterprise transformation program.
  • Exposure to large-scale cloud, data modernisation and Data Mesh initiatives.
  • A highly collaborative environment working with senior stakeholders and technical leaders.
  • Competitive daily rate and flexible working arrangements.
